chapters.title: Chapter 601 - 368: Divine Artifact, Giant Beast Shield (3)
paragraphs: Hearing this, Balrog instantly understood.
He nodded and said, "This is simple; just add more Philosopher’s Stones to increase the strength of the Divine Power."
Han Xing was delighted once again, "Then I’ll trouble Grandmaster Balrog."
After speaking, they left the place.
Upon arriving at the inn.
There was a dwarf wearing a royal uniform at the door, seemingly waiting there for quite some time.
Upon seeing Han Xing, the dwarf slightly bowed and then said, "His Majesty the King has informed that the Ancient Ruins will officially open in five days."
"At that time, special vehicles will come to pick you all up."
"Please make preparations."
Han Xing nodded.
After the dwarf finished speaking, he left the place.
Everyone returned to the inn’s room once more, silently waiting.
Time swiftly passed.
Soon, it was five days later...
On this day.
An extended version of the Golden Angel Battleship appeared above the royal capital.
Then it landed straight at the entrance of the inn where Han Xing and the others were staying.
Han Xing knew that this battleship was meant to pick them up.
Then, with a flash, five people appeared directly on the Golden Angel Battleship.
At the same time.
Golden Angel Battleships were ascending into the sky throughout the royal capital.
Mixed among them were some other flying vehicles.
All these flying vehicles were heading towards the same place.
Seven or eight hours later.
They arrived at the Dwarf Realm, in an extremely remote area.
There were no bustling cities here.
All around the Sky Island were terrifyingly lethal defense towers.
The defense forces were exceptionally strict.
Occasionally, one could sense a powerful aura flashing by.
From afar, Han Xing saw a black continent ahead.
On that continent, there was no vegetation or buildings, just a barren land.
At that moment, a broadcast sounded from the battleship overhead.
"Attention, mighty figures of each race, the entrance to the Ancient Ruins is about to be reached, please prepare for landing."
Upon hearing the broadcast, everyone tensed up.
It’s about to begin!
Then.
They saw all the battleships moving towards the black continent.
The battleship advanced for some time.
Arriving at a vast open space, it slowly descended.
With curious eyes, everyone began to step out of the battleship.
Han Xing’s first glance saw the charred landscape around them.
Whether it was the soil or the distant mountains.
Everything here was black.
Even the air was filled with the scent of dense smoke.
As if it had been scorched by a great fire.
At the same time.
Other mighty figures from various races also disembarked from the battleships one after another.
Han Xing saw the Bright Divine Son radiating golden light all over.
The Little Giant Spirit King, standing seven or eight meters tall.
Even Wan Liu of the Tree Spirit Race was present.
Just like Han Xing.
Upon landing, they immediately began to survey the terrain.
At that moment, a rainbow-like light appeared in the sky.
The light descended directly.
Like a small wooden boat drifting in the apocalypse, filled with redemption and holiness.
It was the small wooden boat of the Elf Race Goddess.
A fairy-like figure slowly descended from the sky.
After landing, the Elf Goddess Elinora put away the small wooden boat.
Her gaze scanned the crowd.
Pausing on the Bright Divine Son, Dark Divine Son, Little Giant Spirit King one after another.
Then, upon seeing Han Xing, a faint smile appeared on her face.
She nodded at Han Xing.
Below, the Divine Sons and Daughters were momentarily stunned upon seeing Elinora’s smile.
They couldn’t help but murmur.
"Divine Lady Elinora, truly beautiful..."
"Indeed, one wonders what kind of hero could win the favor of a deity."
The Divine Son speaking had a somewhat intoxicated look.
But he was quickly interrupted by another Divine Son.
"What are you thinking? Someone as esteemed as the Divine Maiden, no one in the Holy Spirit Realm is worthy of her."
"Indeed, our Clan Leader said that the Divine Maiden might even break through to become a demigod within a century, becoming the new generation Elf King."
"None of the prodigies of our generation can compare to the Divine Maiden."
"Elf King... That status would make her one of the most powerful beings in the Holy Spirit Realm."
However, the Little Giant Spirit King sneered to the side.
"A woman who often uses cheap tricks and harbors impure motives dares to call herself a Divine Maiden?"
"Even her position as Divine Maiden was obtained through manipulation."
Upon hearing this.
Elinora’s smile disappeared, and she said seriously.
"Little Giant Spirit King, you continually slander me. During our last expedition to the Flame Plateau, it was solely due to your lack of strength."
"I don’t wish to argue with you further."
"Now, you accuse me of obtaining the position of Divine Maiden through manipulation."
"Do you have any proof?"
The Little Giant Spirit King sneered, "I already said, I don’t need any proof."
"No matter how much you disguise it, you can’t fool my eyes."
Upon seeing the Little Giant Spirit King so aggressive, some other Divine Sons could no longer hold back and wanted to speak up for Elinora.
Just as they were about to argue.
In the sky.
An extremely powerful aura appeared.
That aura was like refined steel tempered thousands of times over.
Heavy and unceasing.
It was the Dwarf King.
Beside him were seven dwarves with equally formidable and concentrated auras.
A quick sensing revealed each had High-tier Legend strength.
The Divine Sons and Daughters below were shocked.
Unexpectedly, even the Dwarf King personally came for this exploration of the ancient ruins.
It showed his seriousness about this action.
At this moment, the Dwarf King solemnly said, "Divine Sons and Daughters of all races, the entrance to the Ancient Ruins will open in a few minutes."

chapters.title: Chapter 602 - 369: Entering the Ancient Ruins
paragraphs: The Dwarf King said, "Before that, let me explain to you the situation inside and some things to pay attention to."
Upon hearing this, everyone focused their attention and listened carefully to the Dwarf King’s speech.
"You should all know that the Ancient Ruins are a special area, equivalent to a Secret Realm."
"Inside, your Power will be restricted, and everyone’s Divine Power cannot be used."
Upon hearing the Dwarf King announce the first rule, there was an uproar on the scene.
It was their first time knowing that the use of Divine Power is restricted inside the Ancient Ruins.
It’s important to know that the biggest difference between Legendary Powerhouses and those below is Divine Power.
Without Divine Power, they will lose many abilities.
Such as God’s Perspective, Divine Power Domain, Sky Flying, etc.
Their combat capability will be greatly reduced.
As if aware that they would be shocked,
the Dwarf King paused, then continued, "Don’t worry, even without Divine Power, your physical capabilities remain."
"With your combat experience, you can handle general dangerous situations."
Hearing this, the crowd gradually breathed a sigh of relief.
"The second restriction is, due to the Ancient Ruins’ vast space,"
"your positions will be randomly dispersed when you enter, and you may not find where the others are."
"But it’s okay. Our race has developed a locating chip."
"You can use the chip to sense the positions of others."
The Dwarf King continued, "My advice to you is to find other Divine Sons and Daughters to gather with as soon as you enter."
"The monsters inside the Ancient Ruins are very powerful and dangerous."
"Only by concentrating the team’s strength can you go further inside and obtain more opportunities."
Below, the Divine Sons and Daughters nodded.
The Dwarf Race has explored the Ancient Ruins many times and must have experience dealing with various situations.
With that,
the Dwarf King waved a single hand.
The crowd saw a purple Teleportation Gate appear on the previously charred black ground.
The Dwarf King’s weathered voice came forth.
"Then, go inside."
"You have three months of exploration time."
"After three months, a Teleportation Array somewhere on the ruin continent will activate."
"You will all receive the relevant notification."
The Dwarf King solemnly reminded everyone.
"Remember, once the time is up, you must rush to the location of the Teleportation Array as soon as possible."
"Otherwise, you’ll have to stay inside and wait for the next opening of the Ancient Ruins to exit."
"That period could be long..."
"Perhaps five years, maybe ten years."
The Divine Sons and Daughters on the scene suddenly stiffened with determination.
They definitely didn’t want to stay inside for so long!
At this moment, the Dwarf King opened his palm.
Items wrapped in Divine Power flew to their sides.
Everyone received a peculiar chip in their hands.
With just a slight sense, one could feel the dense cluster of red dots nearby.
Han Xing showed a look of realization on his face.
These red dots should mark the positions of other Divine Sons and Daughters.
You can roughly sense the locations of other Divine Sons through the chip.
At this moment,
the towering giant scanned the people on the scene.
Raising an eyebrow, he directly stepped into the Teleportation Gate,
and the other Divine Sons and Daughters followed suit, one by one stepping in.
Han Xing’s group of five walked behind everyone else.
Shen Yun, holding his chip, said, "Brother Xing, the Dwarf King said our positions would be split when we enter."
"Do you think the group function inside will shut down?"
As Survivors, the system is their advantage.
No matter how far apart they are, they can send messages and determine each other’s locations.
If the group function fails, they would become like the natives of this world.
Only fumbling in the dark and exploring based on intuition.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Not sure, we’ll check it out once we get in."
"If the group function doesn’t work, then we’ll use this chip to determine our positions."
"Either way, regroup as soon as we get in."
Everyone nodded together.
Then.
They each stepped into the purple Teleportation Array.
The scene before their eyes shifted.
The five disappeared from the original spot simultaneously.
It was unclear how much time had passed.
Han Xing felt solid ground beneath his feet.
He suddenly opened his eyes.
Instinctively, he took out his Longbow, preparing for battle.
After sensing no immediate danger around him, he slightly relaxed.
At this moment, Han Xing began to rapidly observe his surroundings.
This place looked like a deserted city.
Everywhere around were collapsed buildings, crumbling walls, and ruins spread all over.
The air was also filled with drifting black ash.
The entire world seemed as if it had been scorched by fire.
Even the ground’s debris was charred black.
In the distance, one could faintly see black mountains.
However, these mountains seemed man-made.
Some were standard triangles, others were rectangular.
Some were just a single column...
For this mysterious world, Han Xing was at a loss.
"Is this the Ancient Ruins?"
"Why does it feel like a future world from a movie?"
Leaving aside the destroyed city, from the buildings,
one could vaguely see the former prosperity.
The ground was covered with many discarded metal parts.
Some looked like they could be the tail sections of spaceships.
Other mechanical components were scattered on the ground too.
Shaking his head.
Han Xing put these thoughts aside.

chapters.title: Chapter 603 - 369: Entering the Ancient Ruins
paragraphs: The immediate priority now is to confirm whether the team channel function is still operational.
Han Xing quickly opened the system panel.
Then, he breathed a sigh of relief.
"Great, the system panel is still there, and the team function is normal."
Moreover, he also found that the small map function on the system interface was also present.
He was the first to send a message on the chat channel.
"How’s your situation now? Have you encountered any danger?"
As soon as the message was sent, he immediately received replies from the team members.
Shen Yun: "Brother Xing, I seem to have landed in a scorched mountain forest, there are strange sounds nearby, but no danger."
Cheng Jianyong: "I landed on a plain, I haven’t encountered any danger here either."
Then, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang also responded.
Han Xing nodded, secretly relieved.
He continued, "Report your locations, as per the previous plan, let’s regroup as quickly as possible."
Then, everyone reported their coordinates one after another.
Han Xing took a look.
The positions of the five of them were all very far apart.
At least tens of thousands of kilometers.
The closest to him was Su Xiaoyang.
The positions of Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were not far from each other.
While Zhang Lianmeng was in a separate area.
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing directly said, "Shen Yun, Cheng Jianyong, you two meet up first."
"I’ll go get Xiaoyang."
"Then we’ll split into two routes and head towards the same place."
Regarding Han Xing’s decision.
The five people all expressed no problem.
Then.
Han Xing dashed straight for Su Xiaoyang’s coordinates.
In the Ancient Ruins.
Divine Power couldn’t be used, so everyone could only advance rapidly on foot.
But fortunately, he was naturally an agility-type profession.
Coupled with the Witch Race Saint Master title and various equipment bonuses.
His movement speed had almost reached a terrifying level.
"Whoosh!
Above the abandoned city, a strong gust of wind suddenly arose.
Han Xing’s instant burst speed was so fast, it was like a cannonball exploding on the spot!
After the violent explosion.
A figure charged out at an extremely terrifying speed.
Black smoke billowed everywhere.
In just a few seconds, Han Xing traversed the city’s ruins.
Straight into the outer wasteland.
The wasteland’s ground was still covered with fragments of various mechanical parts.
As if there had been a sci-fi battle.
From a distance, Han Xing saw a small hill appear on the ground in front.
Before he could get closer, the ground had already started to shake slightly.
"Rumble!"
The small hill rose from its place, instantly reaching a hundred meters high.
Moreover, all the parts and mechanical debris on the surrounding ground converged towards that small hill.
As if that small hill was a giant magnet.
Han Xing’s arrival activated its magnetism.
"What is that?"
In Han Xing’s puzzled gaze, a mechanical monster several hundred meters tall, with a burnt black appearance, appeared in front of him.
It held a black broken blade in its left hand, and a huge cannon mouth in its right hand.
This appearance reminded Han Xing of some familiar creature.
Spiritual Puppet.
A type of monster previously encountered in the Cloud Secret Realm.
However, the mechanical monster in front of him was obviously more powerful.
In front of Han Xing, appeared the monster’s attributes.
[Enhanced Battlefield Robot: Five-star Lord Level]
[Level]: 53.
[Attributes]: Power 8761, Agility 7545, Spirit 9642, Constitution 12111
[Skills]: Enhanced Cutting, Enhanced Air Burst Cannon, Mechanical Domain, Energy Core Detonation.
Note: A battle weapon specifically developed for battlefield environments, possessing strong combat capabilities.
A five-star lord-level creature, the attributes introduction also stated that the opponent had extremely strong combat capabilities.
Han Xing didn’t hesitate.
Directly drawing his bowstring.
Then he fired an arrow.
"Boom!"
The Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill once again exerted its power, causing a violent explosion.
Han Xing knew that the weak point of this kind of monster was the energy core in its chest.
This arrow hit exactly at the chest area.
The next moment.
This gigantic robot had a charred black hole appear on its chest.
Black smoke rose from its head, and after a bout of trembling, it collapsed.
[Successfully killed Enhanced Battlefield Robot: Five-star Lord Level, gained Experience Value 173 million... ]
To deal with a lord-level creature of the same level, it only took one arrow.
This shows how terrifying Han Xing’s Attack Power is now.
Han Xing stood in front of the massive corpse of the robot, deep in thought.
"I remember, in the Cloud Secret Realm, those Spiritual Puppets’ corpses could be dismantled."
"I wonder if this combat robot can be dismantled too?"
Han Xing attempted to click dismantle.
At this moment, the system prompt appeared.
[Dismantle successful, obtained Mithril Ingot*12723, Permanent Gold Ingot*314, Insect Emperor Stone*43, broken Energy Core (Five-star Lord Level)*1... ]
"Insect Emperor Stone? What is this?"
[Insect Emperor Stone]: A stone nurtured within certain creatures, contains extremely strong Divine Power, can be used in place of the Philosopher’s Stone.
Upon seeing the system prompt, Han Xing’s eyes revealed a hint of joy.
"I see, the Insect Emperor Stone of this world is equivalent to the Philosopher’s Stone of the Holy Spirit Realm?"
"Then this gain is really not bad!"
Not to mention those Mithril and Permanent Gold Ingots.
Getting over 40 Insect Emperor Stones from a five-star lord level is already quite an astonishing yield.
As for the Energy Core afterward.
Just like the Energy Core from the previous Spiritual Puppet Han Xing obtained.
It can be combined with schematics to create a new Model No. 13 battle robot.

[Enhanced Battlefield Robot: Five-star Lord Level]
[Level]: 53.
[Attributes]: Power 8761, Agility 7545, Spirit 9642, Constitution 12111
[Skills]: Enhanced Cutting, Enhanced Air Burst Cannon, Mechanical Domain, Energy Core Detonation.
Note: A battle weapon specifically developed for battlefield environments, possessing strong combat capabilities.
A five-star lord-level creature, the attributes introduction also stated that the opponent had extremely strong combat capabilities.
Han Xing didn’t hesitate.
Directly drawing his bowstring.
Then he fired an arrow.
"Boom!"
The Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill once again exerted its power, causing a violent explosion.
Han Xing knew that the weak point of this kind of monster was the energy core in its chest.
This arrow hit exactly at the chest area.
The next moment.
This gigantic robot had a charred black hole appear on its chest.
Black smoke rose from its head, and after a bout of trembling, it collapsed.
[Successfully killed Enhanced Battlefield Robot: Five-star Lord Level, gained Experience Value 173 million... ]
To deal with a lord-level creature of the same level, it only took one arrow.
This shows how terrifying Han Xing’s Attack Power is now.
Han Xing stood in front of the massive corpse of the robot, deep in thought.
"I remember, in the Cloud Secret Realm, those Spiritual Puppets’ corpses could be dismantled."
"I wonder if this combat robot can be dismantled too?"
Han Xing attempted to click dismantle.
At this moment, the system prompt appeared.
[Dismantle successful, obtained Mithril Ingot*12723, Permanent Gold Ingot*314, Insect Emperor Stone*43, broken Energy Core (Five-star Lord Level)*1... ]
"Insect Emperor Stone?
What is this?"
[Insect Emperor Stone]: A stone nurtured within certain creatures, contains extremely strong Divine Power, can be used in place of the Philosopher’s Stone.
Upon seeing the system prompt, Han Xing’s eyes revealed a hint of joy.
"I see, the Insect Emperor Stone of this world is equivalent to the Philosopher’s Stone of the Holy Spirit Realm?"
"Then this gain is really not bad!"
Not to mention those Mithril and Permanent Gold Ingots.
Getting over 40 Insect Emperor Stones from a five-star lord level is already quite an astonishing yield.
As for the Energy Core afterward.
Just like the Energy Core from the previous Spiritual Puppet Han Xing obtained.
It can be combined with schematics to create a new Model No.
13 battle robot.

chapters.title: Chapter 604 - 369: Entering the Ancient Ruins
paragraphs: "It seems that the spiritual puppet blueprints of Kaelon drew their design inspiration from here."
At this moment, another system notification appeared.
[Successfully killed a relic monster, relic energy points +20.]
"Relic energy points? What is this thing?"
Han Xing showed a contemplative expression.
He studied it for half a minute but couldn’t make headway.
So he decided to put it aside.
Then, Han Xing continued heading toward the coordinates sent by Su Xiaoyang.
He hadn’t gone far.
Han Xing once again encountered a five-star lord-level mechanical puppet attacking him.
However, similarly, it was still blown apart by a single arrow from Han Xing.
Dragon-hunting archery is indeed effective against these large-bodied creatures.
One arrow deals more horrific damage than a large fireball.
As usual, Han Xing disassembled it, harvesting many materials and an Insect Emperor Stone from the puppet.
At this time, Han Xing realized.
This world, resembling a war-torn apocalypse, still had quite a dense population of monsters.
Having advanced about a hundred kilometers.
Han Xing had encountered five or six mechanical puppets with lord-level strength.
Among them, there was even a dominator-level robot.
From the remains of that dominator-level robot.
Han Xing, as usual, initiated the disassembly.
This time, however, there was an unexpected harvest.
Besides the Insect Emperor Stone and 50 energy points.
Han Xing also acquired a piece of Calamity Divine Gold.
Even though it was only one piece.
It still brought joy to Han Xing’s heart.
Because this indicated.
These puppets could drop such a precious material as Calamity Divine Gold!
At this moment, Han Xing pondered.
"If there’s no time limit, staying longer in this world to specifically farm these mechanical monsters might be a good choice."
Afterward, Han Xing would solve every puppet he encountered along the way.
After all, for him, these types of creatures were just a one-arrow matter.
Quickly, half a day passed.
And Han Xing arrived near the coordinates sent by Su Xiaoyang.
This place was also a city in ruins.
In the distance, there was a black mountain.
"Xiaoyang, I’m here. Where are you?" Han Xing sent a message asking.
A moment later, Su Xiaoyang replied.
"Brother Han Xing, I’m in the center area of this city."
"I’m fighting a mechanical monster bird, its defense is so strong...
Hearing this, Han Xing frowned slightly.
A mechanical monster bird?
To make Su Xiaoyang find it tricky, it must at least have legendary-level strength.
Moreover, it’s not an ordinary legendary creature.
At this moment.
A sudden explosion sound came from the city center far away.
"Boom!"
Han Xing instantly looked up.
In the distance, smoke and dust filled the air.
Han Xing knew that should be where Su Xiaoyang was fighting.
His figure flickered and he disappeared from where he was.
Heading directly towards the place where the explosion just happened.
Han Xing was extremely fast, and everywhere he passed by on the way, there were bursts of explosions.
He hadn’t even approached.
He saw a huge shadow in the sky.
It truly was a mechanical giant bird.
Its size exceeded a kilometer, and with each flap of its wings, a violent wind was stirred up.
Furthermore, the bird’s blood-red eyes were emitting laser beams.
The beams hit an object and triggered an incredible explosion.
"Boom boom boom!"
Black smoke rose in clouds.
Meanwhile.
Han Xing saw.
A nimble silhouette.
Dashing through the city’s ruins.
Occasionally flying into the sky to shoot an arrow at the monster bird.
That figure was Su Xiaoyang, crowned with a sacred halo.
So far.
The monster bird already had hundreds of arrows, exuding a green aura, embedded in it.
Meanwhile, Su Xiaoyang herself showed no signs of injury.
Both being hunters.
Su Xiaoyang’s combat style was completely different from Han Xing’s.
Compared to Han Xing’s violent one-hit kills.
Su Xiaoyang was more inclined to use a dense attack rhythm to suppress the enemy.
Of course, ultimately.
It’s because her attack power wasn’t as high as Han Xing’s.
This monster bird possessed high-tier legendary combat strength.
Su Xiaoyang achieving this extent was already quite remarkable.
After all, not every hunter boasted Han Xing’s terrifying attack power.
At this time.
Han Xing suddenly pulled back his bowstring and shot an arrow.
"Whoosh!"
It hit the monster bird’s abdomen with precision.
The monster bird, suddenly attacked, instinctively locked its gaze there.
Instantly it locked on Han Xing standing not far away.
The monster bird, with its blood-red eyes, was about to emit laser beams.
In the next moment.
A violent explosion sound suddenly erupted from its abdomen.
The explosive effect of Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill appeared.
"Boom!"
"Screech!"
The mechanical monster bird opened its long beak and roared toward the sky.
Its metal-composed abdomen was instantly blown out into a massive cavity!
At the moment of seeing the explosion.
Su Xiaoyang realized something.
She looked afar, then happily shouted, "Brother Han Xing!"
Han Xing nodded and gave a smile.
At this moment.
The monster bird seemed to be thoroughly enraged.
It spread its wings, emitting a mechanical synthesized voice.
"Screech!"
In the next moment.
A dense swarm of metal feathers shot towards the two at high speed!
"Whoosh! Whoosh whoosh whoosh!"
The sound of them piercing through the air was incessant.
Han Xing glanced at the sky.
He instantly locked onto the chest location of this monster bird.
A pale blue halo was emanating from it.
In the next moment, an arrow sped toward it even more fearsomely.
"Whoosh!"
"Boom!"
After the explosion sound.
The chest of the mechanical monster bird was blasted with a large hole.
Its attack ceased abruptly.
Those two blood-red eyes still locked onto Han Xing, seemingly revealing disbelief.
It couldn’t believe that with its high-tier legendary strength.
It could be one-shotted by this human.
A plume of black smoke billowed from its body.
Like a crashing airplane, it staggered downwards.
[Successfully killed a mechanical winged bird: high-tier legendary creature, gained experience value 2.743 billion, gained relic energy value 500...]

chapters.title: Chapter 605 - 370: Rendezvous, Opportunities in the Apocalyptic World
paragraphs: [Successfully killed Mechanical Winged Bird: High-tier Legendary Creature, gained 2.743 billion experience points, gained 500 relic energy points...]
Han Xing took down the monster with an arrow.
For monsters with clear weaknesses like this, as long as you can explode its energy core.
Even with high-tier legendary combat power, it’s just a matter of one arrow.
The rewards from the high-tier legendary bird are quite generous.
Apart from a huge amount of experience points, there’s also a whopping 500 relic energy points!
So far, Han Xing doesn’t know what these energy points are used for.
At this time, Su Xiaoyang gracefully descended from the sky after seeing Han Xing finish the battle.
She spoke in a shy tone, softly saying, "Brother Han Xing... you’re here!"
Han Xing nodded, then asked, "How is it, are you hurt?"
"No... no."
Su Xiaoyang quickly shook her head, then softly said, "Tha... thank you, Brother Han Xing."
Han Xing turned around and smiled, "Thank me for what, without me, you could have solved the battle just the same."
"Don’t forget, you’re part of my team."
"In the Holy Spirit Realm, you’re a once-in-a-millennium genius, more powerful than those Divine Sons and Daughters."
"Mm-hmm!" Su Xiaoyang nodded emphatically.
After speaking.
Han Xing then led Su Xiaoyang to the corpse of the Mechanical Winged Bird.
Then, he directly clicked ’disassemble’.

[Successfully disassembled Mechanical Winged Bird, obtained Secret Silver Ingot, Permanent Gold Ingot... obtained Insect Emperor Stone*532, obtained Calamity Divine Gold*13, obtained damaged Energy Core (High-tier Legendary) *1]
Joy appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
Truly deserving of a high-tier legendary mechanical monster.
With 13 pieces of Calamity Divine Gold, it’s enough to craft a Spiritual Godslaying Cannon!
With a few more high-tier legendaries, Han Xing could even gather materials for a catastrophe-level defense tower!
This place is truly a treasure trove!
If possible, Han Xing really wants to spend more time farming here.
With his combat efficiency.
In less than a day, he could collect a large amount of Insect Emperor Stones and Calamity Divine Gold.
But soon, Han Xing put this thought aside.
The urgent task now is to merge with his companions first.
Shen Yun and Zhang Lianmeng are still waiting for him.
Thinking of this, Han Xing said to Su Xiaoyang, "Let’s go, Xiaoyang, let’s find Lian Meng."
Su Xiaoyang nodded silently, following behind Han Xing.
The two figures began to travel quickly in this apocalyptic world.
Their movement speed was extremely fast.
Along the way, they triggered the awakening of various mechanical monsters, which came to attack them.
However, often with a loud bang,
These monsters would fall to the ground.
With Han Xing’s current power.
Even without using Divine Power, he has the ability to fight across levels.
These high-tier legendary mechanical monsters, which could be regional tyrants outside,
are no match for Han Xing and can be killed with a single arrow.
Then, they all turn into heaps of Insect Emperor Stones and Calamity Divine Gold, entering Han Xing’s backpack.
After several hours of travel.
Shen Yun sent a message over.
"Brother Xing, we’ve already merged, when can you get over here?"
Han Xing glanced at his current coordinates.
There’s about 120,000 kilometers to Shen Yun and the others.
With Han Xing’s speed, it would take about six or seven hours to get there.
No choice, without using Divine Power, their movement speed is too slow.
And, if it were Su Xiaoyang, the speed would be even slower.
After all, her Agility Attribute is high too,
But with Han Xing’s Witch Race Saint Master title, it’s nearly twice hers.
After advancing for an hour.
Han Xing found that they had moved less than 5,000 kilometers.
That’s because theoretical movement speed is one thing.
Actual movement speed is another.
On the way, they would encounter obstacles from various terrains.
Mountains, lakes, monsters, etc.
They also had to stop to deal with battles on the road.
At this rate, it might take them 24 hours to reach Shen Yun and the others.
Seeing Han Xing gradually slow down.
Behind him, Su Xiaoyang, who had been gritting her teeth to keep up,
said somewhat guiltily at this moment, "Sorry... Brother Han Xing..."
"It’s my slow speed that’s dragging you down."
Han Xing shook his head and said, "It’s okay, this speed is already very fast."
"It won’t make much difference in a few hours."
However, Su Xiaoyang still felt very guilty.
She bit her lip lightly, seemingly making some kind of decision.
"Brother Han Xing, you should go meet Sister Lian Meng first..."
"I’ll catch up at the back slowly, it’s okay."
However, Han Xing looked at her and showed a comforting smile.
"Xiaoyang, what are you talking about? If I’d planned to go get Lian Meng first, I wouldn’t have come to you."
"Our goal is to merge as soon as possible, leaving you behind would defeat the purpose, wouldn’t it?"
"But... that way I’ll hold you back."
Su Xiaoyang said apologetically.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing seemed to think of something.
He suddenly said, "No problem, I have a way."
Su Xiaoyang looked up, puzzled.
At this time, Han Xing crouched slightly, tapped his back and said, "I’ll carry you and run."
Su Xiaoyang: "???"
She looked at Han Xing with a face full of question marks, as if wondering how he came up with this method.
However, Han Xing explained, "With my Witch Race Saint Master title bonus, I have more than double your strength."
"As it stands, even Cheng Jianyong’s Strength Attribute isn’t higher than mine."
"Carrying you doesn’t affect my movement at all."
"This way, you won’t slow me down."
Su Xiaoyang seemed somewhat convinced and tentatively asked, "Re... really?"

chapters.title: Chapter 606 - 370: Reunion, Opportunities in the Apocalypse World
paragraphs: Han Xing nodded, "Really, come over quickly."
Upon hearing this, Su Xiaoyang instinctively moved her steps, approaching Han Xing.
She didn’t know why.
Suddenly she had a strange feeling.
A feeling that couldn’t be described.
Both shy and somewhat expectant.
Her fair face was now so flushed it looked like water could be pinched out of it.
Even though it was only a few meters.
Still, Su Xiaoyang felt as if she were living through years.
Each step closer weakened her defenses.
Finally, she stopped less than ten centimeters from Han Xing’s side.
Han Xing could even feel her slightly trembling body.
Knowing the nature of this girl, Han Xing softly said, "Xiaoyang, relax a bit."
He slightly crouched down, "Reach out your hands."
At this moment.
Su Xiaoyang almost subconsciously followed Han Xing’s instruction.
She extended her arms past Han Xing’s shoulders.
Then, directly pressed against this man’s back.
Feeling Han Xing’s presence, Su Xiaoyang’s mind went blank.
Her consciousness was on the verge of fading.
Before she could respond.
The man’s voice came again.
"Hold on tight to me."
Su Xiaoyang instinctively gripped with both hands.
Then.
She felt her thighs being lifted by two strong hands, suspending her in mid-air.
At that moment.
Su Xiaoyang’s entire body tensed.
She dared not make a sound.
Feeling the soft yet tense body on his back.
Han Xing knew she was very nervous.
He said no more.
He carried Su Xiaoyang and started sprinting wildly.
Whoosh—
Whoosh—
The scenery around them quickly receded.
Han Xing sped like an arrow shot from a bow.
Whenever monsters appeared on the way.
Han Xing would leap high.
Then free his hands, pull back his bow, and shoot an arrow.
"Whizz!"
With one arrow, a sky-shattering explosion ensued!
All monsters along the way were instantly killed by his shot!
As a result, their movement speed skyrocketed.
In merely an hour.
They had advanced over ten thousand kilometers.
Getting closer to Shen Yun and the others’ location.
At this time, Su Xiaoyang, clinging to Han Xing’s back.
Had gradually dispelled her inner tension after long adaptation.
Occasionally, she would sneak glances at Han Xing’s profile with her peripheral vision.
Her body muscles were no longer tense.
She even felt somewhat relaxed.
Her fair, slender legs swayed freely in the air.
Like exquisite jade.
Beautiful enough to hold one’s gaze.
This was when Han Xing noticed.
Su Xiaoyang’s legs were really long.
Such perfect proportions were something Han Xing had rarely seen in his life.
As Su Xiaoyang’s muscles relaxed.
Han Xing felt he was carrying a soft mass like cotton.
Light and fragrant.
The atmosphere at this moment was somewhat subtle.
Su Xiaoyang, with a dreamy look, gazed at Han Xing’s profile.
As she watched, she fell asleep.
Feeling the gentle breathing from the beauty on his back.
Han Xing didn’t wake her.
Hours later.
Han Xing had traveled over seventy thousand kilometers.
In her sleep, Su Xiaoyang heard a familiar voice.
"Xiaoyang, we’re almost there."
Hearing this, Su Xiaoyang drowsily opened her eyes.
When she realized it, there were only a few dozen kilometers remaining to Shen Yun and the others’ coordinates.
At this moment.
Su Xiaoyang realized she was still on Han Xing’s back.
However, Han Xing seemed to forget to let her down and continued advancing rapidly towards the destination.
Su Xiaoyang dared not break free.
After some inner struggle.
Su Xiaoyang whispered, "Han... Brother Xing, let me down."
Han Xing turned his head, puzzled, "What’s wrong? We’re almost there."
Su Xiaoyang softly said, "I, I feel a bit embarrassed..."
Han Xing was stunned for a moment.
Seemingly understanding something.
He smiled slightly.
Then he set Su Xiaoyang down from his back.
The moment she landed.
Su Xiaoyang felt her legs go weak.
She also felt a bit empty inside.
Thinking that she had fallen asleep on Han Xing’s back, she felt waves of shyness.
A few minutes later.
Han Xing then spotted Shen Yun and the others in the distance.
At this moment, the three of them had already regrouped.
Shen Yun was waving his hand, greeting him.
As Han Xing got closer.
He heard Cheng Jianyong say with a smile, "Brother Xing, your speed is really fast!"
"In just a few hours, you crossed over eighty thousand kilometers."
"During the same period, we only advanced over thirty thousand kilometers."
Han Xing smiled.
Cheng Jianyong, at this moment, also noticed Su Xiaoyang behind Han Xing.
He asked, "Little Sister Yang, did anything happen on the way?"
"We encountered quite a few monster attacks along our journey."
However, Su Xiaoyang appeared to be lost in thought, her head hanging low.
She didn’t even hear Cheng Jianyong call her.
Moments later, she seemed to snap out of it, and softly replied, "No... no danger was encountered."
"Those monsters were all dealt with by Brother Xing."
Cheng Jianyong nodded, "Indeed, with Brother Xing around, hardly any danger was encountered."
At this time, Zhang Lianmeng also noticed something off about Su Xiaoyang.
Her gaze wandered over the two of them, seemingly understanding something.
However, not only did she have no other thoughts.
Instead, she grinned inexplicably.
Zhang Lianmeng skillfully grabbed Su Xiaoyang’s little hand, swiftly pulling her to her side.
Han Xing observed the surrounding scenery and said, "Alright, now that we’ve regrouped."
"The next step is to focus on exploring the Ancient Ruins."

She didn’t know why.

A feeling that couldn’t be described.

Even though it was only a few meters.
Still, Su Xiaoyang felt as if she were living through years.

Finally, she stopped less than ten centimeters from Han Xing’s side.

He slightly crouched down, "Reach out your hands."

Su Xiaoyang almost subconsciously followed Han Xing’s instruction.
She extended her arms past Han Xing’s shoulders.
Then, directly pressed against this man’s back.
Feeling Han Xing’s presence, Su Xiaoyang’s mind went blank.
Her consciousness was on the verge of fading.

The man’s voice came again.
"Hold on tight to me."
Su Xiaoyang instinctively gripped with both hands.
Then.

At that moment.
Su Xiaoyang’s entire body tensed.
She dared not make a sound.

chapters.title: Chapter 607 - 370: Reunion, Opportunities in the Apocalypse World
paragraphs: "First, let’s exchange the information each of us has collected."
"That is, share what you’ve discovered in this world."
Everyone nodded.
Han Xing was the first to mention that the corpses of those monsters could be dismantled, yielding a significant amount of valuable materials.
Cheng Jianyong was momentarily stunned upon hearing this.
"Damn! We’ve taken down at least three legendary-level mechanical monsters along the way!"
"I thought they were just heaps of iron, didn’t even consider dismantling them, damn it, this is a huge loss!"
Cheng Jianyong appeared to be deeply regretful and remorseful.
Both Shen Yun and Zhang Lianmeng showed a bit of regret on their faces.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "It’s alright, just remember to dismantle the monsters we kill next time."
"Now, let’s hear your discoveries."
After a moment of contemplation, Shen Yun spoke.
"Brother Xing, when we passed by an inverted triangular mountain, we heard a mechanical broadcast."
"It said it detected a target approaching ancient ruins number 13 and was checking the opening conditions."
"Then it said we didn’t have enough relic energy points, and the opening failed..."
Han Xing pondered, "Ancient ruins number 13? Relic energy points?"
"So, the energy points obtained from killing those monsters are used to open the ruins?"
Everyone nodded.
Han Xing continued to ask, "How many energy points do you all have now?"
Cheng Jianyong replied first, "I have 120, Shen Yun has 50, Sister Lian Meng has 200."
"These mechanical monsters drop relic energy points."
"But I found that only the one who delivers the final blow gets the energy points."
Han Xing nodded.
Because he was the one who killed all the monsters along the way.
His relic energy points had already surpassed 1000.
While Su Xiaoyang had only a few dozen points.
Shen Yun supplemented, "I feel these ruins must be the places of fortune of this area."
"It seems, we need to kill more monsters and then explore these ruins."
Han Xing nodded again.
"Alright, the next target is to start killing the mechanical monsters in this world to collect energy points."
"Then go open the ruins!"
Everyone agreed wholeheartedly with Han Xing’s decision.
Having a target, everyone became more motivated.
They began actively seeking places in the ruins where mechanical monsters might be present.
Upon encountering them, they would bombard them with skills.
"Boom!"
"Whoosh! Whoosh whoosh!"
Large fireballs and dragon-hunting arrows continually caused terrifying explosive damage.
After beating the monsters to a near-dead state.
Han Xing and the others would stop.
Leaving the final blow to those with fewer energy points.
Shen Yun raised his shield with one hand, while his other hand held the holy hammer aloft.
Then he jumped high.
He aimed at the mechanical monster on the ground, already breathing its last.
Shouted, "Take my hammer!"
"Boom!"
A dull thud of metal striking resonated.
The energy device of the mechanical monster was directly smashed!
Then, Shen Yun stood arrogantly on the corpse of the mechanical monster, making a victory gesture.
Everyone rolled their eyes at him.
Ignoring his sudden display of adolescent bravado.
They hurried to the corpse of the mechanical monster, dismantling it into various metals and ores.
Thus, over and over.
Their energy value grew at an average pace.
The speed of collecting Insect Emperor Stones and Calamity Divine Gold in their backpacks also increased rapidly.
Because this was an unknown world.
There was no distinction between day and night.
The sky was continuously shrouded in black smoke and dust.
After 30 hours.
The group had already killed hundreds of monsters.
Not one below the five-star leader level.
The monsters here were all very powerful.
Similarly, their harvest was great.
Han Xing roughly calculated.
They accumulated over 40,000 Insect Emperor Stones and more than 150 pieces of Calamity Divine Gold.
Although, compared to the rate of material acquisition from the corpse of the beast, it was at a completely different level.
Nonetheless, everyone knew.
Such a celestial chance like the beast’s body was rare.
Moreover, their current collection speed was much faster than outside.
hours, the collected Calamity Divine Gold was enough to craft 15 Spiritual Godslaying Cannons, or 3 catastrophe-level defense towers.
Calculating this way.
Three months of exploration.
Their final cumulative harvest might not be far from that of the beast’s body.
Plus, there were mysterious ruins in this place waiting for them.
The harvest might be even greater.
Everyone became excited once again.
At this moment, Han Xing asked, "How many energy points do you have now?"
Upon hearing this, everyone reported a number.
Han Xing nodded, it was roughly as he expected.
Everyone had reached over 1200 relic energy points.
At this point, he spoke again, "Let’s stop farming monsters."
"Let’s go take a look at the number 13 ruins."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded.
Then.
The five of them swiftly headed towards the location of the number 13 ruins.
A dozen minutes later.
From afar, Han Xing saw a black, inverted triangular mountain.
The mountain appeared as though it had been cut out by lasers, its surface incredibly smooth.
The closer they got, the more they could feel the mountain’s enormity.
Rough estimates put it at least over a hundred thousand kilometers.
As the group approached.
This time, a synthetic mechanical sound emitted from the black inverted triangular mountain.
"Detecting life waves approaching ruins number 13, checking relic energy points on them..."
"Check complete, target: 5 individuals, relic energy points all exceed 1000, meeting relic opening conditions..."
The synthetic voice paused for a moment.
Then it spoke again.
"Do you wish to consume 1000 relic energy points to open ruins number 13?"
Everyone exchanged looks.
Then, Han Xing directly replied, "Yes."
The next moment.
A red laser swept over everyone.

chapters.title: Chapter 608 - 371: Ruins, Unlocking the Hidden Map
paragraphs: After the red light scanned over everyone.
Han Xing noticed that their relic energy points decreased by 1000 points.
"Successfully activated... Please enter the relic interior through the teleportation gate."
When the synthetic voice ended.
Han Xing saw it.
At the base of the inverted triangular mountain.
At the tip area, a door appeared as if it were an illusion, resembling a void.
Without hesitation.
Han Xing was the first to step into the black, wavelike door.
Just as he stepped in.
The vision before him suddenly became clear.
In front of Han Xing.
Appeared a massive laboratory.
In the center was a spacious open area.
Beside it were all kinds of instruments.
However, these instruments had been covered in dust for a long time.
They seemed to have lost their function.
The map indicated.
This was the 173rd floor of relic number 13.
Han Xing took a look around and said, "Let’s split up and explore, see if we can find anything."
Upon hearing this.
Everyone began searching around the spacious laboratory.
Han Xing noticed.
In the corners of the laboratory were transparent containers.
But, these containers had been broken.
The things inside seemed to have escaped.
Han Xing just sensed something amiss.
In the darkness.
A black shadow suddenly lunged at Han Xing.
Han Xing didn’t even have time to see clearly what the thing looked like.
He only vaguely saw that it had a cockroach-like head, with two long antennae on top.
In the next moment.
Han Xing shot an arrow directly.
"Boom!"
A violent explosion sounded.
The monster’s body exploded instantly.
Green and white liquid splattered everywhere.
As the monster’s body exploded, Han Xing backed away.
So, the liquid didn’t splash onto Han Xing.
At the same time.
Shen Yun and the others heard the explosion and rushed over immediately.
They asked with a worried tone.
"Brother Xing! What happened?"
"Did you encounter any danger? Do you need support?"
Han Xing said, "I’m fine, there are some unusual monsters in this laboratory, be careful."
After hearing this, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Though they knew, with Han Xing’s strength, it was unlikely he’d encounter danger.
However, Han Xing’s last sentence.
’Unusual monsters’ made everyone vigilant.
At the same time.
Han Xing glanced at the system prompt.
[Successfully killed mutated creature: Five-star Elite Level, gained experience value of 43.87 million...]
"Mutated creature... What is this?"
Han Xing pondered slightly.
At this moment.
Not far away, explosions were also heard one after another.
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong also encountered such monsters.
Fortunately though, the strength was about the same.
Only Five-star Elite to Leader Level strength.
They could all easily take them out.
After clearing all the monsters on this level.
Everyone regrouped.
They shook their heads.
Apart from those monsters.
They didn’t find anything else.
At this moment.
Shen Yun suddenly noticed something, pointing to a corner and said, "Brother Xing, see if there’s a new passage over there?"
Upon hearing this, everyone looked over immediately.
Indeed, they found a new passage on the previously flat ground.
It seemed to lead to the next floor of the laboratory.
At this moment, Han Xing seemed to understand something.
"I see, we entered from the lowest teleportation gate and got directly transported to the top floor of this inverted triangular laboratory."
"Now, we need to explore step by step downward."
Upon hearing this, everyone also felt Han Xing’s speculation made sense.
After finishing,
Han Xing was the first to step into the passage.
Following the stairs.
They quickly reached the second-lowest floor of the laboratory.
The map position also changed to [13th relic, 172nd floor...]
Here, everyone continued rummaging around.
Relentlessly searching every corner.
After dealing with the ugly mutated monsters down below.
Cheng Jianyong held a few bottles of potions and walked over.
"Brother Xing, take a look at this."
Han Xing took the milky white potion from Cheng Jianyong’s hand.
His expression was somewhat puzzled.
And when he saw the potion’s attributes, his pupils shrank instantly.

[Genetic Enhancement Potion (Experimental Version)]: After consumption, has a 50% probability of increasing 1000 points in four-dimensional attributes, a 30% probability of mutation, a 10% probability of exploding.
[Remaining usage times]: 10 times.
Note: The experiment has reached its final stage, we need more samples, the hope of saving the world lies in our hands - Dr. Clayton.
After looking at the attributes of this stuff, then glancing at the monster bodies.
Everyone’s expression was a bit strange.
Could it be that they turned into these monsters after consuming this potion?
Thinking about it, it should be true.
After all, even though there’s only a 30% chance of mutation.
But keep in mind, they definitely wouldn’t consume it just once.
Even if they were lucky the first time, not mutating or exploding.
What about the second time, the third time.
So.
This potion is a big trap.
If you’re confident in your luck, taking it once or twice might be okay.
Any more than that, it’s courting death.
Han Xing disinterestedly put these potions into his bag.
To see if there’s a chance to use them in the future.
At the same time.
After exploring this layer thoroughly.
A passage appeared once more.
They exchanged glances.
Then headed straight to the next layer.
After passing through dozens of layers in succession.
Han Xing realized they seemed to have reached the middle of this inverted triangular structure.
The five of them gathered together.
Consolidated the harvest in their hands.
Apart from dozens of incomplete genetic potions, there were some damaged weapons and experimental data.

The five of them gathered together.
Consolidated the harvest in their hands.
Apart from dozens of incomplete genetic potions, there were some damaged weapons and experimental data.

chapters.title: Chapter 609 - 371: Ruins, Unlocking the Hidden Map_2
paragraphs: These things are of no use to Han Xing and his companions.
However, if taken outside, they could probably be sold for quite a bit of money.
After all, the Holy Spirit Realm is a world of magic and sword Qi.
The technological weapons here allow ordinary people to possess the power to face formidable monsters.
Just like when Han Xing held the Molten Gold Cannon.
At this moment, Han Xing saw the prompt on the small map.
[Ruins No. 13, Floor 64...]
Upon reaching this floor.
The monsters inside were no longer those mutants.
But various mechanical puppets.
However, most of them were not very strong.
After defeating the puppet monsters.
The group continued to delve deeper.
All the way to the bottom of the roughly inverted triangular structure.
The space here also became slightly narrower.
The map indicated.
They had already reached [Ruins No. 13, Floor 14...]
At this time, the cold synthetic mechanical voice reappeared.
"Challengers detected, having reached the target floor, the ruin’s guardian monster is being activated..."
Upon hearing this voice, a look of realization appeared on everyone’s faces.
"Is the floor boss finally about to appear?" Cheng Jianyong said expectantly.
At this moment.
The ground began to quake wildly.
In a shadowy corner of the laboratory, something seemed to be moving.
Then came the sound of metal scraping against the ground.
"Clang clang clang..."
The visibility here was very low.
It seemed to be deliberately creating a terrifying atmosphere.
However, with the legendary level vision of everyone present, light or no light, it made little difference.
They could see clearly, in the dark corner, just what it was.
It was a giant python, seemingly made of metal.
Over three hundred meters long, its body rivaled the size of an ancient towering tree.
The moment it detected Han Xing and the others.
The mechanical snake suddenly raised its massive head.
Then opened its large black metal mouth, revealing a black tongue.
"Hiss! Hiss hiss!"
Then, a black energy beam shot down!
However.
Han Xing and the others were quite speechless.
Such a grand display for just a high-tier legendary monster.
To the uninformed, it could easily be mistaken for a demigod.
Shen Yun casually raised the Giant Beast Shield.
And completely withstood the energy beam from the mechanical python.
Moreover.
Shen Yun even advanced under the pressure of that energy beam.
In the stunned eyes of the mechanical python.
It saw all four raise their weapons.
"Swish! Swish swish!"
Striking down with waves of sword Qi.
As well as large fireballs exploding fiercely!
Illuminating the dark laboratory completely.
Under the combined assault of the group.
In less than ten seconds.
The energy core on the head of the mechanical giant python was utterly destroyed.
A voice broadcast emerged.
"Successfully defeated the guardian monster of Ruins No. 13: Black Flame Python."
"Please proceed to the loot room to claim your reward."
"Uh, is it over just like that?"
"That was way too quick!" Cheng Jianyong said, full of confusion.
Shen Yun smiled, "Of course, with Brother Xing here, as long as it’s not a demigod, nothing can really stir up trouble."
"However, the challenge level of this ruin still presents some difficulty."
"After all, it’s a high-tier legend. Without using our divine power, it would take quite some time to resolve the fight."
"Even those divine sons and daughters might face a tough battle."
Cheng Jianyong nodded in realization.
He then asked in confusion, "Where is this loot room mentioned in the voice broadcast?"
The group scanned the hall and found a door in the corner.
Han Xing’s eyes lit up, "Let’s go over there.
The five of them filed through the door.
Inside was a relatively narrower room.
In the center of the room, there was a black box placed.
Without hesitation, Han Xing chose to open it.
At the bottom of the box lay some familiar metals and stones.
As well as a few bottles of milky white potions and a blueprint.
Han Xing collected them all.
The system prompt appeared.
[Obtained Insect Emperor Stone *1000, Shimmering Terra Stone *1000, Calamity Divine Gold *50, Genetic Enhancement Potion (Improved) *5, Ancient Weapon: Black Flame Python Blueprint *1...]
Hearing the last system prompt, Han Xing felt a surge of joy in his heart.

[Genetic Enhancement Potion (Improved)]: After consumption, has a 70% chance to increase four-dimensional attributes by 1000 points, a 20% chance to mutate, no risk of body explosion (5 uses remaining).
This item, worthy of being improved.
Not only does the probability of attribute increase greatly improve, but there’s also no risk of body explosion.
However, it’s still somewhat unstable.
Han Xing still didn’t want to try it.
At this point, he looked at the last blueprint.
[Ancient Weapon Blueprint: Black Flame Python]: Through the blueprint, create a Black Flame Python with high-tier legendary combat power to assist in battle.

[Materials needed to create the Black Flame Python]: Spiritual Core (High-tier Legendary Level) *1, Insect Emperor Stone *50,000, Shimmering Terra Stone *10,000, Calamity Divine Gold *20, Mithril, Permanent Gold Ingot, Spirit Core...
After reviewing the introduction of the blueprint.
Han Xing pondered for a moment.
The implication is, as long as there are enough materials.
He can use this blueprint to mass-produce mechanical monsters with high-tier legendary combat power, right?
This is indeed good.
Although for Han Xing, high-tier legendary combat power is already somewhat lacking.
But in the Holy Spirit Realm.
It is still top-tier combat power.
If he could create a few more.
Han Xing’s faction power would experience a significant boost.
Propelling it to become one of the behemoth forces in the Holy Spirit Realm.
However, the consumption of Calamity Divine Gold surpasses even that of a Spiritual Godslaying Cannon.
Bear in mind, a Spiritual Godslaying Cannon can inflict damage upon demigod-level creatures.

chapters.title: Chapter 610 - 371: Ruins, Unlocking the Hidden Map_3
paragraphs: However, the Black Flame Python has an advantage.
It can move.
As for whether it’s a loss or gain, that’s subjective.
At this moment, Shen Yun pondered, "So those ancient weapon blueprints from the Dwarf Race originated like this."
Everyone suddenly nodded in understanding.
"Brother Xing, now that we’ve defeated the final BOSS, can we leave?" Cheng Jianyong asked.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, let’s go."
After he spoke.
He led everyone out of the loot room.
And at the spot where the Black Flame Python died, a purple teleportation gate appeared.
A voice broadcast came on.
"This relic challenge is complete, challengers please exit 13th relic through the teleportation gate..."
Just as everyone was about to step into the teleportation gate.
Han Xing suddenly noticed.
The position displayed on the mini-map.
[13th Relic 14th Floor...]
Han Xing instantly stopped.
"Wait a minute."
Hearing his voice, everyone turned back to look.
"What’s wrong, Brother Xing?" Cheng Jianyong asked puzzledly.
Han Xing said, "When we were outside earlier, we saw the appearance of this relic."
"It looks like an inverted triangle."
"This relic clearly has several more layers below."
"Why does it end here?"
Everyone realized something at that moment.
"Brother Xing, you mean there are more layers below we can explore?" Cheng Jianyong asked.
Han Xing nodded, "It’s very possible."
Everyone scanned the surroundings.
"But, hasn’t there always been a passage to the next floor before?"
"There’s no passage here, though?" Shen Yun puzzled.
Han Xing said, "There isn’t."
"Let’s not leave yet, let’s search this floor first."
The team members nodded in agreement.
Then, they split up and began exploring.
A few dozen minutes later.
The 14th floor was almost thoroughly explored by them.
But, they still didn’t find the passage.
At this moment, Shen Yun suddenly said, "Brother Xing, there’s something here, come take a look."
Everyone gathered towards Shen Yun’s location.
Here.
In a corner of the 14th floor.
A broken machine appeared in front of them.
Cheng Jianyong curiously asked, "Xiaoyunzi, isn’t this just a broken machine? What’s the issue?"
Shen Yun pointed, "Look below."
Everyone focused their gaze on the ground.
Underneath the machine, there was a faint mark of an underground passage gate.
The team members’ eyes lit up instantly.
"Wow! The passage was hiding here all along!"
"Seems like someone deliberately placed a machine here to block it," Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Han Xing nodded.
Then.
He directly pushed with force.
The heavy machine was pushed aside.
In front of them appeared a strange array inscribed with mysterious writings.
At this moment.
An alarm sounded.
"Beep! Beep! Beep!"
"Challengers, please note, you have touched a forbidden area of the 13th relic, please stop attempting, leave the 13th relic immediately."
Listening to the alarm ringing in their ears.
Everyone’s expressions turned odd.
However, this also indirectly proved they found the right place!
At the same time, the attributes of the array appeared before them.
[Underground Passage Gate]: Defense Value 500,000, with an Advanced Divine Power Barrier.
"Advanced Divine Power Barrier, what is that?" Shen Yun asked puzzled.
However, Cheng Jianyong nonchalantly said, "Whatever it is, I’ll slash it with my sword and find out!"
With that said.
Cheng Jianyong slashed out a sword qi.
"Swoosh!"
However.
The sword qi landed on the gate, causing a burst of blue energy waves.
Moments later.
His sword qi dissipated without a trace.
As for the gate.
Not even a white scratch appeared.
The 500,000 Defense Value didn’t decrease at all.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong was dumbfounded.
"What the heck, not a single point off its Defense Value?"
"This thing, is so terrifying?"
Han Xing thought for a moment, analyzing, "It’s probably because of that Advanced Divine Power Barrier."
"If we don’t disable the barrier effect, we can’t damage the passage gate."
Everyone fell into deep thought after hearing this.
Within the ancient ruins.
Their divine power couldn’t be utilized.
And this Advanced Divine Power Barrier was clearly set by a Demigod, or even above Demigod Level presence.
With sheer force, there’s no hope of breaking it.
Shen Yun regretfully said, "Seems like the previous existence anticipated someone would be curious and explore the layers below."
"So they set up countermeasures in advance."
"Even the Dwarves probably haven’t explored here."
Han Xing nodded.
Just as everyone was about to give up.
Han Xing suddenly thought of something.
He remembered that the Giant Beast’s Spike he got had the [God-Breaking Spike] effect.
[God-Breaking Spike]: The tail spike contains strong laws of divine power, with the Absolute Forbidden Break effect, can pierce the divine power domain of Low-tier Divine Spirits and below.
Han Xing’s eyes lit up instantly.
Then, he directly took out the Giant Beast Tail Spike from his backpack.
In an instant.
A giant ’silver needle’ several hundred meters long appeared suddenly.
The moment this tail spike appeared.
Everyone felt a terrifying tearing sensation across their bodies!
For a moment, blood seeped from their pores.
Even Han Xing wasn’t much better off.
But he gritted his teeth, lifted the Giant Beast Tail Spike, and fiercely stabbed at the passage gate.
"Pop!"
With a sound like a bubble being popped.
Han Xing quickly put the Giant Beast Tail Spike back into his backpack.
The tearing sensation all over disappeared.
At this moment, the entire relic blared with a harsh alarm.
"Alarm! Alarm!"
"Your actions have seriously violated the taboos of the 13th relic, please stop immediately! Stop immediately!"

chapters.title: Chapter 611 - 372: Alien Race, Fire Seed Storage Room
paragraphs: Repercussion from the giant beast’s tail spike.
Han Xing stood in place, covered in blood, looking like a bloodied figure.
Yet in the next moment, a smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
Because he knew.
He succeeded!
The door of that passage, with just a light stab from him.
Not only was the Divine Power Barrier broken.
Even the 500,000 defense value was reduced to zero in an instant.
The door collapsed.
This means they can proceed to the next level!
At this moment.
Shen Yun hurriedly threw several Healing Techniques to everyone, restoring their injuries.
Then, with an excited look, headed to the next level of the passage.
[You have entered Hidden Area 13 of the ruins, Level 13...]
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise, "We really opened the hidden map, as expected of Brother Xing!"
The others also had smiles on their faces.
As players on Blue Star, proficient in most game strategies available in the market.
They knew that hidden maps often contain some precious rewards.
And possibly, unique rewards.
Thinking of this, everyone’s eyes became more expectant.
The lighting here is darker than above.
However, as Shen Yun tossed out a Holy Light Ball, everyone gradually saw the surrounding scene clearly.
This place is no longer a laboratory.
It looks more like a human experimentation site.
In the rows of containers at the front, there were creatures with cockroach heads.
They didn’t seem dead.
But rather, in a deep sleep.
"These... aren’t they the indigenous species of this world?" Cheng Jianyong asked incredulously.
Han Xing pondered for a moment and shook his head.
He wasn’t sure either.
At this time, a large brain screen lit up in front of everyone.
A projection appeared on it.
A male cockroach creature with a cockroach head, dressed in military officer uniform, was talking to a female cockroach creature.
The female cockroach creature, wearing a laboratory coat, had a curvaceous figure.
However, her cockroach head spoiled the beauty of her figure.
"Dr. Kentri, these are the last fire seeds of our race."
"They are all carefully selected, strong-bodied clan members."
"Underneath each laboratory, there is a Fire Seed Storage Room of our race."
"These are the most important areas and must not be lost."
At this moment, the female cockroach creature in a laboratory coat sighed and said, "General Mobai, disaster is drawing closer and closer to us."
"I don’t know if the ruins, built with 90% of our race’s resources, can withstand this catastrophe."
"And I don’t know if these fire seeds can be preserved..."
The cockroach general in officer uniform resolutely said, "We certainly can!"
"There is always a way in heaven, even if the race’s extinction is a foregone conclusion."
"We will try everything to change this outcome!"
The female cockroach raised her head and looked at him curiously.
"General Mobai, you mean..."
The male cockroach officer said excitedly: "Yes, we have found the hope to survive!"
"In the Void, we found a world with an extremely high energy level and a very rich life aura."
"And we have already established a teleportation anchor point in this world."
"As long as we can survive this natural disaster."
"Relying on our clan’s strong reproductive ability, it would only take a year or two to restore the peak scale of the race..."
A moment later, the female cockroach nodded excitedly and then turned away.
After watching this scene.
Everyone looked at each other.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong seemed to realize something and said in surprise.
"Damn, the high energy level world they mentioned, isn’t it the Holy Spirit Realm?"
"These cockroach creatures want to hide using the ruins and then take the opportunity to invade the Holy Spirit Realm?"
Everyone gulped.
Without a doubt.
Cheng Jianyong’s speculation was likely correct.
At this time.
Shen Yun suddenly said seriously, "Brother Xing, should we exterminate the monsters inside here?"
"According to the projection, this race’s reproductive ability seems quite abnormal."
"If they really invade the Holy Spirit Realm, it won’t take long before a new race rises?"
Han Xing thought for a moment and shook his head, "No need."
"This race is just trying to survive and hasn’t violated our interests yet."
"Moreover, strictly speaking, we are not from the Holy Spirit Realm either."
"If it’s about protecting the Holy Spirit Realm, it’s not our place to do it."
Everyone nodded, agreeing that Han Xing made a valid point.
However, the ultimate goal of these creatures is to invade the Holy Spirit Realm.
At this time.
We couldn’t help but sigh again.
The Holy Spirit Realm truly endures many calamities.
Han Xing ignored the scene here.
After a search.
Everyone continued on to the next level.
Since they descended from level 14.
The doors of the passages below no longer had the Divine Power Barrier.
For seven or eight consecutive levels, it was the same scene.
Rows of containers stored strange creatures.
Rough estimates suggested there were at least over 100,000 cockroach creatures in the jars.
According to what the previous projection said.
Although it’s uncertain how many such ruins exist in this world.
If each ruin below contains these creatures.
This number would certainly be staggering.
Then, they arrived at the fourth level of the ruins.
The space here became only over two thousand square meters large.
There was nothing else in the laboratory.
Only a huge container.
Tens of thousands of pipes connected to this container, seemingly supplying it with energy.

"These... aren’t they the indigenous species of this world?" Cheng Jianyong asked incredulously.
Han Xing pondered for a moment and shook his head.
He wasn’t sure either.
At this time, a large brain screen lit up in front of everyone.
A projection appeared on it.
A male cockroach creature with a cockroach head, dressed in military officer uniform, was talking to a female cockroach creature.
The female cockroach creature, wearing a laboratory coat, had a curvaceous figure.
However, her cockroach head spoiled the beauty of her figure.
"Dr.
Kentri, these are the last fire seeds of our race."
"They are all carefully selected, strong-bodied clan members."
"Underneath each laboratory, there is a Fire Seed Storage Room of our race."
"These are the most important areas and must not be lost."
At this moment, the female cockroach creature in a laboratory coat sighed and said, "General Mobai, disaster is drawing closer and closer to us."
"I don’t know if the ruins, built with 90% of our race’s resources, can withstand this catastrophe."
"And I don’t know if these fire seeds can be preserved..."
The cockroach general in officer uniform resolutely said, "We certainly can!"
"There is always a way in heaven, even if the race’s extinction is a foregone conclusion."
"We will try everything to change this outcome!"
The female cockroach raised her head and looked at him curiously.
"General Mobai, you mean..."
The male cockroach officer said excitedly: "Yes, we have found the hope to survive!"
"In the Void, we found a world with an extremely high energy level and a very rich life aura."
"And we have already established a teleportation anchor point in this world."
"As long as we can survive this natural disaster."
"Relying on our clan’s strong reproductive ability, it would only take a year or two to restore the peak scale of the race..."
A moment later, the female cockroach nodded excitedly and then turned away.
After watching this scene.
Everyone looked at each other.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong seemed to realize something and said in surprise.
"Damn, the high energy level world they mentioned, isn’t it the Holy Spirit Realm?"
"These cockroach creatures want to hide using the ruins and then take the opportunity to invade the Holy Spirit Realm?"
Everyone gulped.
Without a doubt.
Cheng Jianyong’s speculation was likely correct.
At this time.
Shen Yun suddenly said seriously, "Brother Xing, should we exterminate the monsters inside here?"
"According to the projection, this race’s reproductive ability seems quite abnormal."
"If they really invade the Holy Spirit Realm, it won’t take long before a new race rises?"
Han Xing thought for a moment and shook his head, "No need."
"This race is just trying to survive and hasn’t violated our interests yet."
"Moreover, strictly speaking, we are not from the Holy Spirit Realm either."
"If it’s about protecting the Holy Spirit Realm, it’s not our place to do it."
Everyone nodded, agreeing that Han Xing made a valid point.
However, the ultimate goal of these creatures is to invade the Holy Spirit Realm.
At this time.
We couldn’t help but sigh again.
The Holy Spirit Realm truly endures many calamities.
Han Xing ignored the scene here.
After a search.
Everyone continued on to the next level.
Since they descended from level 14.
The doors of the passages below no longer had the Divine Power Barrier.
For seven or eight consecutive levels, it was the same scene.
Rows of containers stored strange creatures.
Rough estimates suggested there were at least over 100,000 cockroach creatures in the jars.
According to what the previous projection said.
Although it’s uncertain how many such ruins exist in this world.
If each ruin below contains these creatures.
This number would certainly be staggering.
Then, they arrived at the fourth level of the ruins.
The space here became only over two thousand square meters large.
There was nothing else in the laboratory.
Only a huge container.
Tens of thousands of pipes connected to this container, seemingly supplying it with energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 612 - 372: Alien Race, Fire Seed Storage Room_2
paragraphs: Inside the container lay none other than that Cockroach Officer.
[Alien Race General Mobai: Initial-tier Demigod]
[Level]: Unknown
[Attributes]: Unknown
[Skills]: Unknown
Note: A very ancient race, they advocate the ascension of flesh and blood, using technology to push physical bodies to the extreme.
Seeing the attributes of this thing.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed directly, "Whoa, isn’t that Cockroach General?"
"It seems like this guy is still alive?"
Upon hearing this, everyone directed their gaze towards it.
At this moment, Shen Yun asked, "Brother Xing, should we take it down?"
"This Alien Race General seems quite strong."
Han Xing shook his head, "No need."
"Just like them, we are also foreign creatures."
"This time, we’re just here to see if there are any hidden treasures in the ruins."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
Just as Han Xing was about to find the passage to the next level.
Suddenly, the Cockroach General in the container opened its eyes.
Everyone immediately felt a terrifying insect-like gaze focused on them.
With the keen perception of Legendary Powerhouses, they immediately reacted.
They tightened their grip on their weapons.
Turning around, they saw that the massive container was covered in countless cracks.
"Is that Cockroach General trying to come out?" Shen Yun wondered.
Before they could react.
In the next moment.
The sound of glass shattering rang out.
"Crack! Crackle!"
Then.
"Boom!"
A loud explosion.
Dark yellow liquid flowed across the floor of the laboratory.
At this moment.
A tall creature, standing two meters high and clad in dark red armored uniform, jumped out from the container.
A pressure from the depths of life erupted from that creature!
"This monster has something,"
Shen Yun praised, "Without sensing any Divine Power fluctuation on it, just with its physical body, it gives us the threat only a Demigod Level can!"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, the introduction mentioned that this race has developed their physical bodies to the extreme."
"Perhaps, this is their achievement."
Cheng Jianyong assumed a defensive state, "Brother Xing, is this guy planning to attack us?"
Han Xing shook his head, "I don’t know, let’s wait and see."
At this moment.
The Cockroach General looked at everyone, discovering that they were mere ants with only Legendary Level strength.
Faced with its oppressive aura, not only were they unafraid, but they also chatted calmly.
Instantly, its terrifyingly grotesque features twisted together.
The Cockroach General opened its chrysanthemum-like mouth, emitting an extremely unpleasant screeching sound.
It sounded just like the call of an insect.
After being translated by the system, everyone understood what it was saying.
"Who are you people? How did you come to the relic’s Fire Seed Storage Room?"
"Speak clearly, quickly!
The opposing insect-like mouthparts opened and closed, appearing exceptionally terrifying.
Scaring Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang quite a bit.
Han Xing pointed upwards, "Clearly, we came down from above."
Upon hearing this, the Cockroach General’s eyes immediately showed a shocked expression.
"Did you break the Original Force restriction above?"
Its face turned extremely unsightly: "Damn it!"
Han Xing shrugged.
Neither confirming nor denying.
The Original Force restriction it mentioned should be the Divine Power Barrier Han Xing and the others encountered.
The Cockroach General assumed a battle stance, shouting, "Breaking the relic’s Original Force restriction, that’s something only an Insect Emperor can do!"
"What are you people intending to do?"
"What about the fire seeds preserved by our race?"
It appeared very flustered and nervous, throwing a multitude of questions at Han Xing and his team.
Han Xing shook his head, "No need to worry, we don’t intend to do anything, just came down to search for some loot."
"We haven’t opened any of those containers upstairs."
Upon hearing this, the Cockroach General breathed a sigh of relief.
In its eyes, regardless of what the motives of these aliens were.
As long as the fire seeds were unharmed, it was fine.
Moreover, in its senses, it indeed did not detect the death of its kin.
At this point, the Cockroach General examined Han Xing and his companions once again
and asked, "Aliens, which world do you strong ones come from?"
Han Xing replied speechlessly, "Haven’t you anchored that world long ago?"
"Why ask us which world we come from, knowing the answer?"
The Cockroach General nodded in sudden realization.
It seems, its guess was correct.
These few aliens, they come from the last anchor point of their Great World!
And this also means, they succeeded!
Successfully survived the apocalyptic disaster, and moved closer to that world.
Their race has hope for revival!
General Cockroach showed a gleam of delight in his eyes.
But he quickly hid this emotion.
However, the issue at hand is.
These aliens discovered their existence.
Furthermore, they seem to know their secret!
At that moment, a flash of murderous intent appeared in General Cockroach’s eyes.
The feeling of being watched by a terrifying creature arose once again.
Han Xing sighed, "I said, I don’t want to fight you."
"Once we finish searching the layers below, we will naturally leave."
"Don’t force us."
However, upon hearing this, the murderous intent in General Cockroach’s eyes became even stronger!
In its eyes, regardless of these aliens’ purpose.
But since they discovered their Fire Seed Storage Room.
Then, these aliens must die!
Moreover, judging by their aura, they are significantly weaker than itself!
At most, they only have Insect General level strength.
In its eyes, Han Xing and the others are mere ants to be crushed easily!
"Whatever words you have, say them once I capture you!"
"Just right, using your alien bodies to inject my race’s insect eggs."
"Achieving the first step to invade that Great World!"
These words caused everyone to shudder.
Damn, injecting insect eggs into their own bodies?
This is extremely disgusting!
However, Han Xing merely sighed upon hearing this.
"Why must you insist on courting death?"
The General Cockroach didn’t respond, his figure disappearing instantly.
Everyone felt as if they were being watched by a terrifying presence!
A sense of oppression originating from the level of life overwhelmed them.
At the same time.
The sound of wind rushed from above.
The target turned out to be Han Xing among the crowd.
The opponent seemed to know Han Xing was the leader of this group of aliens.
Rich battle experience made it decide to control Han Xing first!
Han Xing sensed the danger from above.
Yet he hadn’t made any moves.
A figure blocked in front of Han Xing.
Shield-bearer Shen Yun, raised his shield high.
Engaging in direct contact with this being possessing Demigod-level power!
Boom!
A dull impact sound reverberated!
As if a bomb had been thrown on the spot.
The entire laboratory was swept by a terrifying storm!
After the storm.
General Cockroach was instantly sent flying dozens of meters away.
His insect-like eyes filled with a look of dread.
Blocked it?
How is it possible?
General Cockroach’s face was full of disbelief.
In its eyes, these few aliens’ strength was perceived far inferior to itself.
Not even reaching the Insect King level of strength.
This was something that had never happened in their world.
Yet, shield-bearer Shen Yun indeed achieved it!
With his current defense, he could withstand attacks from even Middle-tier Legend.
Not to mention this cockroach monster!
And from the earlier probing, they already figured it out.
General Cockroach had at most Initial-tier Demigod strength.
"This is, the power belonging to that world?"
Excitement appeared in General Cockroach’s eyes.
"Truly formidable! If I could obtain this power, combined with my race’s technology!"
"Then, my race would truly become, the first transcendent race!"
At this moment.
General Cockroach vanished instantly from his spot.
However.
Han Xing had already lost his patience.
He waved his hand, issuing an order: "Resolve this."
"Don’t waste time anymore."
Everyone nodded immediately.
In an instant, endowed with two blessings from Shen Yun, everyone’s aura surged dramatically!
