chapters.title: Chapter 613 - 373: Looting the Trophy Room, Astonishing Gains!
paragraphs: Sensing the surge in Han Xing and the others’ aura.
General Cockroach’s pupils shrank instantly, exclaiming, "Insect King!"
Not waiting for it to react.
Zhang Lianmeng’s Ice Spear shot out instantly.
General Cockroach, in mid-air, sensed the terrifying destructive power of the strike, feeling even more astonished.
Another Insect King!
Not yet finishing its shock.
Seeing Su Xiaoyang’s Elf Longbow tremble in her hands.
In the next moment.
The originally narrow ruins level 4 was instantly filled with various vines.
At the moment General Cockroach was entangled by the vines.
A bad premonition appeared in its heart.
Simultaneously.
Han Xing’s Gale Arrow.
Cheng Jianyong’s Sword Qi, Zhang Lianmeng’s Large Fireball.
All crashed down.
At this moment.
A thought appeared in General Cockroach’s mind.
It’s over!
It’s not three Insect Kings but five of them with Insect King level power.
Moreover, each stronger than the last!
In the final moments of life.
General Cockroach opened its mouth,
"The power of the Great World is truly extraordinary."
"I lost..."
With those words.
All the attacks had struck its body.
"Boom! Boom boom!"
"Snap!"
After an explosion.
This General Cockroach with initial-tier demigod power was blasted by everyone on the spot!
The green and white liquid from its body sprayed over the entire fourth level of the laboratory.
At the last moment, Shen Yun raised a Holy Light Shield, blocking these liquids outside.
[Successfully killed Alien Race General: Mobei (Demigod Level), gained 8.724 billion Experience Value, no Divine Power Value absorbed...]
At this moment.
Cheng Jianyong looked at General Cockroach’s body turned into meat paste, showing a disgusted expression on his face.
"Such a monster, although possessing demigod-level power."
"Defeating it yields less than defeating a legend, and it doesn’t drop any materials."
"So poor."
Shen Yun laughed aside, "After all, it’s a purely flesh-body evolutionary type of monster, its cultivation system differs from ours."
"Not dropping items is normal."
Han Xing nodded in agreement.
"Don’t mind its corpse anymore, let’s continue exploring downwards."
Everyone began searching for the passage to the next level...
At the moment General Cockroach was blasted.
In this world.
All ancient ruins had a powerful aura awakened.
These auras contained intense anger, along with a hint of trepidation.
"Who killed General Mobei?"
"Damn! Is the Armageddon not over yet?"
"Quickly activate the system emergency procedures, the ruins must be preserved!"
Simultaneously.
The entire apocalyptic world, the black earth fell into turmoil!
Countless shattered mechanical parts, reassembled at a terrifying speed.
One after another, formidable mechanical monsters revived from the ground.
Han Xing and others, inside the ruins, hadn’t yet felt anything.
But this sudden change threw other races’ Divine Sons and Daughters instantly into dire straights.
At this moment.
Divine Son Wan Liu was casually dealing with a mechanical monster with middle-tier legendary power.
Suddenly sensing the ground around him wildly shaking!
When he regained his senses.
He was shocked to discover hundreds of mechanical monsters appeared around, all locking onto him.
Wan Liu just felt cold sweat on his forehead.
The move he prepared to attack hung frozen in mid-air.
"Oh my mother!"
"What’s happening?"
Wan Liu exclaimed in shock, frighteningly revealing his true form.
A towering ancient tree tens of thousands of meters tall suddenly appeared on this black earth.
Branches waving across the sky.
Wan Liu began desperately resisting the monster tide attacking from all sides.
The situation wasn’t much better for other Divine Sons and Daughters.
A two-headed ogre was currently engaged with a high-tier legendary mechanical monster.
Suddenly, dozens of strong auras appeared beside it.
Though its combat power was astonishing.
At this moment, it could only do its utmost to resist!
"Oh! Dammit!"
"Big Head, this doesn’t match the intel we received!"
"Wasn’t it said only those numbered ruins have danger in the ancient ruins?"
"What’s with so many mechanical monsters?"
"That sneaky pack of dwarves! Could they have deceived us?"
Its other head said.
"Second Head, those dwarves entered with us too."
"If they wanted to trap us, they’d be caught by these mechanical monsters too."
"Stop complaining, let’s first find a way to deal with the current situation."
At this moment, the seven dwarven legends who came in together were also bewildered.
They were desperately resisting the rampaging mechanical army.
"Damn! What’s happening?"
"We came here so many times before, and never encountered anything like this!"
One dwarf wielding a chain hammer looked up at the sky, asking.
"Did His Majesty the King mention such a situation happening in this ancient ruins this time?"
The dwarves shook their heads one by one.
Clearly, what was happening here was beyond everyone’s expectations.
Han Xing was unaware that due to their actions.
A series of chain reactions was triggered.
Even affecting the workings of this world.
Of course, even if he knew, Han Xing would still act.
After all, this General Cockroach was clearly intending to wipe them out.
Han Xing certainly wouldn’t be polite.
On the third level, the second level, there were no traces of any monsters anymore.
These two levels seemed to be the control centers of the entire ruins.
Above lay an extremely huge apparatus, still constantly emitting various data.
But Han Xing and the others couldn’t understand.
Also, they didn’t know how to operate these instruments above.

Of course, even if he knew, Han Xing would still act.
After all, this General Cockroach was clearly intending to wipe them out.
Han Xing certainly wouldn’t be polite.
On the third level, the second level, there were no traces of any monsters anymore.
These two levels seemed to be the control centers of the entire ruins.
Above lay an extremely huge apparatus, still constantly emitting various data.
But Han Xing and the others couldn’t understand.
Also, they didn’t know how to operate these instruments above.

chapters.title: Chapter 614 - 373: Looting the Trophy Room, an Astonishing Haul!
paragraphs: Simply left it alone.
At this moment, Shen Yun suddenly said, "Brother Xing, we’re already on the second level."
"Logically, there should be one more level and then we’re at the bottom, right?"
Han Xing nodded, "If this ruin doesn’t have a basement-like structure, then the first level should be the last one."
"We’ve searched all of the over a hundred levels above, but found nothing."
"If there really is treasure in this ruin, then it can only be on the last level."
Pausing for a moment, Han Xing said, "Everyone, look for the passage. If we can’t find anything, we’ll have to give up."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
Then they began searching around every corner of the second level.
Once again, they discovered a passage beneath an apparatus.
However, just like on the 14th level, the entrance to this passage had a layer of Divine Power Barrier for protection.
This time, they had experience.
Before Han Xing took out the [Giant Beast Tail Spike], Shen Yun had already set up the Recovery Array.
The next moment.
A wave of piercing pain swept through their bodies and disappeared in a flash.
After Han Xing took out the [Giant Beast Tail Spike], he immediately made a stab and then quickly stored it back in his backpack.
The Divine Power Barrier on the passage shattered instantly.
With a glance at the collapsed entrance of the passage.
Han Xing led the team into the last level of the ruin.
A system prompt appeared.
[You have entered Ruin No.13: Resource Storage Room.]
Upon seeing this prompt,
everyone’s face broke into a knowing smile.
Because they knew.
This time they had found the right place!
Resource Storage Room.
The name alone indicated that it was a place for storing materials.
They knew these ruins were built by a certain civilization to cope with the apocalypse.
The resources inside must be the most valuable belongings of this race.
Ahead, a corridor appeared.
On both sides of the corridor were numerous doors.
One could imagine that behind these doors were surely many stored resources.
Han Xing smiled and said, "Let’s search!"
Hearing this, a gleam flashed in everyone’s eyes.
Nothing brings more joy than a fruitful harvest!
"Bang!"
The door to the first material storage room opened.
In the first room.
They found a large amount of food and some plant seeds.
Though there were many, they held little use for Han Xing and his team.
"Let’s go to the next room," Han Xing said.
The group shook their heads a bit disappointedly and turned to leave.
However, the contents of the second storage room made everyone’s eyes light up!
Because inside, they saw many weapon racks.
And on these weapon racks, there were many exaggeratedly shaped weapons.
At a glance, all the prefixes included the words Ancient Weapons.
[Middle-tier Ancient Weapon: Energy Storage Cannon]
[Initial-tier Ancient Weapon: Energy Pulse Rifle]
[High-tier Ancient Weapon: Demon-piercing Light Killing Cannon!]
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but exclaim, "We’ve struck it rich... we’re really damn rich now!"
"So many Ancient Weapons!"
Even Han Xing couldn’t help but gasp in excitement at this moment.
In front of them, at least a hundred Ancient Weapons were displayed.
And one must know, in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Any single Ancient Weapon can sell for a staggering price.
Initial-tier Ancient Weapons are worth at least 1000 Philosopher’s Stones.
Middle-tier ones directly multiply by a hundred.
As for high-tier Ancient Weapons, their value is hard to measure.
The reason for this is.
That.
Common Initial-tier Ancient Weapons are capable of harming creatures below the Fifth Transformation.
Middle-tier Ancient Weapons possess a terrifying power to damage Legendary Creatures.
As for the mighty high-tier Ancient Weapons, even Demigods would not dare to take a direct hit!
And the most crucial point is.
This type of hot weapon Ancient Weapon can be carried and used at will!
That’s why they can sell for such exorbitant prices!
"Wow... this time, we could earn a fortune just by selling off this batch of Ancient Weapons, couldn’t we?"
Cheng Jianyong gulped.
Everyone was aware of the value of the items in this weapon room.
However, at this moment.
Han Xing suddenly had an odd idea.
What if he took all these Ancient Weapons out and gave them to a batch of his combat units?
So many full sets of Ancient Weapons, it could even equip an entire hundred-man force!
While those creatures were still clashing with Magic Sword Qi.
Han Xing’s side could directly suppress them with hot weapons!
The sight would be exhilarating!
However, this also indirectly indicated the strength of this cockroach race.
Although their personal combat ability wasn’t strong.
Their technology level was extremely advanced.
Without hesitation, Han Xing directly swept all the Ancient Weapons in the weapon room away.
System prompts continuously appeared.
[Obtained Ancient Weapons...]
Han Xing roughly calculated.
The cumulative harvest was 174 Initial-tier Ancient Weapons, 18 Middle-tier, and 4 High-tier.
The harvest was immense!
"Let’s go! To the next room!" Han Xing said excitedly.
The group continued to open doors and enter.
In the subsequent rooms.
There were still various weapon rooms, food storage rooms, and data storage rooms.
Inside the data rooms, the civilization and certain historical events of this race were recorded.
Along with their path of flesh body evolution.
For Han Xing,
those food and data were of no use.
Including the so-called path of flesh body evolution, which was also useless.
After all, judging by the combat power of that General Cockroach from earlier.
Even if they took this path of flesh body evolution to the extreme, their strength would only be comparable to the weakest Demigods in the Holy Spirit Realm.
It’s said to be the weakest Demigod, but in reality, it can only hold its own against a High-tier Legend.
One must know, in the Holy Spirit Realm, they can use Divine Power.
And Divine Power can bring a qualitative change to the battle strength of Legendaries in the Holy Spirit Realm.
So, Han Xing wasn’t particularly interested in their method of evolution.
What he wanted were the Ancient Weapons that could quickly boost his own combat strength.
Sifting through the loot, Han Xing once again harvested over a thousand Initial-tier, 78 Middle-tier Ancient Weapons.
And 14 High-tier Ancient Weapons!
Converted to the number of Philosopher’s Stones, it’s simply unimaginable!
At this point.
They arrived at the end of the corridor.
Here, there was only one last room left unsearched.
Without hesitation, Han Xing pushed the door open.
Upon seeing the scene inside.
Everyone’s eyes reflected an exceptionally shocked look!
In the room before them, there were at least a hundred large black boxes!
Exactly the same as the boxes they had opened in the trophy room above!
"Damn! So this is the most important place of the entire ruin!"
"So many boxes, imagine how much material they could yield?" Cheng Jianyong said in shock.
Even Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang had a hint of excitement on their faces!
After all, there were just too many boxes here.
Imagining that in their previous completion of the ruin challenge, they were only given one box.
One can imagine the immense value contained here!
"Open them all."
Han Xing directly announced.
Upon receiving Han Xing’s instruction.
The group excitedly rushed over to open each one of these boxes.
Immediately, they saw a dazzling array of various exotic metals and minerals inside!
Rough estimates suggested that the quantity of Insect Emperor Stones and Divine Gold in each box was no less than ten thousand!
At this moment, even Han Xing couldn’t help but feel excited!
He quickly stored them all in his backpack.
A system prompt appeared.
[Obtained Insect Emperor Divine Stone*114 million, obtained Calamity Divine Gold*5432, obtained Insect Mother Brain Core*1...]
[Obtained Genetic Enhancement Potion (Ultimate Improved Version)*9...]
A total of over a million Insect Emperor Divine Stones! Equivalent to more than a million Philosopher’s Stones.
Plus over five thousand Calamity Divine Gold!
This was almost equivalent to ten days of harvesting on a beast’s body!
Han Xing admitted he was shallow.
The gains from this Ancient Ruin not only didn’t fall short of those from a beast’s corpse but far surpassed them!
Han Xing felt like he’d found an unbelievably grand treasure trove!
His excited hands were trembling slightly!
Then, Han Xing inspected the attributes of the other two items...

chapters.title: Chapter 615 - 374: Insect Mother Core, Attribute Enhancement
paragraphs: Han Xing began examining the attributes of the other two items.

[Genetic Enhancement Potion (Ultimate Improved Version)]: After taking, there is a 100% chance to increase your four-dimensional attributes by 1000 points, with no risk of mutation. (Remaining uses: 5)
Note: A potion developed through countless experiments, only by chance, completely free of side effects, and extremely rare in quantity.
[Insect Mother Core]: After taking, it can directly increase spiritual power by 5000 points.
Note: The Insect Mother is the breeding mother of this race, possessing extremely strong spiritual power. After each Insect Mother dies, a spiritual power core is formed.
Seeing the attributes of these two items, everyone was wide-eyed again.
"No way, no side effects and it directly adds 1000 points to the four-dimensional attributes, this is awesome!"
Cheng Jianyong gulped.
Shen Yun couldn’t help but say, "The Insect Mother Core, activates special spiritual abilities?"
"What is this thing used for?"
Han Xing didn’t answer but directly tossed the nearly transparent crystal core to Shen Yun.
Shen Yun was stunned.
A moment later, he smiled wryly and shook his head, "Brother Xing, better give it to Sister Lian Meng."
"She is a mage profession, increasing spirit is more important for her than for me."
Han Xing chuckled, "Take it, I’m making you the guinea pig."
"Let’s see if after swallowing it, you grow insect tentacles, wings, or something as a side effect."
"After all, this is the Insect Mother’s brain core, I wouldn’t want Lian Meng to turn into that kind of insect-like appearance."
Upon hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng’s face turned pale instantly.
She waved her hands repeatedly, "No... don’t give it to me..."
Everyone else burst into laughter upon hearing this.
They all knew that Han Xing was joking.
After all, the item information didn’t mention any related side effects.
Shen Yun smiled, then swallowed the ’Insect Mother Core’ directly in front of everyone.
A moment later.
Everyone felt the strength of holy light emanating from Shen Yun’s body begin to surge.
Then, an invisible spiritual power burst forth from Shen Yun’s body.
All those present, except Han Xing, felt a buzzing in their ears!
This is a sign of excessive spiritual power.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but ask, "Oh man, is the effect of this Insect Mother Core that good?"
Shen Yun opened his eyes, glanced at him, and said, "5000 points of spirit, that’s nearly a quarter of my spirit attribute increased at once, how can it not be good?"
Cheng Jianyong looked him up and down.
Upon finding no signs of mutation in Shen Yun, Cheng Jianyong said, "Damn, I’m so envious."
"If I got such a boost in power all at once, I’d dare to single-handedly challenge a Demigod!"
Han Xing interjected, "Hmm? Would you really dare?"
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong immediately gave an awkward laugh, "I’m just kidding, Brother Xing."
"I’m only level 55 right now, challenging a Demigod alone would be asking for death."
Han Xing shook his head, seemingly accustomed to Cheng Jianyong’s shamelessness.
At this time, Han Xing took out all the [Genetic Enhancement Potions (Ultimate Improved Version)] he had.
"9 bottles of potion, two for each of us."
"Xiaoyunzi has already taken the Insect Mother Core, so just one for you."
Everyone had no objections to this distribution.
They each took the potion from Han Xing’s hand.
And drank it directly.
In an instant.
A powerful aura rose within everyone’s bodies!
Two bottles of Genetic Enhancement Potion equate to a 2000-point increase in four-dimensional attributes.
Nearly one-tenth of their current attributes.
Moreover, this potion had a more terrifying effect on Han Xing.
After all, he held the title of Witch Race Saint Master.
All attributes increased by one hundred percent.
The 2000-point increase in four-dimensional attributes became 4000!
His combat power increased once again!
After everyone finished absorbing the Genetic Enhancement Potion, they all showed satisfied expressions.
"Really not bad..."
Shen Yun praised, "This potion has no side effects and the increase is huge."
"If it weren’t for its usage limit."
"I feel like we could crush those Demigods just by piling up four-dimensional attributes."
Of course, Shen Yun was just thinking aloud.
This was clearly impossible.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but say, "Brother Xing, how many relics do you think there are in this world?"
"If we were to loot all these relics."
"We’d never have to worry about the Philosopher’s Stone and Calamity Divine Gold anymore, right?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment and shook his head, "Far from it."
"The Philosopher’s Stone is a major gap."
"The new Catastrophe-level Defense Tower blueprints I just got all require a large amount of the Philosopher’s Stone."
"Even if we scoured every relic in this world, it would only meet my needs for a while."
"Plus, we also need materials like Shimmering Terra Stone."
"So, it’s impossible not to worry about these high-level materials."
Cheng Jianyong nodded.
But even so, everyone knew this time’s gains were already quite astonishing.
Even those dwarves might not know.
The incredible opportunities hidden within these relics.
At this moment, Shen Yun asked, "Brother Xing, now that we’ve explored the last layer."
"Should we head back to the upper layer and use that teleportation gate to get out?"
Han Xing shook his head, "It shouldn’t be that complicated."
"We’re already on the first layer of the relic, there must be hidden doors or passages leading to the outside."
"Let’s look for them."
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun agreed it made sense.
Then, everyone began searching around.
A few minutes later, they actually found a secret door in the corner of a food storage room.

chapters.title: Chapter 616 - 374: Insect Mother Core, Attribute Enhancement
paragraphs: There is a layer of divine power barrier above.
Han Xing, familiar with it, took out the giant beast’s tail spike.
Pierced through the barrier on the hidden door.
The view before his eyes widened.
The outside scene reappeared in front of him.
The black earth, littered with various metal parts.
Everyone looked back and then at the outside scene.
They discovered that even if they went out, they could enter Relic 13 at any time.
Others could do the same.
By this time, after Han Xing and his group had rampaged through this place, it was completely ruined.
"Let’s go, let’s head out."
Han Xing took the lead and stepped out of the door.
The team members followed behind.
At this moment, Han Xing seemed to have thought of something.
He looked at the damaged black tunnel door behind him.
After pondering for a while, he turned around and picked up that pile of unknown metal fragments again.
Gradually, Han Xing pieced this door back into its original shape.
Aside from the cracks on it.
It looks quite similar to its original appearance.
The team members behind him looked at Han Xing’s actions, puzzled.
Until Han Xing took out Slime Gel and some Ether from his backpack.
Repaired those cracks to appear smooth and renewed.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but ask, "Brother Xing, did you glue the door back together?"
Han Xing shrugged, "Yeah."
"We didn’t destroy the machines inside the relic."
"This way, when other Divine Sons and Daughters come, they can likely still activate the relic challenge."
"Of course, whether they can get any rewards after the challenge, I don’t know."
At this moment, everyone suddenly realized.
They couldn’t help but sigh in their hearts.
So naive!
But no one said anything.
Instead, they revealed a knowing smile.
Then, Han Xing led them out of the range of Relic 13.
However, as soon as they emerged, they witnessed scenes of various mechanical monsters rioting around them.
Cheng Jianyong, looking surprised, said, "What... what happened?"
"Have these monsters gone mad?"
The team members were also astonished.
After all, before they entered the relic, it wasn’t like this.
Now the number of monsters had suddenly increased a hundredfold.
Moreover, at the very least, they all had the strength of Fifth-Turn Elite Level.
If any of them faced such a situation alone.
They would feel immense pressure.
Han Xing didn’t speak.
After a moment, he suddenly laughed, "Isn’t this great?"
"The more monsters there are, the faster we can kill them."
"These monsters can all add to the relic energy points."
Upon hearing this, everyone immediately understood Han Xing’s plan.
He meant to speed up the monster-killing pace.
Once the energy points were enough, directly enter other relics to scavenge resources inside!
This plan was to plunder the other relics of this world!
However, they liked it!
Meanwhile.
Upon seeing the monsters rushing, all team members entered battle state!
At this moment, Shen Yun directly bestowed two blessings on everyone.
Then, holding a shield, he suddenly leapt into the group of monsters.
"Boom!"
Like a cannonball landing!
The monsters, in that instant, were all suppressed by the terrifying aura of the Giant Beast Shield.
All froze in place!
In the next moment, the monsters suddenly flew back several hundred meters!
It was exactly the special effect of Shen Yun’s Divine Artifact Shield!

[Fierce Beast’s Might]: Legendary Effect, when attacked, there’s a 50% chance to unleash the beast’s aura, forcibly pushing back nearby enemies by 500 meters. (Ineffective against Divine Spirit Level creatures.)
Shen Yun cleared a space around him in an instant.
Then, he held the Holy Hammer high.
Intense Holy Light erupted from the Holy Hammer!
The surrounding monsters emitted bursts of white smoke as they were scorched by the Holy Light.
Soon, these mechanical monsters died in droves.
Cheng Jianyong, at the rear, exclaimed, "Tsk tsk, Xiaoyunzi’s combat ability is impressive."
"Feels like he could handle the fight alone."
Cheng Jianyong suddenly said with some mischievousness, "Brother Xing, should we rest for a while and watch Xiaoyunzi perform?"
Han Xing rolled his eyes at him.
Of course, everyone wouldn’t let Shen Yun fight alone.
And they knew Cheng Jianyong was joking.
At this moment.
They all drank bottles of [Gale Wings Secret Elixir], gaining temporary flight ability.
The four of them flew directly into the air.
Then, waves of long-range attacks rained down.
"Boom boom boom!"
On the black earth, earth-shaking explosions continuously echoed!
The nearby monsters were blasted wave after wave, exploding into metal fragments.
The four of them were like bulldozers.
Flattening their way through.
All the monsters were enveloped by their terrifying attacks, then exploded into pieces!
It took them only half an hour.
They cleared all the monsters within a hundred kilometers.
The number of monsters they killed in half an hour even exceeded the total they killed in over 30 hours previously.
Everyone panted slightly.
Then rested briefly on an open space.
Of course, they didn’t waste the monster corpses they killed.
They disassembled them into various metals, stowing them in their backpacks.
Cheng Jianyong looked at the backpack space gradually filling up.
"Brother Xing, my backpack space is almost full."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing paused for a moment, then frowned.
He checked his own space and found only less than 200 slots left.
Each team member’s backpack space had only over a hundred slots left.
Looking at everyone’s expression, Han Xing regretfully said, "A miscalculation."
"I didn’t expect such a haul from this trip into the ancient ruins."
"Forgot to clear the space first."
The main issue was the huge pile of giant beast scales taking up too much backpack space.
If they had cleared them out earlier, they wouldn’t have to worry about backpack space.
After pondering for a bit, Han Xing said, "Let’s see then."
"If space runs out later, discard those Mithril and Permanent Gold Ingots."
"Just take those higher-grade items like the Insect Emperor Stone and ancient weapons."
Hearing this, everyone’s eyes flashed a bit of reluctance.
Because this time, they collected a massive amount of Mithril and Permanent Gold Ingots.
Selling them outside would bring a huge profit.
But now, they were facing the situation of discarding them.
But there’s no other way.
The trading function cannot be used inside the ancient ruins.
Otherwise, Han Xing would’ve handed over the materials in his backpack to Lanlan and the others.
No matter how much, it could be transported back.
At this moment, Han Xing looked at his relic energy value and asked.
"What’s your relic energy value at?"
The team members reported a number again.
Han Xing nodded.
Their relic energy points had all reached 1500 points.
It should be enough to activate the next relic.
At this time.
Han Xing looked at the distant, oddly-shaped mountains and said, "Let’s go, let’s check if those mountains are where the relics are."
Then, they fought while advancing.
Soon.
They arrived at the foot of a mountain.
However, this time they didn’t hear a system prompt.
This mountain was quite ordinary in shape.
Han Xing shook his head in disappointment.
It seems not every mountain has relics.
Everyone continued to look for relics.
In this apocalyptic world, after advancing another tens of thousands of kilometers.
A mountain resembling a pillar appeared in front of them.
As they approached, a mechanical voice broadcast sounded again.
"Detecting life forms approaching Relic 117, detecting relic energy points on them..."
"Detection complete, 5 targets, relic energy points all exceed 1500, match relic activation conditions..."
"Enter?"
Upon hearing this prompt.
Han Xing pondered for a moment, "Does each relic require different energy points?"
The previous relic needed 1000 energy points.
This relic has become 1500 points.
However, with their current monster-killing efficiency.
The difference of a few hundred energy points isn’t much.
Han Xing directly answered, "Yes."

sentences.text: There is a layer of divine power barrier above.
Han Xing, familiar with it, took out the giant beast’s tail spike.
Pierced through the barrier on the hidden door.
The view before his eyes widened.
The outside scene reappeared in front of him.
The black earth, littered with various metal parts.
Everyone looked back and then at the outside scene.
They discovered that even if they went out, they could enter Relic 13 at any time.
Others could do the same.
By this time, after Han Xing and his group had rampaged through this place, it was completely ruined.
"Let’s go, let’s head out."
Han Xing took the lead and stepped out of the door.
The team members followed behind.
At this moment, Han Xing seemed to have thought of something.
He looked at the damaged black tunnel door behind him.
After pondering for a while, he turned around and picked up that pile of unknown metal fragments again.
Gradually, Han Xing pieced this door back into its original shape.
Aside from the cracks on it.
It looks quite similar to its original appearance.
The team members behind him looked at Han Xing’s actions, puzzled.
Until Han Xing took out Slime Gel and some Ether from his backpack.
Repaired those cracks to appear smooth and renewed.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but ask, "Brother Xing, did you glue the door back together?"
Han Xing shrugged, "Yeah."
"We didn’t destroy the machines inside the relic."
"This way, when other Divine Sons and Daughters come, they can likely still activate the relic challenge."
"Of course, whether they can get any rewards after the challenge, I don’t know."
At this moment, everyone suddenly realized.
They couldn’t help but sigh in their hearts.
So naive!

chapters.title: Chapter 617 - 375: Continuing the Raids!
paragraphs: At this moment, a purple teleportation gate appeared once again below.
Everyone exchanged smiles, greed flashing in their eyes.
With the activation of the teleportation gate, it was as if these few wolves had been let into a sheep pen.
Given everyone’s character.
They wouldn’t rest until they’d emptied the entire ruin.
Then, Han Xing and the five others directly entered the teleportation gate.
A position appeared on the mini-map.
[Ruins No. 117, Floor 2413...]
"More than two thousand floors..."
"This Ruins No. 117 is much taller than the previous one."
Han Xing knew this might relate to the appearance of this ruin.
After all, the previous ruin was an inverted triangle.
But this ruin was cylindrical.
Its height was also much greater.
Cheng Jianyong laughed: "More than two thousand floors, this will keep us busy exploring."
"Indeed."
Han Xing nodded, "There are too many floors; let’s not waste too much time at the top."
"Let’s find the entrance and rush straight down."
The team members all nodded in agreement.
Then, they all entered battle mode.
Due to the cylindrical appearance of this ruin,
the interior space wasn’t large, roughly only five to six thousand square meters.
With the attack range of him and Zhang Lianmeng,
they could eliminate all the monsters in five seconds.
Then, the moment the passage opened, they dashed to the next floor.
The entire set of actions was like flowing water.
There was no delay whatsoever.
It took an hour and a half.
They advanced over a thousand floors!
And finally reached the middle region of the ruins.
That is, Floor 1032 of Ruins No. 117.
"Challenger detected; you’ve reached the target floor. The guardian monster of the ruins is being activated..."
After the voice broadcast ended,
it was as if a magnetic whirlwind swept through.
Metal parts and fragments on the ground all converged in one place.
When the whirlwind ended,
a hundred-meter-tall mechanical puppet, possessing high-tier legendary level strength, appeared in front of everyone again.
Without needing Han Xing to order it,
everyone unleashed their attacks.
Within thirty seconds, the mechanical puppet was covered in severe wounds.
As Zhang Lianmeng waved the magic staff, a massive meteorite appeared out of thin air.
Then, it suddenly smashed down!
"Boom!"
The entire 1032nd floor of the ruins shook violently.
And this mechanical puppet was smashed back into fragments by the impact.
The voice broadcast appeared again.
"The challenger has successfully defeated the guardian monster of the ruins."
"Please proceed to the loot chamber to claim your rewards."
They searched around the area.
Similarly, they found an open metal gate nearby.
There lay the loot chamber.
Upon entering, it was just like the previous ruin.
A large black chest was inside.
However, just a chest’s reward could no longer pique Han Xing and the others’ interest.
But they didn’t waste it either.
As usual, upon opening it, they obtained more than five thousand Insect Emperor Divine Stones and over a hundred pieces of Calamity Divine Gold.
Plus, a middle-tier ancient weapon blueprint: Puppet Giant.
As for the attributes, they were similar to that of the Black Flame Python.
It’s considered the same type of blueprint.
At this point, the system prompt appeared.
"Challenge of Ruins No. 117 concluded; all challengers, please enter the teleportation array to leave the ruins."
Hearing the system prompt,
everyone exchanged another smile.
Since they were here... how could they leave so easily?
They had to take something with them, right?
Without needing Han Xing to remind them,
they had already started to split up and search in various directions.
A few minutes later,
Cheng Jianyong suddenly said, "Brother Xing, found it!"
Upon hearing this, everyone quickly gathered towards Cheng Jianyong.
Then, they saw a hidden passage door beneath a heap of discarded machinery.
On top of it, there was also a layer of divine power barrier.
Han Xing adeptly took out the giant beast tail spike and skillfully broke it open!
At this time.
The familiar alarm sounded above their heads again.
[Warning! Warning!]
[You have touched the forbidden area of the ruins; please leave immediately! Please leave immediately!]
But clearly, this alarm was directly ignored by everyone.
They started to delve further in.
At this moment, Han Xing discovered that
on every floor here stood an astounding number of containers; by rough estimate, at least ten thousand units.
In each container, there was a cockroach monster.
Given the number of floors in this ruin,
with a thousand floors beneath,
if each was a so-called fire seed storage room,
then this ruin alone housed at least several million cockroach monsters.
This number was truly terrifying!
However, this was none of Han Xing’s concern.
After delving over a thousand floors,
they finally reached the very bottom of the ruins.
That is, Floor 5 of Ruins No. 117.
Here, again, there was a demigod-level cockroach monster, stored individually in a giant jar.
At this point, Han Xing couldn’t help but ponder a question.
"If other ruins also had such situations, then."
"This race’s strength is truly formidable."
"Not only do they possess extremely advanced technology."
"But they also have at least a hundred pseudo demigod-level powerhouses, with countless legendary-level puppet monsters to assist in battle."
In Han Xing’s memory,
the demigod-level powerhouses among these cockroach creatures were too weak, only slightly stronger than ordinary high-tier legends.
So he added the word ’pseudo.’
But unfortunately.
This race still hadn’t developed, now they’re on the brink of extinction.
The demigod-level creature in this container didn’t awaken.
Han Xing wasn’t bothered with it.
He directly stepped into the next layer.
And then.
They finally arrived at the last layer, the most crucial layer of the entire ruin.

chapters.title: Chapter 618 - 375: Continuing the Raids!
paragraphs: Resource storage room.
Here, it is still a corridor.
On both sides are the doors to various rooms.
It’s similar to the situation in Ruin No. 13.
The group once again began to search room by room.
It’s just that the resource rooms here store more food.
Perhaps it has something to do with the number of cockroach creatures in this ruin being larger.
However, among them, they still found quite a few finished ancient weapons.
Han Xing directly packed all of them into his bag.
Then, he went straight to the last room of the resource storage.
The scene inside immediately made everyone’s eyes light up.
Because they saw hundreds of large black boxes!
Inside these large boxes were all kinds of resources!
The group opened all of them and took everything,
[Gained Insect Emperor Stone *1.07 million, gained Calamity Divine Gold *4712...]
[Gained Genetic Enhancement Potion (Ultimate Improved Version) *6...]
The harvest was slightly less than that of Ruin No. 13.
Though it was still rather good.
After dividing the 6 bottles of genetic enhancement potions, the group once again gained a substantial boost.
At this moment, a look of satisfaction appeared on everyone’s face.
Cheng Jianyong excitedly said, "Awesome! One trip’s haul is equivalent to a hundred years’ worth of savings of a group in the Holy Spirit Realm!"
Shen Yun laughed and said, "The resources within a single ruin might be the accumulation of this civilization for countless years."
"Yet we took it all in one go, how can that not be thrilling?"
The group laughed aloud.
Have to say,
this feeling of looting the house is truly delightful!
After leaving this ruin,
they continued to madly hunt monsters.
Besides energy points,
their experience value also surged rapidly.
The mechanical monsters not only break down into various precious metals,
but also provide a lot of experience.
Before long,
Zhang Lianmeng was the first to be enveloped by a white light.
She leveled up to 56.
"This experience gain is really quite nice."
Cheng Jianyong praised, "If we farm for three full months, our entire party should be able to reach level 57 or 58."
The group nodded in agreement.
Next,
they spent another half-day defeating many monsters.
Su Xiaoyang and Cheng Jianyong also reached level 56.
Han Xing looked at the energy points on everyone, then said, "Time’s about up."
"Let’s go find the next ruin."
With those words, they began heading towards more conspicuous areas in the distance.
After half an hour,
the group stopped at the foot of a mountain.
This mountain appeared to be rectangular.
Its length, width, and height each measured over ten thousand meters.
It looked like a black metal box.
Logically speaking, areas with such distinctive appearances should be the location of a ruin.
Yet, after circling the area twice,
they nearly glued themselves to this black mountain.
However, they still didn’t receive any related audio prompt.
"What’s going on? Did we find the wrong place?"
Cheng Jianyong asked somewhat puzzled.
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing shook his head.
"Not quite sure, let’s look again."
After that, they continued circling the black mountain.
With its smooth exterior and unique metallic texture,
Han Xing confirmed.
This was definitely a ruin.
However, no matter how they tried, the related audio prompt never appeared.
At this moment, Han Xing seemed to have thought of a possibility.
"Damn, could it be that this world’s system identified us?"
"And won’t let me in?"
Hearing this speculation, the group was taken aback.
Because what Han Xing said was very likely true!
It’s known that the creatures who built such ruins were quite advanced in civilization.
Their previous actions had nearly ravaged two ruins.
Their behavior might have been sensed by the programs of other ruins.
Thus, Han Xing was prohibited from entering.
At this point, the group couldn’t help but get a bit of a headache.
Cheng Jianyong said speechlessly, "Damn, this is like having us all blacklisted?"
Being blacklisted by a ruin.
This is probably the first time something like this has happened in history.
The Dwarf Race has controlled ruins for so many years, and might have never encountered this.
Shen Yun asked, "Brother Xing, what do we do now?"
"Do we change locations and search for other ruins to enter?"
However, after thinking for a moment, Han Xing shook his head.
"No, let’s keep looking."
"From the previous two ruins, we’ve all seen."
"The last level of the ruin has hidden doors."
"Let’s see if we can find the location of this hidden door."
"Then I’ll directly use the Giant Beast Tail Spike to break it open!"
Hearing this, the group was instantly startled.
Ignoring the rules set by the ruins and forcefully entering!
However, they didn’t have much psychological burden.
They began to scout separately.
Around this black box structure, they searched everywhere.
After half an hour.
The five of them had circled this box-shaped structure with a diameter of thousands of meters several times.
At a certain corner,
Han Xing suddenly noticed something odd about the wall.
Without much hesitation, he pulled out the Giant Beast Tail Spike.
Anyway, the [God-Breaking Spike] special effect of the Giant Beast Tail Spike has unlimited uses.
Unlike the [Giant Beast Poison] special effect, which only has three uses.
The only side effect is that Han Xing has to endure a pin-pricking pain throughout his body while using it.
In the next moment!
Han Xing jabbed hard!
"Pop!
A sound like a bubble popping erupted.
In front of them appeared a broken passage door.
Han Xing’s lips curled up into a strange smile, "Trying to keep me out?"
With those words, he called his teammates over.
Before long, Cheng Jianyong looked at the pitch-black passage and suddenly laughed, "We’ve directly reached the bottom resource storage room!"
"How nice, it saved us a lot of effort."
The rewards from the ruin’s trial aren’t worth mentioning compared to what they gained from looting.
Then, the group entered the first level of the ruin directly.
It only took ten minutes to sweep all the resources inside.
They obtained a vast number of finished ancient weapons again.
As well as over a million Insect Emperor Stones and more than five thousand pieces of Calamity Divine Gold.
Moreover, there were 11 bottles of genetic enhancement potions and 1 Insect Mother Crystal Core.
It’s worth mentioning that.
Since Calamity Divine Gold, this kind of metal, only appears in worlds on the brink of destruction.
Obviously, this world fits that characteristic.
Thus, this rare metal can be found in abundance here.
After distributing the genetic enhancement potions and Insect Mother Crystal Core,
the group exited this unidentified ruin.
Han Xing thought of something again.
He picked up the fragments from the ground and casually glued them back together using some slime glue and Yi State.
The previously damaged passage door was restored to its original state.
If not inspected closely, one wouldn’t be able to tell.
Cheng Jianyong even touched it, praising, "Tsk, tsk,"
"This craftsmanship is really good."
"If not looked at closely, you can’t tell at all."
At the same time.
On a battlefield a million kilometers away from Han Xing and the others.
A creature radiating golden light all over its body.
Was fighting against a group of mechanical monsters.
He wielded a longsword, and every slash cleaved a mechanical monster in half.
Sword Qi extended for tens of thousands of meters.
The majesty was truly shocking.
However, he was surrounded.
Even though he was exceptionally talented and powerful.
Yet, his opponents were four high-tier legends in total.
Plus, there were more than a dozen mid-high tier legends, and a whole host of Lords and Dominators,
Additionally, here, he couldn’t use Divine Power.
At this moment, the Bright Divine Son assumed a humanoid form, frowning.
"Troublesome."
"These monsters are simply endless."
"Continuing like this isn’t a solution."
At this time, the Bright Divine Son looked at a number appearing on his palm.
"Already two thousand relic energy points?" the Bright Divine Son murmured.
As a native,
by defeating these monsters, the Bright Divine Son could only receive relic energy points and nothing else.
After all, they don’t have a system interface.
Unlike Han Xing and the others who could decompose the bodies of these monsters.

sentences.text: Resource storage room.
Here, it is still a corridor.
On both sides are the doors to various rooms.
It’s similar to the situation in Ruin No.
The group once again began to search room by room.
It’s just that the resource rooms here store more food.
Perhaps it has something to do with the number of cockroach creatures in this ruin being larger.
However, among them, they still found quite a few finished ancient weapons.
Han Xing directly packed all of them into his bag.
Then, he went straight to the last room of the resource storage.
The scene inside immediately made everyone’s eyes light up.
Because they saw hundreds of large black boxes!
Inside these large boxes were all kinds of resources!
The group opened all of them and took everything,
[Gained Insect Emperor Stone *1.07 million, gained Calamity Divine Gold *4712...]
[Gained Genetic Enhancement Potion (Ultimate Improved Version) *6...]
The harvest was slightly less than that of Ruin No.
Though it was still rather good.
After dividing the 6 bottles of genetic enhancement potions, the group once again gained a substantial boost.
At this moment, a look of satisfaction appeared on everyone’s face.
Cheng Jianyong excitedly said, "Awesome!
One trip’s haul is equivalent to a hundred years’ worth of savings of a group in the Holy Spirit Realm!"
Shen Yun laughed and said, "The resources within a single ruin might be the accumulation of this civilization for countless years."
"Yet we took it all in one go, how can that not be thrilling?"
The group laughed aloud.
Have to say,
this feeling of looting the house is truly delightful!

they continued to madly hunt monsters.
Besides energy points,
their experience value also surged rapidly.
The mechanical monsters not only break down into various precious metals,
but also provide a lot of experience.

Zhang Lianmeng was the first to be enveloped by a white light.
She leveled up to 56.
"This experience gain is really quite nice."
Cheng Jianyong praised, "If we farm for three full months, our entire party should be able to reach level 57 or 58."
The group nodded in agreement.
Next,
they spent another half-day defeating many monsters.
Su Xiaoyang and Cheng Jianyong also reached level 56.
Han Xing looked at the energy points on everyone, then said, "Time’s about up."
"Let’s go find the next ruin."
With those words, they began heading towards more conspicuous areas in the distance.
After half an hour,
the group stopped at the foot of a mountain.
This mountain appeared to be rectangular.
Its length, width, and height each measured over ten thousand meters.
It looked like a black metal box.
Logically speaking, areas with such distinctive appearances should be the location of a ruin.
Yet, after circling the area twice,
they nearly glued themselves to this black mountain.
However, they still didn’t receive any related audio prompt.
"What’s going on?
Did we find the wrong place?"
Cheng Jianyong asked somewhat puzzled.
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing shook his head.
"Not quite sure, let’s look again."
After that, they continued circling the black mountain.
With its smooth exterior and unique metallic texture,
Han Xing confirmed.
This was definitely a ruin.
However, no matter how they tried, the related audio prompt never appeared.
At this moment, Han Xing seemed to have thought of a possibility.
"Damn, could it be that this world’s system identified us?"
"And won’t let me in?"
Hearing this speculation, the group was taken aback.
Because what Han Xing said was very likely true!
It’s known that the creatures who built such ruins were quite advanced in civilization.
Their previous actions had nearly ravaged two ruins.
Their behavior might have been sensed by the programs of other ruins.
Thus, Han Xing was prohibited from entering.
At this point, the group couldn’t help but get a bit of a headache.
Cheng Jianyong said speechlessly, "Damn, this is like having us all blacklisted?"
Being blacklisted by a ruin.
This is probably the first time something like this has happened in history.
The Dwarf Race has controlled ruins for so many years, and might have never encountered this.
Shen Yun asked, "Brother Xing, what do we do now?"
"Do we change locations and search for other ruins to enter?"
However, after thinking for a moment, Han Xing shook his head.
"No, let’s keep looking."
"From the previous two ruins, we’ve all seen."
"The last level of the ruin has hidden doors."
"Let’s see if we can find the location of this hidden door."
"Then I’ll directly use the Giant Beast Tail Spike to break it open!"
Hearing this, the group was instantly startled.
Ignoring the rules set by the ruins and forcefully entering!
However, they didn’t have much psychological burden.
They began to scout separately.
Around this black box structure, they searched everywhere.

chapters.title: Chapter 619 - 376: Half a Month and the Power of That Arrow
paragraphs: The Bright Divine Son pondered: "According to the intelligence from the race, after the energy points reach a certain level, the relic challenge must be initiated."
"Inside the ruins lies the greatest opportunity."
At this moment.
The Bright Divine Son seemed to have made some kind of decision.
In an instant, he swung a sword.
All the monsters in front were cleared out.
Then, transforming into a golden light, he dashed out at great speed.
He began heading straight forward, searching for the location of the ruins.
It’s not just the Bright Divine Son.
At this moment, strong beings from other races also started seeking out the nearby ruins.
In a building that looked like a sharpened pencil.
A peerlessly beautiful woman, with an extraordinarily fiery figure, walked gracefully within the ruins.
It was the Elf Goddess Elinora.
A voice broadcast appeared.
"The challenger has been detected to have reached the target floor. The guardian monsters of the ruins have been activated..."
Meanwhile.
A magnetic whirlwind began swirling.
Moments later, in front of Elinora.
A mechanical Violent Bear with a body size of hundreds of meters appeared.
The aura it exuded revealed it had the power of a High-tier Legend!
"Roar! Roar roar roar!"
As soon as the mechanical Violent Bear appeared, it immediately lunged at Elinora.
The mechanical mouth, large enough to swallow an elephant, suddenly opened, seemingly intending to bite Elinora alive.
There was no semblance of cherishing womanly beauty.
Elinora slightly raised her head, then took a deep breath.
Her already proud chest now reached an even more exaggerated scale!
The next moment.
Elinora floated slightly in mid-air, her long, slender white legs raised.
At the moment the monster charged.
She stomped down directly!
"Boom!"
A terrifying collision sound was heard.
The enormous body of the mechanical Violent Bear suddenly crashed onto the ground.
This mechanical Violent Bear seemed stunned by that single step.
Lying on the ground, it dazedly looked at Elinora.
At this moment.
Elinora, exuding a holy aura all over, showed a kind smile.
The mechanical Violent Bear wanted to get up again.
However, Elinora gave it no chance at all.
She once again extended her slender long legs.
Then stomped down hard!
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
The power was terrifyingly intense.
Each step made the ground of the ruins tremble continuously!
Completely different from her ethereal style.
Elinora, when fighting, turned out to be so... wild.
A few minutes later.
Looking at the ground filled with the metallic remains of the stomped mechanical Violent Bear.
Elinora exhaled gently, "Fighting in this state is indeed the most effortless."
She seemed to be adjusting her state, returning to that holy appearance once again.
Upon hearing the voice broadcast.
Elinora gave a gentle smile.
Then she walked into the treasure room.
In the next few days.
Han Xing led the members around exploring.
Meanwhile.
The Divine Sons were all making gains at various ruins.
Time quickly passed, and half a month was gone...
This day.
Han Xing and the others stood atop a city’s ruins.
Behind them was a destroyed black passage.
Everyone looked at that passage.
Cheng Jianyong marveled: "Brother Xing, you’re incredible."
"If it were anyone else, who would have known a relic was hidden beneath this city!"
The other team members also showed expressions of admiration.
Indeed.
When passing by this city.
Han Xing keenly noticed that the ground here seemed different.
The previous abandoned cities had grounds made from a special material, appearing grayish-black.
However, the ground here.
Was purely black.
Similar to the walls of the previous ruins.
Moreover, the relic system of this world had already blacklisted them.
Even when approaching the ruins, Han Xing and his team received no prompts.
Han Xing could only rely on his instincts to explore.
Thus, Han Xing became suspicious.
So, he directed his team to search the city.
Unexpectedly, they indeed found a sealed passage.
Han Xing did not hold back.
He directly pierced through with a tool.
Then entered and thoroughly raided their resource storage room.
Before leaving.
Han Xing habitually patched up the ground’s holes.
Then.
They looked at the pile of materials in their backpacks with satisfaction.
In the past half month, they looted twelve ancient ruins in total.
The harvest was quite astonishing.
The number of Initial Tier and Middle Tier Ancient Weapons has already exceeded forty thousand.
Moreover, there were over two hundred High-tier Ancient Weapons capable of harming demigods.
With these weapons alone.
Han Xing could form a super force capable of threatening many demigods.
Additionally, with over ten million Insect Emperor Stones, and sixty thousand pieces of Calamity Divine Gold.
Their half-month’s gain.
Had surpassed a month’s harvest on the Beast’s back!
Thinking about it, they could explore for another two and a half months inside, everyone felt very excited!
Because, after leaving this time.
Han Xing’s power will surge again.
From previously being barely able to handle a Divine Spirit.
He might now be able to handle two or three, maybe even four or five!
By then, Han Xing can directly take the Sky Island.
To the locations revealed by that alluring woman.
Find the other Divine Formats of the Elemental God, allowing Zhang Lianmeng to complete her advancement to Elemental Divine King.
Afterwards, everyone will start aiming for demigod status.
Han Xing has already planned out his future tasks.
At this moment.
Cheng Jianyong glanced around and suddenly said: "Brother Xing, about sixty thousand kilometers ahead of us."

chapters.title: Chapter 620 - 376: Half a Month and the Power of That Arrow
paragraphs: "There are a lot of red dots."
"It seems like the Divine Sons and Daughters of other races, they’ve all gathered together."
Han Xing was a bit surprised, "Gathered together?"
"Weren’t these guys all scattered around in recent days?"
"Why did they suddenly think of gathering?"
"Could it be that something there is attracting them?"
Everyone pondered for a moment.
Shen Yun then said, "Could there be a ruin there?"
Han Xing was taken aback, "Can a ruin accommodate so many people?"
Shen Yun shook his head.
Regarding this aspect.
They really weren’t very clear.
Han Xing thought for a moment, and continued, "Let’s go, let’s check out the situation too."
"Anyway, whether or not it’s a ruin, it doesn’t conflict with us."
Everyone showed a knowing smile.
Han Xing’s way of exploring ruins was different.
While they were still exerting effort dealing with the challenges of the ruins.
Han Xing had already skipped that step and started looting directly!
So, that group of Divine Sons and Daughters really had no conflict with Han Xing.
With those words, everyone sped towards the place where the red dots gathered.
From here, rushing to the location of the red dots, it was over 60,000 kilometers.
Even with Han Xing and the others’ speed, it would take at least six to seven hours.
Moreover
Han Xing discovered.
As everyone headed towards the congregation of red dots.
More and more red dots were already arriving there.
Roughly estimating, the number of red dots had surpassed 20.
This time, a total of only 100 people came in.
And just in that area, a fifth had gathered.
This indicates that there is certainly something there enticing them.
Four hours later.
Han Xing arrived near the gathering of red dots.
From afar, they saw an elliptical massive structure.
As tall as hundreds of thousands of meters.
This structure was the largest Han Xing had seen since entering this world.
Completely smooth, emanating a black glow.
Clearly, this was the material used to create ruins.
However, this ruin was at least tens of times larger than any previous ruins!
"Whoa... so big!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Han Xing nodded, "Indeed, very big."
Then, he cast his gaze further.
"Let’s go, I think I see them."
Han Xing continued to lead the group forward.
Not far forward.
Everyone saw on an open space ahead, more than twenty familiar figures gathered.
Among them, excluding those seven little Dwarfs.
Elinora from the Elf Race, the Bright Divine Son, the Little Giant Spirit King were all here.
These people seemed to be divided into three factions.
The seven little Dwarfs formed a faction of their own, with an aloofness that wanted to disregard anyone.
The second faction was led by the Elf Goddess and the Bright Divine Son.
Wan Liu of the Tree Spirit Race was also there.
A total of eight people.
As for the last faction.
It was led by the Little Giant Spirit King, accompanied by the Dark Divine Son, an Ogre Race legend, and two other strong figures from different races.
The Dark Divine Son and other powerhouses were evidently at odds with those in Elinora’s camp.
So they chose to follow the Little Giant Spirit King.
At this time, the three factions stood their ground against each other.
It seemed no one wanted to engage with the others.
Just then.
The twenty powerhouses on the field simultaneously lifted their heads.
They noticed from afar an extremely powerful aura surging towards them rapidly.
And when they saw the appearance of those auras.
"Human Race..."
The Little Giant Spirit King murmured.
The others also saw Han Xing and his group of five.
They knew very little about the Human Race.
And no one even knew when these five legendary humans unexpectedly appeared.
Furthermore, they had acquired a coveted ruin exploration slot.
After all, in the past centuries.
The Human Race had almost disappeared from the Holy Spirit Realm.
Not to mention a legendary powerhouse.
Not a single living person could be seen.
Moreover, Han Xing and his group’s rise was too rapid.
Throughout the Holy Spirit Realm, there were still too few stories about them.
The earth-shattering events Han Xing had undertaken were only spread among demigods or circles of divine spirits.
When Han Xing arrived, he also noticed the somewhat unusual atmosphere at the moment.
The three factions did not interfere with each other.
Nobody took the initiative to greet.
Of course, there was also the reason that they weren’t familiar with Han Xing.
At this moment, Han Xing was the first to break the silence, saying, "Are you all gathered here to enter this ruin?"
On the field, those Divine Sons and Daughters had strange expressions in their eyes.
But no one answered.
At this moment.
The Elf Race’s Divine Maiden, Elinora, gently stepped forward.
Before she could speak.
Beside the Little Giant Spirit King, a Two-headed Ogre suddenly emitted a sharp voice, saying: "You don’t even know the reason we’re here,"
"So don’t get involved, in case you lose your life, it’ll be a loss."
After speaking, the other head of the Two-headed Ogre mocked: "That’s right!"
"Looking at them like this, they won’t last long."
"If you ask me, just let us eat them up, to avoid wasting food."
After speaking, the two heads of the Ogre began to laugh loudly.
"Second Head, it feels like we haven’t eaten the Human Race in a long time."
"I’ve almost forgotten the taste of this race."
"Yeah, Big Head, I really miss it..."
Cheng Jianyong was just about to retort angrily.
But Han Xing stopped him.
At this moment, Han Xing asked: "Have you, eaten humans?"
The Two-headed Ogre was momentarily stunned.
Then said: "Of course! Big Head and I ate them hundreds of years ago."
"But ever since the Human Race became rarer in the Holy Spirit Realm, we haven’t tasted that delicacy again."
Its other head echoed: "Yeah, I’m almost drooling!"
"From the first moment I saw you, I wanted to swallow you all whole."
"I’ve never eaten a Legendary Level human!"
"I bet, it must be delicious!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing smiled.
Then.
Unexpectedly to everyone present.
He directly drew the bowstring and shot an arrow!
This arrow, too fast and too sudden.
The thirty-some Divine Sons on the field didn’t react at all.
They just saw Han Xing had already launched an attack!
"How dare you!"
"Stop!"
The surrounding Divine Sons and Daughters shouted angrily.
However, Han Xing’s attack had already been launched, how could it be taken back!
The Two-headed Ogre looked dazedly at the arrow flying towards it.
With its strength, it unexpectedly couldn’t react in time!
It had a premonition, if this arrow hit it,
even if it didn’t die, there was a risk of serious injury!
At the critical moment.
The Little Giant Spirit King suddenly swung a cyan-black giant axe.
Then, at an unbelievably fast speed, blocked Han Xing’s arrow with the axe’s body.
"Ding!"
A crisp collision sound made everyone’s ears buzz.
The Little Giant Spirit King was just about to speak.
Suddenly felt that the arrow had changed.
A fierce energy suddenly erupted.
"Boom!"
A violent explosion erupted!
It was the explosion effect triggered by the Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill.
When the smoke cleared, everyone looked at the figure in the smoke with astonished expressions.
The Little Giant Spirit King glanced at Han Xing in the distance, then at its giant axe.
The first wave of the arrow attack was still within expectation.
But the subsequent explosion had caught even the Little Giant Spirit King off guard.
"Interesting."
The Little Giant Spirit King praised: "That arrow even made me feel threatened."
However, the rescued Ogre Divine Son had an expression of shame and anger.
"Damn Human Race, you actually dare attack us!"
"Very well, we’re going to eat you now!"
Han Xing ignored the Ogre’s threat, looking towards the Little Giant Spirit King behind it, he said.
"If you, want to protect such trash."
"You better think about the consequences clearly."
"Here, I don’t care what kind of Giant Race Divine Son you are."
At this moment, everyone heard the threatening intent in Han Xing’s words.
Each looked at Han Xing with terrified expressions.
This guy, is he crazy?
He actually dares to threaten the Little Giant Spirit King!
After the Little Giant Spirit King’s eyes flickered for a while.
He suddenly laughed and said: "I have no intention of protecting it."
"It’s just that, here in the Ancient Ruins, it’s full of dangers."
"I think, since we all come from the Holy Spirit Realm, there’s no need for internal strife."
The Little Giant Spirit King’s words were quite reasonable.
However, everyone had strange expressions.
Everyone knew, this guy was notorious for his temper.
Now, being threatened in front of so many people, he actually managed to hold back and not explode.
And even acted as a peacemaker?
At this moment, everyone realized.
The Little Giant Spirit King seemed to have backed down.
They looked at Han Xing with somewhat strange eyes.
Was that arrow really that terrifying?
Could it actually make the Little Giant Spirit King admit defeat?

sentences.text: "There are a lot of red dots."
"It seems like the Divine Sons and Daughters of other races, they’ve all gathered together."
Han Xing was a bit surprised, "Gathered together?"
"Weren’t these guys all scattered around in recent days?"
"Why did they suddenly think of gathering?"
"Could it be that something there is attracting them?"
Everyone pondered for a moment.
Shen Yun then said, "Could there be a ruin there?"
Han Xing was taken aback, "Can a ruin accommodate so many people?"
Shen Yun shook his head.
Regarding this aspect.
They really weren’t very clear.
Han Xing thought for a moment, and continued, "Let’s go, let’s check out the situation too."
"Anyway, whether or not it’s a ruin, it doesn’t conflict with us."
Everyone showed a knowing smile.
Han Xing’s way of exploring ruins was different.
While they were still exerting effort dealing with the challenges of the ruins.
Han Xing had already skipped that step and started looting directly!
So, that group of Divine Sons and Daughters really had no conflict with Han Xing.
With those words, everyone sped towards the place where the red dots gathered.
From here, rushing to the location of the red dots, it was over 60,000 kilometers.
Even with Han Xing and the others’ speed, it would take at least six to seven hours.
Moreover
Han Xing discovered.
As everyone headed towards the congregation of red dots.
More and more red dots were already arriving there.
Roughly estimating, the number of red dots had surpassed 20.
This time, a total of only 100 people came in.
And just in that area, a fifth had gathered.
This indicates that there is certainly something there enticing them.
Four hours later.
Han Xing arrived near the gathering of red dots.
From afar, they saw an elliptical massive structure.
As tall as hundreds of thousands of meters.
This structure was the largest Han Xing had seen since entering this world.
Completely smooth, emanating a black glow.
Clearly, this was the material used to create ruins.
However, this ruin was at least tens of times larger than any previous ruins!
"Whoa... so big!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Han Xing nodded, "Indeed, very big."
Then, he cast his gaze further.
"Let’s go, I think I see them."
Han Xing continued to lead the group forward.
Not far forward.
Everyone saw on an open space ahead, more than twenty familiar figures gathered.
Among them, excluding those seven little Dwarfs.
Elinora from the Elf Race, the Bright Divine Son, the Little Giant Spirit King were all here.
These people seemed to be divided into three factions.
The seven little Dwarfs formed a faction of their own, with an aloofness that wanted to disregard anyone.
The second faction was led by the Elf Goddess and the Bright Divine Son.
Wan Liu of the Tree Spirit Race was also there.
A total of eight people.
As for the last faction.
It was led by the Little Giant Spirit King, accompanied by the Dark Divine Son, an Ogre Race legend, and two other strong figures from different races.
The Dark Divine Son and other powerhouses were evidently at odds with those in Elinora’s camp.
So they chose to follow the Little Giant Spirit King.
At this time, the three factions stood their ground against each other.
It seemed no one wanted to engage with the others.
Just then.
The twenty powerhouses on the field simultaneously lifted their heads.
They noticed from afar an extremely powerful aura surging towards them rapidly.
And when they saw the appearance of those auras.
"Human Race..."
The Little Giant Spirit King murmured.
The others also saw Han Xing and his group of five.
They knew very little about the Human Race.
And no one even knew when these five legendary humans unexpectedly appeared.
Furthermore, they had acquired a coveted ruin exploration slot.
After all, in the past centuries.
The Human Race had almost disappeared from the Holy Spirit Realm.
Not to mention a legendary powerhouse.
Not a single living person could be seen.
Moreover, Han Xing and his group’s rise was too rapid.
Throughout the Holy Spirit Realm, there were still too few stories about them.
The earth-shattering events Han Xing had undertaken were only spread among demigods or circles of divine spirits.
When Han Xing arrived, he also noticed the somewhat unusual atmosphere at the moment.
The three factions did not interfere with each other.
Nobody took the initiative to greet.
Of course, there was also the reason that they weren’t familiar with Han Xing.
At this moment, Han Xing was the first to break the silence, saying, "Are you all gathered here to enter this ruin?"
On the field, those Divine Sons and Daughters had strange expressions in their eyes.
But no one answered.
At this moment.
The Elf Race’s Divine Maiden, Elinora, gently stepped forward.
Before she could speak.
Beside the Little Giant Spirit King, a Two-headed Ogre suddenly emitted a sharp voice, saying: "You don’t even know the reason we’re here,"
"So don’t get involved, in case you lose your life, it’ll be a loss."
After speaking, the other head of the Two-headed Ogre mocked: "That’s right!"
"Looking at them like this, they won’t last long."
"If you ask me, just let us eat them up, to avoid wasting food."
After speaking, the two heads of the Ogre began to laugh loudly.
"Second Head, it feels like we haven’t eaten the Human Race in a long time."
"I’ve almost forgotten the taste of this race."
"Yeah, Big Head, I really miss it..."
Cheng Jianyong was just about to retort angrily.
But Han Xing stopped him.
At this moment, Han Xing asked: "Have you, eaten humans?"
The Two-headed Ogre was momentarily stunned.
Then said: "Of course!
Big Head and I ate them hundreds of years ago."
"But ever since the Human Race became rarer in the Holy Spirit Realm, we haven’t tasted that delicacy again."
Its other head echoed: "Yeah, I’m almost drooling!"
"From the first moment I saw you, I wanted to swallow you all whole."
"I’ve never eaten a Legendary Level human!"
"I bet, it must be delicious!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing smiled.
Then.
Unexpectedly to everyone present.
He directly drew the bowstring and shot an arrow!
This arrow, too fast and too sudden.
The thirty-some Divine Sons on the field didn’t react at all.
They just saw Han Xing had already launched an attack!
"How dare you!"
"Stop!"
The surrounding Divine Sons and Daughters shouted angrily.
However, Han Xing’s attack had already been launched, how could it be taken back!
The Two-headed Ogre looked dazedly at the arrow flying towards it.
With its strength, it unexpectedly couldn’t react in time!
It had a premonition, if this arrow hit it,
even if it didn’t die, there was a risk of serious injury!
At the critical moment.
The Little Giant Spirit King suddenly swung a cyan-black giant axe.
Then, at an unbelievably fast speed, blocked Han Xing’s arrow with the axe’s body.
"Ding!"
A crisp collision sound made everyone’s ears buzz.
The Little Giant Spirit King was just about to speak.
Suddenly felt that the arrow had changed.
A fierce energy suddenly erupted.
"Boom!"
A violent explosion erupted!
It was the explosion effect triggered by the Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill.
When the smoke cleared, everyone looked at the figure in the smoke with astonished expressions.
The Little Giant Spirit King glanced at Han Xing in the distance, then at its giant axe.
The first wave of the arrow attack was still within expectation.
But the subsequent explosion had caught even the Little Giant Spirit King off guard.
"Interesting."
The Little Giant Spirit King praised: "That arrow even made me feel threatened."
However, the rescued Ogre Divine Son had an expression of shame and anger.
"Damn Human Race, you actually dare attack us!"
"Very well, we’re going to eat you now!"
Han Xing ignored the Ogre’s threat, looking towards the Little Giant Spirit King behind it, he said.
"If you, want to protect such trash."
"You better think about the consequences clearly."
"Here, I don’t care what kind of Giant Race Divine Son you are."
At this moment, everyone heard the threatening intent in Han Xing’s words.
Each looked at Han Xing with terrified expressions.
This guy, is he crazy?
He actually dares to threaten the Little Giant Spirit King!
After the Little Giant Spirit King’s eyes flickered for a while.
He suddenly laughed and said: "I have no intention of protecting it."
"It’s just that, here in the Ancient Ruins, it’s full of dangers."
"I think, since we all come from the Holy Spirit Realm, there’s no need for internal strife."
The Little Giant Spirit King’s words were quite reasonable.
However, everyone had strange expressions.
Everyone knew, this guy was notorious for his temper.
Now, being threatened in front of so many people, he actually managed to hold back and not explode.
And even acted as a peacemaker?
At this moment, everyone realized.
The Little Giant Spirit King seemed to have backed down.
They looked at Han Xing with somewhat strange eyes.
Was that arrow really that terrifying?
Could it actually make the Little Giant Spirit King admit defeat?

chapters.title: Chapter 621 - 377: Slaying the Ogre, Primitive Ruins
paragraphs: The ogre seemed to want to say something.
"Little Giant Spirit King, this human..."
The Little Giant Spirit King glared at the ogre and spoke in a threatening tone.
"If you don’t want to die, shut your mouth."
"Otherwise, get out of my team."
Being threatened in front of so many Divine Sons and Daughters by the Little Giant Spirit King.
Both heads of the ogre turned somewhat reddish.
"Little Giant Spirit King, are you actually going to kick us out for these humble humans?"
"Do you know what you’re doing?"
The Little Giant Spirit King said sternly, "Do I need you to teach me what to do?"
He glared at the ogre.
However, the ogre race also has a fiery temper.
"How dare you threaten us!"
"Today, I’m going to eat these humans, see what you can do!"
The ogre’s expression twisted with anger.
Its other head echoed, "That’s right, that’s right, today we will eat these humans."
The Little Giant Spirit King looked at the two-headed ogre with an idiotic gaze, "If you want to die, I won’t stop you."
"Just right, we’re about to explore the ruin, I don’t want an idiot like you in the same team."
"So that you won’t get us killed."
The genes of the ogre can’t be changed.
Having not tasted delicious food for hundreds of years, seeing Han Xing and his group now.
It’s like a cat seeing a mouse, already wanting to pounce immediately.
At this moment, Han Xing calmly said, "That giant race one."
"After saying so much, can we finally make a move?"
The Little Giant Spirit King understood Han Xing’s meaning, nodded, and stepped aside directly.
Seemingly no longer wanting to intervene in this matter.
The nearby Divine Sons and Daughters watching were all stunned.
Is this the Little Giant Spirit King no longer caring about their matters?
Allowing this group of humans and the ogre to fight it out?
At this moment, both heads of the two-headed ogre were furious.
"Just a bunch of food, how dare they be so arrogant!"
It said excitedly, "Let me see, how you bunch with only Middle-tier Legendary power dare to attack me!"
"That’s right, big head, they’re too arrogant!
"As food, you should be eaten by us!"
As soon as the words fell, the two-headed ogre’s green body suddenly swelled significantly.
Turning into a bloodthirsty red.
Even vaguely exuding a Demigod level aura!
The eyes of the nearby Divine Sons and Daughters narrowed.
They knew, this two-headed ogre was serious now.
This secret technique, is one of the strongest talents of the Cannibal Race.
Bloodthirsty Fury.
It can greatly enhance one’s power in a short period of time.
Watching the charging figure of the two-headed ogre.
Han Xing glanced at it indifferently.
"Idiot."
For such a fool, Han Xing didn’t want to waste words on it.
He casually drew the bowstring.
Then, an arrow shot out.
The two-headed ogre’s eyes flashed with contempt, "You think you can deal with us using that trick again?"
"We now possess Demigod level combat power!"
"With just..."
Before it could finish speaking.
Its body was already covered in a layer of frost.
It was Zhang Lianmeng’s Legendary Skill, Ice Age.
At the same time.
The other team members launched their attacks.
Greenish arrows.
Whistling sword qi.
And large fireballs two to three meters in diameter.
The two-headed ogre, in despair, watched these attacks fall on itself.
Could only let out an unwilling roar.
"Damn it! Humans, you’re so despicable!"
"Bang!"
After an explosion.
The corpse of the two-headed ogre exploded into mince on the spot.
[Successfully killed Ogre Race: Gustine (High-tier Legend), gained Experience Value 7.432 billion, automatically absorbed the opponent’s Divine Power Value...]
On the field, everyone stared at the battlefield blankly.
A bizarre thought popped into their minds.
The Demon Son of the ogre race, just died like that?
Died so easily?
It was supposed to be the hope of the Ogre Lord, expected to breakthrough to Demigod in twenty years!
At this moment, everyone’s gaze towards Han Xing and his team changed.
At the same time.
At the moment this ogre died.
Outside the Ancient Ruins, the Dwarf King frowned.
"So soon, there’s already a Divine Son fallen?"
"In theory, the danger of the Ancient Ruins would only appear in the last month."
"Did something unexpected happen inside?"
Not only the Dwarf King.
In the distant Ogre Realm.
An aura with Demigod level strength rose violently.
It let out an angry roar.
"Who? Who killed my offspring!"
"Didn’t that dwarf say, nothing unexpected would happen?"
"Damn it! No matter who it is, I must get an explanation!"
On that day, a powerful aura was rapidly heading towards the Dwarf Kingdom.
In the Ancient Ruins.
After Han Xing and the others united in an attack, instantly killing the ogre.
The gaze of everyone present was somewhat peculiar.
Even the sinister aura-ed Dark Divine Son, who never showed his true face.
At this time, also cast a concerned glance at Han Xing.
Whether or not they had just joined forces to catch the ogre off guard.
As strong individuals, they could feel it.
The combat power inadvertently displayed by these humans should not be underestimated.
At this moment, Elinora gracefully walked over, came to Han Xing’s side, and softly reminded.
"Han Xing, the ogre you just killed is the offspring of the Ogre Lord."
"That Ogre Lord is notorious for being overly protective."
"When the ruins expedition ends, don’t mention you killed Gustine when you leave."
