chapters.title: Chapter 622 - 377: Slaying the Ogre, Primitive Ruins
paragraphs: "Otherwise, that old guy will definitely take the opportunity to cause trouble for you."
Upon hearing Elinora’s kind reminder.
Han Xing found himself with a changed perspective towards this woman.
He nodded, "Thank you, Divine Maiden, for the reminder. I understand."
Elinora still looked somewhat worried.
"The Ogre Lord is a Demigod level being."
"If things really don’t go well, you can follow me out when the time comes."
"I am the Divine Maiden of the Elf Race, it wouldn’t dare do anything to me."
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing shook his head and said, "There’s no need."
"Once we get out, we’ll find our own way to handle it."
This sentence was a gentle refusal of Elinora’s goodwill.
Elinora nodded.
Though she didn’t know what approach Han Xing had in mind.
But as a clever woman, she didn’t ask further.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly asked, "By the way, Nora Divine Maiden, what are you all gathered here for?"
"Are you planning to explore this relic?"
Upon hearing this question, Elinora nodded lightly.
"Yes, because this relic is quite special, so we are waiting here for people."
"Hoping to gather more powerful individuals to explore together."
Han Xing felt even more puzzled after hearing this.
Seeming to realize he was unaware.
Elinora explained slowly, "Han Xing, you should have explored other relics previously, right?"
"Yes, I’ve explored them."
Elinora nodded, "That’s easy to explain then."
"In the entire Secret Realm, there are many ordinary relics like those."
"The challenge difficulty of those relics is relatively low."
"However, there are only seven of such large-scale Primitive Ruins in the entire Secret Realm."
Han Xing was taken aback, "Are you saying this is one of those seven relics?"
Elinora replied, "Yes."
"These seven relics are very special."

"According to intelligence from the Dwarf Race, completing the relic challenge will not only reward a large number from the Insect Emperor Stone, but the minimum reward is a High-tier Ancient Weapon Blueprint."
"Sometimes, there are some special rewards."
"What are the special rewards?" Han Xing asked in confusion.
Elinora paused, then said one sentence.
Upon hearing this.
"What?"
Han Xing’s pupils instantly shrank!
"Did you say Godslaying-level Weapon?"
Elinora seemed surprised by Han Xing’s intense reaction.
Her body trembled slightly.
However, because of the size wrapped under her fine silk.
No matter how small the movement, it fiercely shook a few times.
Han Xing quickly turned his gaze away, coughing hurriedly, "Divine Maiden, please continue.
Elinora seemed to notice Han Xing’s gaze.
She did not feel shy; instead, a faint smile appeared at the corner of her mouth.
"There are Godslaying-level Weapons inside, which have already been confirmed."
"However, one must pass the ultimate trial of the relic to claim the final reward."
"Moreover, the reward is different each time."
"Sometimes, it’s a Godslaying-level Weapon in complete form."
"Other times, it’s a blueprint."
After listening to Elinora’s narrative.
Not only Han Xing, but also the eyes of the other four were filled with a heated desire.
They all knew what Godslaying-level represented.
It is a weapon capable of causing harm to Divine Spirits.
With the enhancements of Han Xing’s two stone tablets, it would only be more terrifying.
At this moment, Han Xing said, "Then what are we waiting for? Let’s start the relic challenge now!"
Seeing Han Xing’s eager appearance.
Elinora smiled and shook her head, "Starting the relic challenge is not that simple."
"Besides the Relic Energy Points reaching 5000 on us."
"Four groups must be formed, entering from four different directions."
"Each group will have between 1 and 20 members."
"Only when the trials from all four directions have been completed can the final relic trial be unlocked."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing suddenly came to a realization, "I see, it’s a team dungeon."
"What?" Elinora looked at Han Xing in confusion.
Han Xing shook his head, "Nothing."
"So, you are waiting here for people, right?"
Elinora nodded gently.
Then she lifted her beautiful eyes, speaking softly.
"Han Xing, if you also want to explore the relic together."
"You can join our group."
"My group has a few High-tier Legends, who can perform at Demigod level strength in critical moments."
"If you join us, we could easily pass the first stage trial."
After speaking, Elinora looked at Han Xing, her gaze still carrying a hint of expectation.
Faced with Elinora’s invitation.
If it were other Divine Sons and Daughters now, they would probably have accepted.
After all, the strength of the other groups is indeed good.
Joining them ensures safety and guarantees protection.
Han Xing pondered and asked, "May I ask, are there only three groups currently at the scene?"
Elinora nodded with a hint of doubt in her eyes.
"How are you arranging the last group?"
Elinora explained, "For the last group, we are waiting for other Divine Sons and Daughters to arrive."
"Once the numbers are about right, I plan to let Neotos brother lead a group."
Neotos is the Bright Divine Son.
Han Xing could see the other party could also burst with Demigod level strength.
Considered a formidable figure.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing asked again, "So you’re saying we’re still one group short."
"Wait until everyone is gathered to start, correct?"
Elinora hesitated for a moment but still said, "Yes, that’s correct..."
Han Xing nodded.
"Here’s the thing, we’ll form a group of five, and you won’t need to arrange other powerful individuals."
"Thus, the four groups will be complete."
"Once your numbers are sufficient, we can go in directly."
Upon hearing this, the other Divine Sons on the scene were stunned.
What was this human talking about?
They form their own group? Without needing other Divine Sons?
They thought they might have misheard.
Keep in mind, even if they agreed to let the Dwarf Race go alone.
It’s because they all have High-tier Legend strength.
Also, their numbers exceed these humans.
Yet they only have five members, and their overall strength is only at Middle-tier Legend.
The Divine Sons couldn’t help but question.
Where exactly did their confidence come from?
"Han Xing, are you sure you won’t reconsider?"
"The challenge difficulty of the Primitive Ruins is very high, and there’s a risk of falling."
Elinora advised.
Han Xing nodded, "No need to reconsider, it’ll just be the five of us."
"Everyone’s time is very precious."
"Let’s see, once you have enough people, start directly."
Elinora seemed to have more she wanted to say.
Behind her.
Bright Divine Son Neotos said, "Nora, since these humans are so brave."
"Then we should support them."
"Besides, they are right, our time is very tight."
"Even if they fail and are wiped out, we can just try again."
His tone carried a hint of amusement, seemingly not believing they would succeed.
Han Xing glanced at that guy.
The humanoid Bright Divine Son, under a head of golden hair, had a face that made others envious.
Noticing Han Xing’s gaze.
The Bright Divine Son’s mouth showed a shallow smile.
However, this smile appeared to Han Xing as somewhat unpleasant.
Han Xing said, "I don’t like the way you smile at me, it’s a bit insincere and disgusting."
"You better turn your face away, or I might not be able to resist putting an arrow through your head."
The Bright Divine Son’s face froze.
From his birth until now, no one had ever called his smile disgusting.
Including other Divine Sons and Daughters, who also looked at Neotos with strange expressions.
At this moment, a sense of humiliation surged from within him.
"What did you say?" Neotos demanded with concealed anger.
Han Xing spread his hands, "Don’t understand?"
"I said, if you keep smiling at me or can’t control your mouth."
"Then I’ll discipline you on behalf of your master."

Elinora explained slowly, "Han Xing, you should have explored other relics previously, right?"
"Yes, I’ve explored them."
Elinora nodded, "That’s easy to explain then."
"In the entire Secret Realm, there are many ordinary relics like those."
"The challenge difficulty of those relics is relatively low."
"However, there are only seven of such large-scale Primitive Ruins in the entire Secret Realm."
Han Xing was taken aback, "Are you saying this is one of those seven relics?"
Elinora replied, "Yes."
"These seven relics are very special."

"According to intelligence from the Dwarf Race, completing the relic challenge will not only reward a large number from the Insect Emperor Stone, but the minimum reward is a High-tier Ancient Weapon Blueprint."
"Sometimes, there are some special rewards."
"What are the special rewards?" Han Xing asked in confusion.
Elinora paused, then said one sentence.
Upon hearing this.
"What?"
Han Xing’s pupils instantly shrank!
"Did you say Godslaying-level Weapon?"
Elinora seemed surprised by Han Xing’s intense reaction.
Her body trembled slightly.
However, because of the size wrapped under her fine silk.
No matter how small the movement, it fiercely shook a few times.
Han Xing quickly turned his gaze away, coughing hurriedly, "Divine Maiden, please continue.
Elinora seemed to notice Han Xing’s gaze.
She did not feel shy; instead, a faint smile appeared at the corner of her mouth.
"There are Godslaying-level Weapons inside, which have already been confirmed."
"However, one must pass the ultimate trial of the relic to claim the final reward."
"Moreover, the reward is different each time."
"Sometimes, it’s a Godslaying-level Weapon in complete form."
"Other times, it’s a blueprint."
After listening to Elinora’s narrative.
Not only Han Xing, but also the eyes of the other four were filled with a heated desire.
They all knew what Godslaying-level represented.
It is a weapon capable of causing harm to Divine Spirits.
With the enhancements of Han Xing’s two stone tablets, it would only be more terrifying.
At this moment, Han Xing said, "Then what are we waiting for?
Let’s start the relic challenge now!"
Seeing Han Xing’s eager appearance.
Elinora smiled and shook her head, "Starting the relic challenge is not that simple."
"Besides the Relic Energy Points reaching 5000 on us."
"Four groups must be formed, entering from four different directions."
"Each group will have between 1 and 20 members."
"Only when the trials from all four directions have been completed can the final relic trial be unlocked."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing suddenly came to a realization, "I see, it’s a team dungeon."
"What?" Elinora looked at Han Xing in confusion.
Han Xing shook his head, "Nothing."
"So, you are waiting here for people, right?"
Elinora nodded gently.
Then she lifted her beautiful eyes, speaking softly.
"Han Xing, if you also want to explore the relic together."
"You can join our group."
"My group has a few High-tier Legends, who can perform at Demigod level strength in critical moments."
"If you join us, we could easily pass the first stage trial."
After speaking, Elinora looked at Han Xing, her gaze still carrying a hint of expectation.
Faced with Elinora’s invitation.
If it were other Divine Sons and Daughters now, they would probably have accepted.
After all, the strength of the other groups is indeed good.
Joining them ensures safety and guarantees protection.
Han Xing pondered and asked, "May I ask, are there only three groups currently at the scene?"
Elinora nodded with a hint of doubt in her eyes.
"How are you arranging the last group?"
Elinora explained, "For the last group, we are waiting for other Divine Sons and Daughters to arrive."
"Once the numbers are about right, I plan to let Neotos brother lead a group."
Neotos is the Bright Divine Son.
Han Xing could see the other party could also burst with Demigod level strength.
Considered a formidable figure.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing asked again, "So you’re saying we’re still one group short."
"Wait until everyone is gathered to start, correct?"
Elinora hesitated for a moment but still said, "Yes, that’s correct..."
Han Xing nodded.
"Here’s the thing, we’ll form a group of five, and you won’t need to arrange other powerful individuals."
"Thus, the four groups will be complete."
"Once your numbers are sufficient, we can go in directly."
Upon hearing this, the other Divine Sons on the scene were stunned.
What was this human talking about?
They form their own group?
Without needing other Divine Sons?
They thought they might have misheard.
Keep in mind, even if they agreed to let the Dwarf Race go alone.
It’s because they all have High-tier Legend strength.
Also, their numbers exceed these humans.
Yet they only have five members, and their overall strength is only at Middle-tier Legend.
The Divine Sons couldn’t help but question.
Where exactly did their confidence come from?
"Han Xing, are you sure you won’t reconsider?"
"The challenge difficulty of the Primitive Ruins is very high, and there’s a risk of falling."
Elinora advised.
Han Xing nodded, "No need to reconsider, it’ll just be the five of us."
"Everyone’s time is very precious."
"Let’s see, once you have enough people, start directly."
Elinora seemed to have more she wanted to say.
Behind her.
Bright Divine Son Neotos said, "Nora, since these humans are so brave."
"Then we should support them."
"Besides, they are right, our time is very tight."
"Even if they fail and are wiped out, we can just try again."
His tone carried a hint of amusement, seemingly not believing they would succeed.
Han Xing glanced at that guy.
The humanoid Bright Divine Son, under a head of golden hair, had a face that made others envious.
Noticing Han Xing’s gaze.
The Bright Divine Son’s mouth showed a shallow smile.
However, this smile appeared to Han Xing as somewhat unpleasant.
Han Xing said, "I don’t like the way you smile at me, it’s a bit insincere and disgusting."
"You better turn your face away, or I might not be able to resist putting an arrow through your head."
The Bright Divine Son’s face froze.
From his birth until now, no one had ever called his smile disgusting.
Including other Divine Sons and Daughters, who also looked at Neotos with strange expressions.
At this moment, a sense of humiliation surged from within him.
"What did you say?" Neotos demanded with concealed anger.
Han Xing spread his hands, "Don’t understand?"
"I said, if you keep smiling at me or can’t control your mouth."
"Then I’ll discipline you on behalf of your master."

chapters.title: Chapter 623 - 378: This Guy Is Clinging to Me?
paragraphs: "If you smile at me again, or can’t control that mouth of yours."
"Then I’ll discipline you on behalf of your master."
Han Xing’s words were utterly unforgiving.
Neotos, who had always been a favored child of the heavens, had never been so humiliated.
In an instant, a burst of killing intent erupted from him.
The atmosphere became tense, a scene on the verge of a confrontation,
At this moment.
The Dark Divine Son, standing behind the Little Giant Spirit King, laughed.
"Interesting, you’re called Han Xing, right? You humans aren’t bad at all."
"I also really dislike that guy’s fake smile."
"If Neotos bothers you, I’ll join you in action."
"Even if you kill him, it’s fine; I’ll handle the old guy from the Sea of Light if he causes trouble."
Han Xing smiled and said, "No need for that."
"If he’s dissatisfied, he can make a move now."
"As for the forces behind him, they’re not on my mind."
The Dark Divine Son listened, and the admiration in his eyes deepened.
The Bright Divine Son lost face publicly with the two of them, enraging him to the point of smoke rising from his orifices.
"Han Xing, Elaric, do you two want a death match with me?"
Han Xing looked at him with interest and said, "A death match? Are you sure?"
The Dark Divine Son also sneered and said, "Neotos, I only know you’re exceptional at fleeing, but I’ve never heard about how strong your combat abilities are."
"You won’t run halfway through the fight, will you?"
The Bright Divine Son immediately fumed.
He almost couldn’t contain the killing intent in his heart.
At this moment.
Elinora stopped him.
"Neotos, don’t forget why we came here."
Her tone was somewhat serious.
Hearing this, the Bright Divine Son clenched his fists.
After a moment, he could only swallow his anger and walked to the side alone.
The other Divine Sons and Daughters immediately knew,
This fight wouldn’t happen, and they all lost interest.
To be honest, they really wanted to see.
Between the Bright Divine Son and this human, who was stronger.
Han Xing shook his head.
Led his team toward the giant ruins.
As he passed by Elinora, Han Xing said,
"Divine Maiden, call me when everyone is here."
"Alright."
Elinora lightly nodded, a faint smile on her lips.
Then, Han Xing led his team and started exploring around the ruins.
At a good ten kilometers away from the Divine Sons and Daughters.
Cheng Jianyong quietly said, "Brother Xing, are we going to find the hidden door of this ruin?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
Everyone heard and their faces showed an expression of unsurprised realization.
Since it was known that there could be a Godslayer-level weapon in this ruin.
With Han Xing’s character, he certainly wouldn’t follow the rules and form teams for challenges.
If they could take the ruins completely in one go, that would be more his style!
Cheng Jianyong said excitedly, "This ruin is so large, the resources inside must be terrifyingly more than those other ruins, right?"
"If we could find a resource storage room, we’d instantly hit the jackpot!"
The eyes of the group also revealed a heated gleam.
Cheng Jianyong wasn’t wrong.
If they could find the resource storage room.
Considering the scale of this ruin, it would be equivalent to plundering a hundred ruins!
Most importantly, it had blueprints for a Godslayer-level weapon.
When the time comes, the harvest for Han Xing and his team would surpass what they found in the beast carcasses!
Of course, the premise was finding the resource storage room.
Thus.
The group began exploring the enormous elliptical ruin that spanned over ten thousand kilometers in diameter, resembling a flying saucer.
However, this ruin seemed different from any they had encountered before.
Han Xing went around four or five times, almost touching the surface walls of the ruin multiple times.
Yet he still hadn’t found any so-called hidden passage in the ruin.
Aside from discovering a few concave areas in the sky, there were no other findings.
Nevertheless, they didn’t give up and continued to roam around the massive ruin.
Far away, the Divine Sons and Daughters waiting appeared somewhat idle.
Those mechanical monsters were in a state of frenzy.
But they wouldn’t approach the ruins.
At this moment, the group of Divine Sons and Daughters watched Han Xing and his companions with puzzled faces.
"What are these humans doing?"
A petite girl who seemed like a flower sprite asked curiously.
The team members beside her shook their heads.
"We don’t know either."
"Maybe they’re just curious about the ruins."
"Or perhaps they’re seeing if they can find any treasures around?"
Their faces were odd.
These humans were clearly encountering such a large ruin for the first time.
This kind of mentality was also normal.
If it were before, someone would certainly jump out to sneer at them.
But now, after Han Xing had demonstrated his strength,
and publicly made the Bright Divine Son lower his head,
The Divine Sons and Daughters chose to remain silent, not daring to say more.
Time quickly passed by a day later.
Gradually, four or five other strong figures from various races arrived.
But Han Xing and his team had circled the ruins more than a dozen times.
Yet they still had no clue.
The five regrouped.
The team members looked at Han Xing, seemingly puzzled.
Han Xing lowered his head and pondered, "There are two possibilities."
"Either the hidden door passage of this ruin is so well concealed we can’t find it."
"Or there’s simply no hidden door at all."
A look of disappointment flashed in their eyes.
Because they knew, regardless of which possibility it was.

chapters.title: Chapter 624 - 378: This Guy Is Clinging to Me?
paragraphs: This means their idea of directly looting from the outside has failed.
They can only follow the rules and enter the ruins with Elinora and the others.
At this time, Han Xing looked towards the group of Divine Sons and Daughters in the distance.
As the day went by, the number of gathered people increased more and more.
A rough count revealed there were already over 26 people.
Including themselves, the total reached 31 people.
Nearly a third of the entire Secret Realm’s population.
At this moment, Han Xing heard Elinora’s ethereal voice calling by his ear.
"Brother Han Xing, the numbers are almost there, you can come over now."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing said to his team members.
"It’s about to start, let’s go over."
A few minutes later, Han Xing and the others returned to the open space.
After seeing that the numbers were about right, Elinora.
Composed herself and slowly said: "Everyone has arrived."
"Now, regarding the matter of the ruins challenge, I’ll say it one last time."
The Divine Sons and Daughters on the field listened attentively.
"As planned before."
"We will split into four groups."
"Seven elite members of the Dwarf Race will form a team on their own, challenging the southwest trial passage."
"I, along with the Bright Divine Son and other elites, will form a group of 10, challenging the northeast trial passage."
"Little Giant Spirit King and the Dark Divine Son, with a group of 9 elites, will challenge the east and west passages."
At this point, Elinora paused.
Then she looked towards Han Xing and his team.
"These Human Race elites will form a team on their own to challenge the southeast trial passage."
The newly arrived Divine Sons on the field still showed some doubt in their eyes.
They couldn’t help but whisper, "Isn’t the Elf Goddess holding a grudge against this group of Humans?"
"Letting these few Humans take on a separate direction, isn’t that sending them to their deaths?"
Next to them, other Divine Sons quickly interrupted these words: "Don’t make random guesses, it’s the request of those Humans."
"The Divine Maiden had previously proposed to assign some elites to them, but they refused."
"Refused?"
The newly arrived Divine Sons looked puzzled.
But seeing that no one else said anything.
They said nothing more.
Elinora scanned the crowd, asking, "Does anyone have any objections to this arrangement?"
"If you do, you can bring it up now."
The Dwarf Race legends snorted softly and turned their heads arrogantly to the side.
They seemingly didn’t want to converse with Divine Sons of other Races.
The Little Giant Spirit King said nothing.
The Dark Divine Son behind him spoke for him, "No problem."
Elinora’s gaze softened when looking at Han Xing.
Han Xing nodded.
Indicating that he had no issues either.
Elinora’s face showed a gentle smile once again.
"Since there are no issues, let’s prepare to start now."
At this time, Wan Liu, who had been following Elinora, suddenly raised his hand.
"Wait a moment, Divine Maiden."
Elinora turned around, looking at him quizzically.
"Divine Son Wan Liu, do you have something to say?"
Under Elinora’s gaze.
Wan Liu, with a youthful appearance, blushed, seemingly a bit shy to speak.
But he mustered the courage to say, "Um, can I join Master Han Xing’s team?
After saying this, Wan Liu lowered his head.
At this moment.
Not only were the other Divine Sons surprised, even Han Xing was a bit astonished.
He looked at Wan Liu, "Join my team?"
Wan Liu nodded, "Yes, I want to be with Master Han Xing."
"Before my grandfather left, he specifically instructed me."
"Outside, if I meet you, I should do my best to act with you."
"And he told me to do whatever you say."
These words might not mean much to other Divine Sons’ ears.
But to Elinora, they had a different implication.
As the Elf Race’s Divine Maiden, she naturally knew of the Holy Tree’s existence.
She also knew how strong this Ancient Tree was.
It was an entity that could be compared with the leaders of the three major Races.
It should be known, both the Dwarf King and the Elf King were already infinitely close to that level.
Far more formidable than ordinary Demigod Level beings.
However, in recent years, for some special reason, that Holy Tree had become extremely low-key.
The exact reason, though.
The Elf King had never told her.
From Wan Liu’s words, Elinora discerned.
That Han Xing and the others had interacted with this Ancient Tree.
Moreover, they had received special attention.
Even to the extent of giving up the Divine Son of the Tree Spirit Race.
Yes, they had given them up.
Allowing Wan Liu to obey Han Xing in everything.
Isn’t that saying, this young one from our Race, use him as you wish?
At this moment, Elinora looked at Han Xing with growing curiosity.
She found that she simply couldn’t see through this man.
And had no idea how many secrets he carried.
Shaking her head, Elinora cast these thoughts aside.
She continued asking, "Brother Han Xing, Divine Son Wan Liu has requested to join your team."
"We have 9 strong individuals on our side, with similar strengths."
"What’s your decision?"
Han Xing’s expression was peculiar.
If he allowed Wan Liu to join, it would disrupt some of his plans.
Han Xing was about to refuse.
When Divine Son Wan Liu smiled and said, "Lord Han Xing, my grandfather asked me to inquire."
"Regarding the tree spirit specialties from last time, were you satisfied?"
"If not, I’ve brought two more this time."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s expression became even more peculiar.
He naturally knew what Divine Son Wan Liu was referring to.
The Life Tree Heart of the Tree Spirit Race.
Something that could permanently increase Divine Power Value and Life Value.
Moreover, the item given by that Old Tree Spirit certainly wasn’t of low grade.
Looking at Wan Liu’s eager smile.
Is this guy planning to cling to me?
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing nodded.
"Alright, you can come over."
Upon hearing this, joy instantly appeared on Wan Liu’s face.
With a cheerful smile, he hopped over to Han Xing from Elinora’s side.
Elinora didn’t say much.
She directly announced, "Then, the operation begins.
Then.
The four squads proceeded towards the four directions of the relic.
While exploring the ruins, Han Xing discovered above the relic.
Roughly at the top, there were four entrances.
Corresponding to the four directions Elinora mentioned.
Since Han Xing’s group chose the southeast direction.
The five of them, together with Divine Son Wan Liu, headed over.
Before long, they reached the target location.
Everyone couldn’t help but lift their heads and look upwards.
Although.
The direction of those four entrances was somewhat high, located in an area several tens of thousands of meters above.
In the absence of Divine Power, they lost the ability to fly.
But this was not difficult for Han Xing.
He directly took out several bottles of Gale Secret Elixir from his backpack.
And instantly gained the ability to fly.
The strong individuals from the other three teams also.
More or less, had means to fly.
However, when all six of Han Xing’s group flew into the air.
Wan Liu suddenly said in confusion, "Eh? Why is there no voice broadcast?"
"What voice broadcast?" Cheng Jianyong asked.
Wan Liu replied, "It’s the voice broadcast of the relic."
"When we approach the passage, that voice announcement will automatically appear."
"It checks the Relic Energy Points on us and lets us confirm whether to enter."
Wan Liu looked at everyone, "Have none of you attempted a relic challenge before?"
After Wan Liu finished speaking.
Han Xing seemed to understand something.
They had long been blacklisted by the relic system.
At this moment, it was simply impossible for any audio prompts to appear.
Han Xing didn’t answer but said, "Let’s get closer to this passage door and have a look."
Saying so, everyone approached the passage entrance.
Here, there was a blue-grey circular door.
Behind it, seemed to be the inner area of the relic.
Since there was no voice broadcast, it was as if the relic had no intention of letting them in.
Wan Liu didn’t understand this and continued to explore above.
Gradually.
Han Xing’s brows furrowed.
Looking at the door in front, unable to enter.
Impatience arose in his heart.
At this moment, Han Xing said in a low voice.
"I really hate discrimination."
"If this passage won’t open, then I’ll use my own method to enter."
Han Xing’s words were not clearly directed at anyone.
But the team members understood his intention.
Wan Liu, however, was full of confusion.
His own method?
What method?
However, before Han Xing could pull out the Giant Beast Tail Spike and forcibly break through the passage.
A cold system prompt sounded once more.
"Detected life forms approaching Original Relic No. 5, inspecting the Relic Energy Points on the target."

As the Elf Race’s Divine Maiden, she naturally knew of the Holy Tree’s existence.
She also knew how strong this Ancient Tree was.
It was an entity that could be compared with the leaders of the three major Races.
It should be known, both the Dwarf King and the Elf King were already infinitely close to that level.
Far more formidable than ordinary Demigod Level beings.
However, in recent years, for some special reason, that Holy Tree had become extremely low-key.
The exact reason, though.
The Elf King had never told her.
From Wan Liu’s words, Elinora discerned.
That Han Xing and the others had interacted with this Ancient Tree.
Moreover, they had received special attention.
Even to the extent of giving up the Divine Son of the Tree Spirit Race.
Yes, they had given them up.
Allowing Wan Liu to obey Han Xing in everything.
Isn’t that saying, this young one from our Race, use him as you wish?
At this moment, Elinora looked at Han Xing with growing curiosity.
She found that she simply couldn’t see through this man.
And had no idea how many secrets he carried.
Shaking her head, Elinora cast these thoughts aside.
She continued asking, "Brother Han Xing, Divine Son Wan Liu has requested to join your team."
"We have 9 strong individuals on our side, with similar strengths."
"What’s your decision?"
Han Xing’s expression was peculiar.
If he allowed Wan Liu to join, it would disrupt some of his plans.
Han Xing was about to refuse.
When Divine Son Wan Liu smiled and said, "Lord Han Xing, my grandfather asked me to inquire."
"Regarding the tree spirit specialties from last time, were you satisfied?"
"If not, I’ve brought two more this time."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s expression became even more peculiar.
He naturally knew what Divine Son Wan Liu was referring to.
The Life Tree Heart of the Tree Spirit Race.
Something that could permanently increase Divine Power Value and Life Value.
Moreover, the item given by that Old Tree Spirit certainly wasn’t of low grade.
Looking at Wan Liu’s eager smile.
Is this guy planning to cling to me?
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing nodded.
"Alright, you can come over."
Upon hearing this, joy instantly appeared on Wan Liu’s face.
With a cheerful smile, he hopped over to Han Xing from Elinora’s side.
Elinora didn’t say much.
She directly announced, "Then, the operation begins.
Then.
The four squads proceeded towards the four directions of the relic.
While exploring the ruins, Han Xing discovered above the relic.
Roughly at the top, there were four entrances.
Corresponding to the four directions Elinora mentioned.
Since Han Xing’s group chose the southeast direction.
The five of them, together with Divine Son Wan Liu, headed over.
Before long, they reached the target location.
Everyone couldn’t help but lift their heads and look upwards.
Although.
The direction of those four entrances was somewhat high, located in an area several tens of thousands of meters above.
In the absence of Divine Power, they lost the ability to fly.
But this was not difficult for Han Xing.
He directly took out several bottles of Gale Secret Elixir from his backpack.
And instantly gained the ability to fly.
The strong individuals from the other three teams also.
More or less, had means to fly.
However, when all six of Han Xing’s group flew into the air.
Wan Liu suddenly said in confusion, "Eh?
Why is there no voice broadcast?"
"What voice broadcast?" Cheng Jianyong asked.
Wan Liu replied, "It’s the voice broadcast of the relic."
"When we approach the passage, that voice announcement will automatically appear."
"It checks the Relic Energy Points on us and lets us confirm whether to enter."
Wan Liu looked at everyone, "Have none of you attempted a relic challenge before?"
After Wan Liu finished speaking.
Han Xing seemed to understand something.
They had long been blacklisted by the relic system.
At this moment, it was simply impossible for any audio prompts to appear.
Han Xing didn’t answer but said, "Let’s get closer to this passage door and have a look."
Saying so, everyone approached the passage entrance.
Here, there was a blue-grey circular door.
Behind it, seemed to be the inner area of the relic.
Since there was no voice broadcast, it was as if the relic had no intention of letting them in.
Wan Liu didn’t understand this and continued to explore above.
Gradually.
Han Xing’s brows furrowed.
Looking at the door in front, unable to enter.
Impatience arose in his heart.
At this moment, Han Xing said in a low voice.
"I really hate discrimination."
"If this passage won’t open, then I’ll use my own method to enter."
Han Xing’s words were not clearly directed at anyone.
But the team members understood his intention.
Wan Liu, however, was full of confusion.
His own method?
What method?
However, before Han Xing could pull out the Giant Beast Tail Spike and forcibly break through the passage.
A cold system prompt sounded once more.
"Detected life forms approaching Original Relic No.
5, inspecting the Relic Energy Points on the target."

chapters.title: Chapter 625 - 379: Entering the Primitive Ruins, the Endless Trial Begins
paragraphs: "Detection complete, all life targets have relic energy points exceeding 5000, meeting the entry conditions."
"Do you want to enter?"
Upon hearing this prompt.
Everyone couldn’t help but smile.
Because they knew.
The system that controls the relic operation chickened out.
However, this also served as a reminder for Han Xing.
The relic operation system is intelligent.
At least, it could understand the threat in his words.
However, Han Xing was not afraid of it.
Han Xing replied, "Yes."
The next moment.
The door of this high-altitude passage slowly opened.
Revealing a metallic black passage behind it.
The six of them walked in boldly.
As soon as they entered, the cold voice broadcast resounded again.
"Detected primitive ruins, teams have entered all four passages, the relic trial is opening..."
At the moment the voice broadcast ended.
Han Xing and his team also noticed the surrounding scenes.
This place seemed like the interior of a metal box.
Square and four-sided.
The walls were extremely smooth.
At that moment, while Wan Liu was curiously looking around.
Han Xing suddenly appeared in front of him, extending his right hand.
Wan Liu’s eyes were bewildered, "What’s wrong, Lord Han Xing?"
Han Xing glared at him and said, "Don’t play dumb, where’s the stuff?"
Wan Liu seemed to instantly understand, hurriedly taking out two green objects containing strong life force fluctuations.
In an instant, the green light began to explode.
The entire space was filled with this surge of life force.
[Life Tree Heart (Demigod Level)]: After consumption, can permanently increase the maximum life value by 50,000 points, divine power value +500. (Maximum consumption times: 5/5.)
Han Xing looked at the item’s attributes in his hand, a hint of surprise appeared in his eyes.
Goodness, another demigod-level Life Tree Heart!
This thing can be consumed up to 5 times, and Han Xing had already consumed one before.
The effect of each piece is quite astonishing.
Han Xing unhesitatingly took the Life Tree Heart from his hand.
Then swallowed it on the spot.
The team members had no objections.
Instead, they curiously watched the changes in Han Xing’s body.
The immense life force contained in the two Life Tree Hearts,
At this moment, Han Xing’s height seemed to increase by another five centimeters.
His face became more youthful.
He almost reverted to the appearance of a 17 or 18-year-old teenager.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun marveled from the side.
"Wow, Brother Xing has become so young."
"In the future, calling him ’Brother’ in front of everyone might feel awkward."
The two said with peculiar expressions, a hint of jealousy in their tone.
Han Xing ignored them. After fully absorbing the energy contained in the Life Tree Hearts, a system prompt appeared.
[Successfully absorbed Life Tree Heart (Demigod Level) *2, maximum life value +100,000, divine power value +1,000.]
Han Xing could feel himself becoming stronger again.
The look in his eyes towards Wan Liu no longer held hostility.
It’s worth noting that Han Xing, at the very beginning, had secretly communicated with Shen Yun and the others.
As soon as they entered the relic, they planned to cover Wan Liu’s head with a sack and knock him out.
Now, it seemed unnecessary.
Looking at Han Xing’s gaze, Wan Liu again revealed a shy smile.
Unaware that he had just narrowly avoided being sacked.
Han Xing then asked, "Can I ask, is your grandfather that ancient tree?"
Wan Liu nodded, "Yes, Lord Han Xing."
"He greatly appreciates your help and mentioned that if you have time, he’d like you to visit the Sky Island Forest again."
Han Xing nodded.
"Then why did your grandfather ask you to follow us?"
However, Wan Liu looked puzzled and said, "I don’t know."
"Grandfather said, you might be the chosen people of this era."
"That is, people with powerful fortunes."
"By following you, there’s a chance to stumble upon various heavenly fortunes."
"At the very least, there would be no life-threatening danger."
Han Xing was speechless.
"Is this your grandfather’s exact words?"
Wan Liu nodded heavily.
"That old guy...
Han Xing couldn’t resist making a snide remark.
He understood the ancient tree’s intention.
It wanted to see if it could tap into their fortunes to gain resources for the Divine Son of the Tree Spirit Race.
At this moment, a thought re-emerged in Han Xing’s mind
to sack Wan Liu and knock him out.
However, this guy would be useful for the upcoming relic trial.
They could wait to finish the so-called ultimate trial before knocking Wan Liu out.
While they were talking.
A voice broadcast appeared.
"Primitive relics, endless trial initiation successful."
"Challengers, please enter the front passage and begin the first challenge."
Han Xing looked confused, "Endless trial? What does that mean?"
However, the relic system seemingly wouldn’t answer this question for them.
As the voice dissipated.
A wall in front suddenly vanished.
Revealing a pitch-black passage.
They exchanged glances.
"Let’s go." Han Xing said.
As soon as Han Xing and his team stepped into the passage.
The black door behind them sealed again.
"Endless Trial: The first stage has begun, challengers, please quickly reach the end of the trial passage."
"On the way, you will encounter various dangerous attacks; please proceed with caution."
The voice broadcast ended.
In the black passage ahead.
Suddenly, the sound of dense winds emerged!
When the team reacted.
They saw beams of energy.
With attack power sufficient to devastate legends, raining down like a storm upon them.
Should they be hit, even a high-tier legend might fall on the spot.
"Oh my god!"
Divine Son Wan Liu’s face turned pale with fright!
From his body, hundreds of branches instantly sprouted, seemingly trying to counter the incoming attacks.

chapters.title: Chapter 626 - 379: Entering the Primitive Ruins, the Endless Trial Begins (Part 2)
paragraphs: However, Han Xing directly said, "Move to the back."
Divine Son Wan Liu looked bewildered.
At this moment, he saw within Han Xing’s team.
A human knight clad in black armor, armed to the teeth, suddenly rushed to the front of the team.
In one hand, he held a seemingly simple and unadorned shield.
Then, he directly stood before everyone.
"Puff! Puff puff puff!"
Those energy beams, upon hitting this human knight’s shield, were instantly neutralized.
With a demeanor that seemed unfazed by the heaven and earth shattering!
Divine Son Wan Liu was stunned.
These attacks could instantly kill a high-tier legend, right?
Yet, this human blocked them effortlessly!
Is this guy a monster?
And at this moment.
Just then, this person dressed like a black knight, erupted with a burst of pure white holy light.
Then, he charged forward against the attacks in the passage.
"Brother Xing, let’s go."
Shen Yun’s voice came from ahead.
Han Xing nodded, "Let’s go, follow Shen Yun."
After speaking, the team followed Shen Yun, bracing against the storm-like attacks, and proceeded deeper into the passage.
Wan Liu seemed to have just regained his senses.
Seeing Han Xing and the others walk away.
His expression changed instantly, and he quickly followed them.
Meanwhile.
At Primitive Ruin No. 5, in the other three trial passages.
They all encountered the same scenario.
Except for that group of dwarves.
The other divine offspring were undergoing the so-called endless trial for the first time.
The first wave of attacks caught them off guard.
In an instant, several divine offspring were severely injured.
At the critical moment.
Bright Divine Son erupted in golden light, filling the entire passage.
The power of those energy beams was greatly reduced.
At this time, Alicia appeared holding a silver-white wooden staff.
With a gentle wave.
A large number of vines emerged ahead, further weakening the power of these energy beams.
This wave of crisis was resolved by both of them working together.
On the side of Little Giant Spirit King, the scene was completely different.
After the initial chaos.
Little Giant Spirit King instantly entered a berserk state, then shouted.
"Hey! Get out of my way!"
His massive body filled almost the entire passage.
Then, Little Giant Spirit King swung the giant axe in his hand, smashing all incoming attacks away!
"Ding! Ding ding!"
The incessant clashing of metal echoed.
The team members of Little Giant Spirit King exclaimed in astonishment.
"As expected of Little Giant Spirit King, this title is truly deserved."
"Yes, such frightening power, it feels like he’s almost reaching the level of a demigod!"
One divine offspring said in a low voice, "I heard that his father, the true Giant Spirit King, has reached the limit of a demigod."
"Infinitely close to that level, is it true?"
"It should be true; the rulers of the three great races in the Holy Spirit Realm are said to have reached that realm."
"But let’s stop discussing those levels of existence, let’s take care of what’s in front of us first."
The divine offspring quieted down.
Then, they followed Little Giant Spirit King’s figure and charged into the passage.
With Shen Yun holding the Giant Beast Shield, they traveled nearly ten kilometers.
Approximately ten thousand meters.
The intensity of the attacks ahead was no longer so fierce.
As they journeyed through.
The team was almost unharmed.
No matter how wild the attacks were.
Shen Yun alone with a shield was sufficient.
Finally, after a few minutes, they reached the end of the passage.
The team reappeared in a strange room.
The shape seemed to be a circular room.
The walls were still incredibly smooth, with no visible seams.
"The first stage of the endless trial has concluded, please wait for challengers from other areas to complete their challenges."
Upon hearing this prompt, a look of realization appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
It turned out they had to wait for other teams to finish their challenges before they could proceed to the next stage.
If any other team failed during the trial.
This meant teams from other locations would be forced to stop.
Until then.
They could only continue to wait.
At this moment, Han Xing began observing the surroundings.
He noticed the interior of this circular room looked completely enclosed.
The walls crafted from mysterious materials.
Han Xing suddenly shot an arrow.
The explosion from Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill drew everyone’s attention.
Then, Han Xing walked to the wall’s edge, precisely where he had attacked.
And discovered nothing had left any noticeable mark.
With Han Xing’s current power, a casual strike could severely damage a high-tier legend.
Yet, it only managed this much.
This indicated the wall’s materials were extremely advanced.
Shen Yun observing Han Xing’s actions seemed to understand.
He quietly asked, "Brother Xing, are you planning to use that thing to forcibly breach the trial space?"
Han Xing nodded, "I have considered that."
"However, I don’t know if doing so will affect the so-called final trial."
"Let’s observe what might happen first."
Shen Yun nodded.
A few minutes later.
A voice message appeared.
"All teams have completed the first stage challenge, now initiating the second stage challenge."
As the words fell.
Before them, a channel appeared again in the circular room.
But this channel seemed very narrow and cramped.
It was less than two meters long, and less than one meter wide.
Barely able to accommodate one adult.
"So small?"
Cheng Jianyong wondered, "If there’s a battle inside here, it’s difficult even to turn around!"
Everyone nodded.
But despite the complaints, they still had to go in.
With Shen Yun leading, Divine Son Wan Liu followed behind.
Then came Han Xing.
Everyone entered single file.
Upon entering the passage, the rear door closed again.
The inside became pitch black.
The team seemed to have entered an enclosed cave.
Suddenly, rustling insect sounds came from their ears.
Wan Liu couldn’t help but shiver and screamed, "Insects, I feel a lot of insects!"
"What kind of hellish place is this?"
This time, Shen Yun directly threw a holy light ball.
The passage was instantly illuminated.
Han Xing saw Wan Liu’s trembling body.
Feeling uneasy about this guy, he let him walk ahead.
Unexpectedly, Han Xing didn’t anticipate such cowardice.
At this moment, he stood frozen, afraid to move.
"What are you doing?" Han Xing asked.
Divine Son Wan Liu stammered, "I feel like a lot of eyes are watching us."
"It’s terrifying!"
Han Xing gave him a sideways glance.
"Stop screaming, just keep moving."
Despite these words.
The team remained vigilant.
Because they also felt eyes watching them.
Then.
Everyone felt a rapid crawling sound from behind.
"Rustle... Rustle..."
Walking at the back, Cheng Jianyong quickly turned his head.
But he saw nothing.
Next, bizarre events kept happening.
They felt crawling sounds becoming more frequent.
Some occurred behind, others to the left and right.
Some even appeared directly above their heads!
Wan Liu was utterly terrified, shaking all over, his face pale.
Were it not for being sandwiched in the middle.
He might have turned and fled.
In this eerie atmosphere.
The team moved forward for about ten minutes.
Suddenly.
Wan Liu felt a breath from above.
Unconsciously, he lifted his head.
Then, he saw a face with two antennae, insect-like features, looking at him.
The next moment, Wan Liu screamed loudly!
"Mom!"
"Grandpa, Dad, My God!"
"Help!"
Listening to his heart-wrenching screams.
Everyone was speechless.
Including Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang behind, barely holding their laughter.
At this moment.
The figure already lunged at Wan Liu.
Han Xing also realized what those watchful eyes were.
They were the mutating creatures from beneath the ruins’ seedling room.

At this moment, he stood frozen, afraid to move.
"What are you doing?" Han Xing asked.
Divine Son Wan Liu stammered, "I feel like a lot of eyes are watching us."
"It’s terrifying!"
Han Xing gave him a sideways glance.
"Stop screaming, just keep moving."
Despite these words.
The team remained vigilant.
Because they also felt eyes watching them.
Then.
Everyone felt a rapid crawling sound from behind.
"Rustle...
Rustle..."
Walking at the back, Cheng Jianyong quickly turned his head.
But he saw nothing.
Next, bizarre events kept happening.
They felt crawling sounds becoming more frequent.
Some occurred behind, others to the left and right.
Some even appeared directly above their heads!
Wan Liu was utterly terrified, shaking all over, his face pale.
Were it not for being sandwiched in the middle.
He might have turned and fled.
In this eerie atmosphere.
The team moved forward for about ten minutes.
Suddenly.
Wan Liu felt a breath from above.
Unconsciously, he lifted his head.
Then, he saw a face with two antennae, insect-like features, looking at him.
The next moment, Wan Liu screamed loudly!
"Mom!"
"Grandpa, Dad, My God!"
"Help!"
Listening to his heart-wrenching screams.
Everyone was speechless.
Including Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang behind, barely holding their laughter.
At this moment.
The figure already lunged at Wan Liu.
Han Xing also realized what those watchful eyes were.
They were the mutating creatures from beneath the ruins’ seedling room.

chapters.title: Chapter 627 - 380: End of the Endless Trial
paragraphs: These mutant variants possess the strength of Five-star Elite Monsters.
Aside from their terrifying appearance, their strength is not very formidable.
Because it’s not the first time encountering them.
So Han Xing and his team didn’t feel much fear.
Su Xiaoyang was the first to fire an arrow.
"Whoosh!"
The mutant variant rushing toward Wan Liu had its head penetrated instantly.
"Thud!"
The corpse, like an insect, fell to the ground.
Green and white liquids splattered all over Wan Liu, almost making him vomit on the spot.
At this time, Han Xing realized.
It turned out this passage wasn’t enclosed.
Above, there were numerous extremely concealed secret doors.
Inside these secret doors might connect to a network of passages.
These mutant variants were hiding inside, ready to deliver a deadly blow at any moment.
The monsters seemed to know they’d been exposed.
The next moment.
A terrifying number of mutant variants frenzied towards them from all directions.
Han Xing didn’t show them any mercy.
He directly ordered.
"Attack toward the passage entrance, kill all these insects."
The crowd immediately gripped their weapons tightly and launched attacks inside.
"Boom!"
Explosive sounds filled the air continuously.
The monsters inside hadn’t even appeared, yet they were eradicated within the passage.
The bombing continued.
Despite the dangers.
They reached the end of the passage, completing the second stage of the challenge.
Other teams did the same.
Although those insect monsters startled them,
luckily, the monsters weren’t strong.
Most were Fifth Turn Elite Level, the strongest barely Initial-stage Legendary Level.
Just enduring the initial panic period, the subsequent challenge wasn’t too difficult.
In a few minutes.
Voice announcements indicated that all teams had completed the challenge.
Then the third challenge began.
This time, everyone arrived at a huge space.
In the space appeared a High-tier Legendary Mechanical Monster.
Han Xing and his team collectively attacked, killing it instantly.
"Boom!"
The huge mechanical monster’s body fell heavily.
Then, everyone noticed.
Once this mechanical monster was defeated, its metallic parts instantly merged into the ground, disappearing.
Furthermore, there was no experience notification given after killing the monster.
The group frowned.
They seemed to not understand the reason behind it.
After waiting a few minutes.
The fourth and fifth challenges began immediately...
Moreover, the difficulty escalated significantly.
Originally faced with a single High-tier Legendary Monster, occasionally mixed with a few Middle-tier Legendary monsters.
Later, four or five High-tier Legendaries, plus dozens of Legendary Level monsters besieged everyone.
The battles grew increasingly tough.
Still, there was no experience reward.
They weren’t even allowed to dismantle the monster corpses.
They directly merged into the ruins.
Until the eighteenth challenge.
It was in a giant plaza-like space.
This time, they had to challenge ten High-tier Legendary Mechanical creatures.
Plus, one mechanical Tyrannosaurus reaching Demigod strength!
The intensity and scale of enemies even forced Han Xing to show some real skills.
As a meteor shower descended.
Zhang Lianmeng’s Ice Age erupted instantly.
All mechanical monsters on the field exploded.
When the voice announcement came, indicating the battle was over.
Everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but complain: "Damn it, we killed so many Legendary monsters, not a bit of experience given!"
"Making us work in vain?
Han Xing also felt it was somewhat strange.
Shen Yun approached Han Xing and said: "Brother Xing, do you think these monsters were never truly killed by us."
"They were created by the ruins through some means, reappearing in a new form after being defeated by us?"
Han Xing nodded, "It’s possible."
Otherwise, it’s impossible to explain why there are so many High-tier Legendaries in these ruins.
Counting the other four teams.
The number of High-tier Legendaries they’ve killed might be two or three hundred.
In the Holy Spirit Realm, it’s a considerable force.
Han Xing spoke at this moment: "Regardless, no experience means no experience."
"Let’s observe further, if things don’t work out, we’ll initiate the second plan."
"Before that, let’s take a rest and recover our energy."
Even though Han Xing and others were energetic, they began to feel some fatigue.
Let alone other Divine Sons and Daughters.
As the twenty-fifth ruin challenge began.
Difficulty surged once again!
At this moment.
On Elinora’s side.
Total nine strong clan members fighting against ten High-tier Legendaries plus one Demigod.
Moreover, various insect monsters continued to pour in from all directions.
Everyone felt chills run down their spines.
Elinora faced the Demigod-level mechanical monster alone.
The Silver Staff in her hands swung continuously, taking it aside.
The Bright Divine Son’s divine light illuminated all corners.
He battled five High-tier Legendary Mechanical Monsters alone.
With just the two of them, they bore half of the battle’s pressure.
But even so.
There were still five High-tier Legendary Mechanical Monsters remaining on the field, along with many more middle to low-tier legendaries.
Everyone felt bouts of powerlessness.
After a tough and lengthy tug-of-war battle.
Elena’s body emitted multi-colored dazzling light, then quickly gathered together.
She seemed to have unleashed an incredibly terrible skill.
Making everyone’s heart tremble on the spot!
Then, a highly formidable energy shockwave hit the Demigod-level mechanical monster!

chapters.title: Chapter 628 - 380: End of the Endless Trial
paragraphs: "Boom!"
A loud explosion.
The mechanical monster’s corpse shattered into pieces.
The strong contenders from various races showed signs of joy in their eyes.
Because the completion of the battle over on Eilena’s side indicated a change in the tide of war.
With her joining, the high-tier Legendary mechanical monsters began to be blown up one by one.
Finally, when the last high-tier Legendary mechanical monster died.
The twenty-fifth trial finally ended.
At this moment, apart from Elinora and the Bright Divine Son.
The others already bore injuries.
However, even the two of them felt waves of fatigue.
At this point, the Bright Divine Son Neotos breathed a sigh and said, "This time, the trial should be over, right?"
However, as soon as the words fell.
The system broadcast appeared again.
"Initiating Endless Trials, the twenty-sixth challenge."
The Bright Divine Son’s extended hand paused in mid-air.
Moments later, he could only say,
"Damn!"
They began the rounds of battle once again.
Until the fortieth challenge began.
On the side of the Giant Spirit King.
A Divine Son with a moose head was targeted by a Demigod-level mechanical life form.
Suddenly, an energy ball blasted out of the demigod-level mechanical monster.
The Giant Spirit King was too late to support.
He could only watch as the energy ball blasted toward that Divine Son.
In his terrified gaze.
A violent explosion rose up.
"Boom!"
This moose-headed Divine Son was blown to pieces on the spot.
Nothing remained of the body!
Thus, the first casualty appeared among the four crews.
"Damn it!"
The Little Giant Spirit King was furious.
He immediately activated a certain secret technique, causing his body to grow dozens of times larger.
Then, with his own power.
Dragging two demigod-level mechanical monsters, he fought in a chaotic melee!
"Die for me!"
The Little Giant Spirit King fell into a completely berserk state, wildly swinging the giant axe in his hands.
"Boom! Boom! Boom!"
Each axe stroke caused space to ripple with waves.
In fact, showing signs of rupture.
You know, this is not the Holy Spirit Realm.
In circumstances where Divine Power cannot be used, the fact that the Little Giant Spirit King achieved this.
Shows that he nearly broke through the limits of Legendary just with his physical power.
Therefore, it can be seen how terrifying the Little Giant Spirit King’s power is now!"
After a series of terrifying explosions.
These two demigod-level mechanical monsters disintegrated on the spot.
Then, he, in an even more fearsome manner.
Charged towards the battlefield of Legendary Level.
With the Little Giant Spirit King’s joining, the battle had no suspense.
After the battle ended.
The Dark Divine Son appeared behind him and said, "Little Giant Spirit King, things seem to be a bit off."
"According to the information we obtained earlier, the Dwarf Race would initiate the final trial directly after several battles."
"But now, we have fought forty battles."
"And it doesn’t look like it’s over yet."
The Little Giant Spirit King was calming down the boiling giant’s bloodline.
He turned his head and said softly, "You mean the information from the Dwarf Race is incorrect?"
"Don’t forget, they, like us, are undergoing relic challenges."
However, the Dark Divine Son said, "Yes, they are in relic challenges."
"But who knows if they have other methods?"
"After all, this Secret Realm has always been in the hands of the Dwarf Race."
"None of us here understand the Secret Realm as thoroughly as the Dwarf Race."
The Little Giant Spirit King asked confusedly, "You mean those Dwarves are screwing us over?"
The Dark Divine Son did not deny, "Just saying it’s a possibility."
After hearing this, the Little Giant Spirit King could not help but ponder deeply.
Then, he shook his head and said, "Shouldn’t be."
"Our Giant Race and the Dwarf Race just ended a war."
"In the Holy Spirit Realm, internal strife is forbidden, as established by the rule of the three major race kings.
"If the Dwarf Race wants to break this agreement, then they will be besieged by two tribes."
"I think these Dwarves wouldn’t dare to face such consequences."
The Dark Divine Son remained silent for a moment.
He seemed to also find the Little Giant Spirit King’s logic reasonable.
"Hopefully..."
Then, after over twenty more challenges.
There were casualties in the team again.
Two died on Elinora’s side.
Now only seven remained.
She too was pushed to her limit.
Even took out her little wooden boat.
Yet she still couldn’t prevent the deaths of teammates.
Looking at her companions’ corpses.
A strong sense of guilt appeared in Elinora’s eyes.
Nearby Divine Sons and Daughters stepped forward to console her.
After all, they knew it wasn’t Elinora’s fault.
Elinora regained her spirits.
She also realized this wasn’t the solution.
Already considering whether to showcase her strongest combat form in front of them.
When the eightieth challenge started.
Han Xing summoned Bear Spirit Gangtu, paired with the legendary skill Broken Moon, and shot an arrow that exploded a demigod’s body.
At this point, Han Xing asked, "Brothers, how many legendary skills are left?"
Everyone looked at each other, and reported theirs one by one.
Shen Yun first said, "Brother Xing, I’ve already used my legendary skill, only the Sun remains, can burst one more wave."
"I still have one Divine Demon Swordsmanship, can burst once more." Cheng Jianyong reported.
As for Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang’s legendary skills and Church Secret Technique.
They had already used them in earlier stages of the challenge.
Han Xing glanced at his own skill bar.
Burst skill, only one ultimate skill left - Sun-Destroying Arrow.
Plus the effects of several sacred artifact equipment.
It’s somewhat insufficient for a prolonged battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 629 - 380: End of the Endless Trial
paragraphs: At this moment, Han Xing asked, "The Legendary Points we got from repelling that guy last time, is it enough to draw a second skill?"
Everyone glanced at each other and replied in unison.
"Yes, it’s enough."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s face lit up with joy.
"Great, then let’s draw."
The four of them nodded simultaneously upon hearing this.
Then, they all began the process of drawing Legendary Skills.
A flash of white light flickered over them,
then surprise and delight appeared on their faces as they looked toward Han Xing.
Seeing their expressions, Han Xing knew.
The newly drawn skills must be extremely powerful.
They didn’t keep it a secret either.
They directly posted the four new Legendary Skills in the team chat channel.

[Legendary Skill—Descent of the Great Angels]: Summons the phantom of a six-winged Archangel, putting all enemies into Judgement state, increasing all allied units’ Attack Power by 100%, speeding up Life Force recovery by 100%, and all attacks carry the Holy Light Punishment effect.

[Legendary Skill—Heaven-Sundering Sword]: Concentrates all Power to slash a single enemy with the fastest and strongest strike, dealing Attack Power + Power * 500% damage, while the sword qi can deal Agility * 400% damage to enemies.

[Legendary Skill—Star Burst]: Summons a phantom of a planet, hurling it heavily at the target, then detonates the planet, causing the enemy to be stunned for one second, with the explosion damage equaling Magic Damage * 3000%.

[Legendary Skill—Tree of Life]: Summons the phantom of the Tree of Life, allowing all allies to recover Life Value per second equal to Agility * 120%, with an accompanying Life Domain effect (the damage any team member takes at once won’t exceed 50% of their Life Limit, and they can forcibly retain 1 Life Force when receiving fatal damage).
Seeing these four Skill Attributes,
Han Xing’s eyes also filled with delight.
It was obvious.
These four skills were very powerful, each with its unique traits.
Shen Yun finally drew a Legendary Level auxiliary skill.
From the skill description, the effect was terrifying.
Together with Su Xiaoyang’s Tree of Life, the group could nearly achieve an undying effect.
Zhang Lianmeng’s Star Burst and Cheng Jianyong’s Heaven-Sundering Sword didn’t need much explanation.
They were purely attack-oriented skills with incredibly terrifying damage.
Divine Son Wan Liu lay exhausted on the ground nearby.
Although he couldn’t understand what Han Xing and the others were saying,
he could sense that, somehow, these people’s strength had grown even more powerful.
It wasn’t an evident increase in Attributes,
but a deeper level of enhancement.
Similar to that of the Dwarf King, with an incredibly refined feeling.
At this time, Han Xing looked at his remaining Legendary Points.
[Remaining Legendary Points]: 273.
It had been a long while since he drew the third Legendary Skill.
After experiencing so many events, he finally gathered enough Legendary Points for the fourth skill.
Han Xing took a deep breath and said, "Now, it’s my turn."
[Do you wish to spend 200 Legendary Points to draw the fourth exclusive skill of the Wild Ranger?]
"Yes."
However, just as Han Xing was about to confirm,
a different kind of feeling arose,
this feeling wasn’t like drawing a Legendary Skill,
but rather similar to when Han Xing was learning the Ultimate Skill: Sun-Destroying Arrow!
Han Xing’s eyes widened.
"Damn... Could it really be an Ultimate Skill?"
As soon as he said that, a white light, as if crossing infinite spaces, appeared above Han Xing’s head.
At that moment, a massive amount of memories surged in Han Xing’s mind.
[Draw successful, Wild Ranger exclusive skill learned: Ultimate Skill—Endless Arrow Prison.]
As the system prompt ended,
a terrifying aura rose from Han Xing’s body!
It felt as if a Demon King from Hell had awakened!
Divine Son Wan Liu on the ground felt even more terrified and shocked.
Everyone looked at Han Xing’s transformation in astonishment.
Without seeing it, they also knew.
The skill Han Xing drew must be incredibly terrifying.
Han Xing directly posted the skill’s attributes.

[Ultimate Skill—Endless Arrow Prison]: Alters the surrounding environment to summon a hell of ten thousand arrows, reducing enemies’ mobility by 80% and forcibly sealing divine power. (Ineffective against True God level creatures)

All arrows of the Wild Ranger have their Attack Power increased by 500%, the Endless Arrow Rain lasts 60 seconds, and for every enemy killed, the duration extends by 5 seconds (maximum limit of 300 seconds).
No doubt.
This Ultimate Skill was extremely terrifying.
Solely by the attack coefficient, it had already surpassed the Sun-Destroying Arrow.
Additionally, it came with a control and divine power sealing effect.
It could be said that Han Xing now has another powerful trump card!
"Hiss! Truly terrifying!"
Cheng Jianyong marveled endlessly, "Is this what an Ultimate Skill is? It’s countless times more impressive than a Legendary Skill!"
The look of excitement appeared in the eyes of the other people as well.
Han Xing’s growth made them feel immensely gratified.
At this moment, Shen Yun remarked, "Brother Xing, now that we’ve all drawn new skills, shouldn’t we be able to persist through at least ten more challenge levels?"
However, upon hearing the broadcast, Han Xing shook his head directly.
"We can’t keep going on like this."
"We’ve already gone through eighty challenges."
"We still don’t know how many more trials lie ahead."
"Even if we could last until the end, we’d probably have barely any skills left."
"As for the ultimate trial, it’s even more out of the question."
"Besides, I have a feeling these challenges seem to be infinite."
Upon hearing this, thoughtful expressions appeared in their eyes.
At this moment, Divine Son Wan Liu couldn’t help but get up from the ground and say, "Lord Han Xing, do you have any solution?"
Han Xing shrugged, "No."
"However, if it’s truly like how I described, with these limitless challenge phases."
"Then I don’t mind employing some violent means."
Wan Liu was puzzled.
Han Xing’s violent means naturally meant taking out the Beast’s Tail Spike.
And then begin massive destruction.
He didn’t believe that if they demolished the relic, the challenge could continue.
It seemed almost as if the remnant heard Han Xing’s threat.
The relic challenge ceased on the 82nd attempt.
A different kind of system voice broadcast appeared.

A flash of white light flickered over them,
then surprise and delight appeared on their faces as they looked toward Han Xing.
Seeing their expressions, Han Xing knew.
The newly drawn skills must be extremely powerful.
They didn’t keep it a secret either.
They directly posted the four new Legendary Skills in the team chat channel.

[Legendary Skill—Descent of the Great Angels]: Summons the phantom of a six-winged Archangel, putting all enemies into Judgement state, increasing all allied units’ Attack Power by 100%, speeding up Life Force recovery by 100%, and all attacks carry the Holy Light Punishment effect.

[Legendary Skill—Heaven-Sundering Sword]: Concentrates all Power to slash a single enemy with the fastest and strongest strike, dealing Attack Power + Power * 500% damage, while the sword qi can deal Agility * 400% damage to enemies.

[Legendary Skill—Star Burst]: Summons a phantom of a planet, hurling it heavily at the target, then detonates the planet, causing the enemy to be stunned for one second, with the explosion damage equaling Magic Damage * 3000%.

[Legendary Skill—Tree of Life]: Summons the phantom of the Tree of Life, allowing all allies to recover Life Value per second equal to Agility * 120%, with an accompanying Life Domain effect (the damage any team member takes at once won’t exceed 50% of their Life Limit, and they can forcibly retain 1 Life Force when receiving fatal damage).
Seeing these four Skill Attributes,
Han Xing’s eyes also filled with delight.
It was obvious.
These four skills were very powerful, each with its unique traits.
Shen Yun finally drew a Legendary Level auxiliary skill.
From the skill description, the effect was terrifying.
Together with Su Xiaoyang’s Tree of Life, the group could nearly achieve an undying effect.
Zhang Lianmeng’s Star Burst and Cheng Jianyong’s Heaven-Sundering Sword didn’t need much explanation.
They were purely attack-oriented skills with incredibly terrifying damage.
Divine Son Wan Liu lay exhausted on the ground nearby.
Although he couldn’t understand what Han Xing and the others were saying,
he could sense that, somehow, these people’s strength had grown even more powerful.
It wasn’t an evident increase in Attributes,
but a deeper level of enhancement.
Similar to that of the Dwarf King, with an incredibly refined feeling.
At this time, Han Xing looked at his remaining Legendary Points.
[Remaining Legendary Points]: 273.
It had been a long while since he drew the third Legendary Skill.
After experiencing so many events, he finally gathered enough Legendary Points for the fourth skill.
Han Xing took a deep breath and said, "Now, it’s my turn."
[Do you wish to spend 200 Legendary Points to draw the fourth exclusive skill of the Wild Ranger?]
"Yes."
However, just as Han Xing was about to confirm,
a different kind of feeling arose,
this feeling wasn’t like drawing a Legendary Skill,
but rather similar to when Han Xing was learning the Ultimate Skill: Sun-Destroying Arrow!
Han Xing’s eyes widened.
"Damn...
Could it really be an Ultimate Skill?"
As soon as he said that, a white light, as if crossing infinite spaces, appeared above Han Xing’s head.
At that moment, a massive amount of memories surged in Han Xing’s mind.
[Draw successful, Wild Ranger exclusive skill learned: Ultimate Skill—Endless Arrow Prison.]
As the system prompt ended,
a terrifying aura rose from Han Xing’s body!
It felt as if a Demon King from Hell had awakened!
Divine Son Wan Liu on the ground felt even more terrified and shocked.
Everyone looked at Han Xing’s transformation in astonishment.
Without seeing it, they also knew.
The skill Han Xing drew must be incredibly terrifying.
Han Xing directly posted the skill’s attributes.

[Ultimate Skill—Endless Arrow Prison]: Alters the surrounding environment to summon a hell of ten thousand arrows, reducing enemies’ mobility by 80% and forcibly sealing divine power. (Ineffective against True God level creatures)

All arrows of the Wild Ranger have their Attack Power increased by 500%, the Endless Arrow Rain lasts 60 seconds, and for every enemy killed, the duration extends by 5 seconds (maximum limit of 300 seconds).
No doubt.
This Ultimate Skill was extremely terrifying.
Solely by the attack coefficient, it had already surpassed the Sun-Destroying Arrow.
Additionally, it came with a control and divine power sealing effect.
It could be said that Han Xing now has another powerful trump card!
"Hiss!
Truly terrifying!"
Cheng Jianyong marveled endlessly, "Is this what an Ultimate Skill is?
It’s countless times more impressive than a Legendary Skill!"
The look of excitement appeared in the eyes of the other people as well.
Han Xing’s growth made them feel immensely gratified.
At this moment, Shen Yun remarked, "Brother Xing, now that we’ve all drawn new skills, shouldn’t we be able to persist through at least ten more challenge levels?"
However, upon hearing the broadcast, Han Xing shook his head directly.
"We can’t keep going on like this."
"We’ve already gone through eighty challenges."
"We still don’t know how many more trials lie ahead."
"Even if we could last until the end, we’d probably have barely any skills left."
"As for the ultimate trial, it’s even more out of the question."
"Besides, I have a feeling these challenges seem to be infinite."
Upon hearing this, thoughtful expressions appeared in their eyes.
At this moment, Divine Son Wan Liu couldn’t help but get up from the ground and say, "Lord Han Xing, do you have any solution?"
Han Xing shrugged, "No."
"However, if it’s truly like how I described, with these limitless challenge phases."
"Then I don’t mind employing some violent means."
Wan Liu was puzzled.
Han Xing’s violent means naturally meant taking out the Beast’s Tail Spike.
And then begin massive destruction.
He didn’t believe that if they demolished the relic, the challenge could continue.
It seemed almost as if the remnant heard Han Xing’s threat.
The relic challenge ceased on the 82nd attempt.
A different kind of system voice broadcast appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 630 - 381: Frozen Star Cannon Blueprint, Interrogation!
paragraphs: A different kind of voice announcement appeared.
"Attention challengers, you have completed all challenges. Please proceed to the end of the passage to claim your rewards."
Upon hearing this, everyone raised their heads.
Including Elinora and the Little Giant Spirit King over there.
Their eyes, which had been full of despair,
suddenly turned incredibly joyful at this moment!
At the end of the four passages,
a large black chest appeared.
This chest, compared to the previous ruin challenges, is at least five or six times larger.
Elinora took a deep breath, forced herself to stay spirited, and said, "It’s over."
"We finally succeeded!"
The remaining Divine Sons and Daughters couldn’t help but cheer loudly at this moment!
"That’s great!"
"Long live the Divine Maiden!"
"Long live the Bright Divine Son!"
They knew that without Elinora and the Bright Divine Son,
everyone would have had no hope of passing through.
For a moment, their eyes looking at Elinora were filled with intense admiration!
It was the same situation over on the side of the Little Giant Spirit King.
Finding life in desperate circumstances made everyone feel incredibly happy.
In the trial passage where Han Xing was.
He led his team to the end of the passage first.
Upon seeing the large black chest,
Wan Liu’s eyes lit up, instinctively wanting to rush over and open the chest.
However, he remembered Han Xing and the others were still there,
and sheepishly backed away.
Han Xing didn’t mind.
He walked over directly and opened the chest.
Inside, there was an abundance of Insect Emperor Stones and Calamity Divine Gold.
On top of that, there were also a few bottles of crystal-clear potions and ancient weapons.
And a yellowed blueprint.
At a glance, there were at least seventy to eighty thousand Insect Emperor Stones.
Wan Liu’s eyes widened instantly, exclaiming,
"Oh my God! So many Insect Emperor Stones and Calamity Divine Gold!"
Wan Liu probably hadn’t seen so many precious materials before and couldn’t stop exclaiming.
If it had been earlier, Han Xing and his team might have been excited too.
But having raided so many ruins’ lairs,
Han Xing was no longer very interested in these materials.
In the eager gaze of Wan Liu, Han Xing directly collected everything inside.
[Acquired 88,746 Insect Emperor Stones, 437 Calamity Divine Gold, 5 Improved Genetic Enhancement Potions, Initial-tier Ancient Weapon... ]
[Acquired High-tier Ancient Weapon Blueprint: Frozen Star Cannon... ]
"Frozen Star Cannon..."
A slight smile appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
Since entering the ruins, the first High-tier Ancient Weapon Blueprint.
Finally obtained!
Previously, in those ruins, most of what was found were completed Ancient Weapons.
A small number of Initial-tier and Middle-tier Ancient Weapon Blueprints.
In this so-called Original No. 5 Ruin,
finally obtained a blueprint comparable to the [Spiritual Godslaying Cannon].
[Frozen Star Cannon], just the name sounds impressive!
Han Xing first put the blueprint away, planning to inspect it later after leaving.
Then, he waved his hand, leaving a large pile of Insect Emperor Stones and a bottle of Genetic Enhancement Potion in front of Wan Liu.
Wan Liu asked in confusion, "Master Han Xing... what’s this?"
Han Xing laughed, "What do you mean, what’s this? Of course, it’s the loot sharing."
"Here are twenty thousand Insect Emperor Stones."
"The Calamity Divine Gold is useful to me, so I’ll give you more Insect Emperor Stones, is that okay with you?"
Of course, even if Wan Liu had objections, it wouldn’t matter.
Because Han Xing wasn’t going to share the Calamity Divine Gold.
Looking at the pile of materials in front of him, Wan Liu quickly shook his head, "Master Han Xing, I can’t take these!"
"I didn’t contribute much, I just followed behind you the whole time."
"You give me so much all at once, I’m afraid you want to sell me.
Han Xing, upon hearing this, rolled his eyes at him in an instant.
"What the hell are you saying?"
"Why would I sell you?"
"If I want to sell, it would be your grandpa."
"He’s got a lot of Demigod-level Life Tree Hearts on him, those are valuable."
"Master Han Xing, you jest."
Wan Liu chuckled a few times, not taking Han Xing’s joking words to heart.
What he didn’t know was,
Han Xing was serious.
He truly wanted to get the Life Tree Hearts from the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots.
Their effect was just too good.
Han Xing had eaten three, and his Divine Power Value and Life Value had skyrocketed.
According to the system’s description, he could eat two more.
He could enhance himself further.
Moreover, Han Xing wanted to get a few for his team members to enhance together.
Who knows if that Ancient Tree has enough Life Tree Hearts.
Han Xing brought his thoughts back, looking at Wan Liu and said, "Just take it."
Wan Liu nodded and no longer refused.
He extended a thin, long branch and swept the ground.
The pile of Insect Emperor Stones and Genetic Enhancement Potion instantly disappeared.
At this time, Wan Liu, holding the Genetic Enhancement Potion, said, "I think my grandpa mentioned this."
"It’s a potion that can enhance physical strength."
Han Xing laughed, "If you want to become like those insects, you can give it a try."
However, upon hearing this, Wan Liu shook his head and replied.
"No, Master Han Xing."
"Our race has traded with the Dwarf Race for this potion many times before."
"We also know that this potion has a mutation risk."
"But,"
At this point, Wan Liu paused.
"But, our race discovered a special method to effectively reduce, even eliminate, the mutation chance of this potion."
Han Xing was stunned in place upon hearing this.
"What did you say? No mutation?" His tone carried a hint of shock.
