chapters.title: Chapter 631 - 381: Frozen Star Cannon Blueprints, Interrogation! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Wan Liu seemed to know that Han Xing would be surprised.
With a bit of smugness, he said, "Yes."
"The method is to use the Life Tree Heart of our race to neutralize it."
"The powerful life force contained in the Heart will dilute the unstable factors in the potion."
"This is a small secret secretly researched by our Tree Spirit Race."
"Not even the Dwarf Race knows about it."
Wan Liu’s tone was very confident.
"Moreover, it doesn’t require a particularly strong Life Tree Heart."
"For this kind of potion, only one Four-star Dominator Level Life Tree Heart is needed."
When he finished speaking,
Han Xing gave this guy a deep look.
Indeed, there are no fools in this world.
Even if that Ancient Tree was eroded by the Curse, unable to move for so many years,
it still seeks ways to improve itself.
Even the Dwarf Race doesn’t know that the Life Tree Heart can reduce the mutation probability,
yet they discovered it.
At this time,
a voice broadcast reappeared: "The endless trial has ended."
"All challengers, please proceed to the central laboratory ahead to begin the final trial, or choose to leave the current ruins."
A deep tunnel appeared again in front of Han Xing.
Everyone looked at Han Xing.
Han Xing said directly, "Let’s go, enter."
Then, the six of them stepped into the tunnel together.
After walking for more than ten minutes,
a vast scene finally appeared before them.
It seemed to be a large laboratory plaza.
Some old instruments were placed on both sides.
Just as the six of them stepped into the laboratory plaza,
the passage behind them disappeared again.
At this moment, Han Xing realized something.
This relic absolutely possesses extremely advanced technological means.
Not only can it infinitely create mechanical puppets with Demigod Level combat power,
it can also change the terrain at will.
At this time,
three other passages appeared out of thin air in three different directions.
These were the other three waves of teams.
When the strong individuals of various races stepped out together,
the passage behind them closed.
Han Xing noticed.
Elinora and Little Giant Spirit King, their faces were tired.
Moreover, the number of people had decreased.
About four fewer people were with Elinora.
Three fewer people were with Little Giant Spirit King.
That means,
the 82 trials
caused the loss of seven strong individuals.
Moreover, these strong individuals were all important figures from various races.
If those strong individuals from major races had any sense of it,
they would probably be frantic by now!
However, the few dwarves didn’t suffer any casualties.
And there weren’t many injuries on them either.
Noticing Han Xing’s gaze,
those small dwarves looked over too.
Then, with an interested look, they sized up Han Xing.
As if seeing Han Xing and his group unharmed was a bit surprising.
Other people’s eyes revealed a more shocked look.
This Human Race group actually completed the trial.
Moreover, without any reduction in numbers!
As individuals with firsthand experience of the 82 challenges,
they clearly knew how insanely difficult this relic trial was.
And this also indicated,
the strength of this Human Race group far exceeded everyone’s expectations.
Elinora, with a tone of greeting, said, "Han Xing, are you all okay?"
Han Xing nodded.
"That’s good."
Elinora breathed a sigh of relief.
Han Xing gradually shifted his gaze away from the dwarves.
At this moment, a voice broadcast appeared.
"All challengers, please note, you have successfully passed the endless trial, and your strength has been recognized by the No. 5 Primitive Ruins."
"Now, you can choose to begin the final trial, or choose to give up."
"Teams choosing to give up can leave the No. 5 Primitive Ruins via the teleportation channel."
After the broadcast ended,
a dark purple teleportation channel appeared in the distance.
Through that channel, everyone could leave directly.
At this moment, the four teams fell into silence.
No one spoke.
Compared to the confidence at the beginning,
the 82 endless trials left them exhausted.
Also wiping out the determination in their hearts.
On one side, a few dwarven legends exchanged a glance.
One dwarf holding a chain hammer was the first to speak, "Everyone, shall we continue?"
"After all the challenges we went through before, shouldn’t we see it to the end?"
Elinora thought for a moment and asked, "Brother Gulichi, do you know what the ultimate challenge is like?"
"How difficult is it?"
Elinora asked the question everyone most wanted to know.
However, that dwarf just shook his head and said, "I don’t really know either."
"We only know that the challenge difficulty of the final trial varies each time."
"Like this endless trial, the last time we came in there were only over twenty trials."
"But now, it suddenly surged to over eighty."
Hearing this, a thoughtful look appeared in everyone’s eyes.
For a moment, there was still some hesitation.
At this moment, the dwarven legend spoke again, "However, I suggest we give it a try."
"After all, the ultimate challenge likely has Godslaying-level weapons!"
"Those are divine artifacts that can enhance the heritage of a race."
Hearing the name Godslaying-level weapons,
everyone seemed persuaded by this dwarf.
They all began to waver.
At this moment, the Bright Divine Son stepped forward and said, "I choose to begin the final trial."
Upon hearing this, the small dwarves looked at the Bright Divine Son with an appreciative gaze.
"Neotos, very good, brave enough."

chapters.title: Chapter 632 - 381: Frozen Star Cannon Blueprints, Interrogation!
paragraphs: The Bright Divine Son had no reaction to the Dwarves’ praises.
Behind the Bright Divine Son, several strong warriors of various races also chose to start the trial.
The Bright Divine Son looked at Elinora.
Here, her reputation could be said to surpass everyone else.
As long as she agreed, then there would basically be no problem.
At this moment, Elinora was still hesitating.
It was right then.
A voice suddenly rang out.
"I’m not going anymore, you guys play yourselves."
Upon hearing these words, warriors of various races cast their eyes.
They found that the speaker was that member of the Human Race.
For a moment, their eyes showed surprise.
After all, they had barely made it through the team trial.
They had made considerable sacrifices to reach this point.
And this human, is he really saying give up just like that?
"Brother Han Xing, it’s already come to this. Are you sure you want to give up?" Elinora asked.
Han Xing nodded without hesitation.
"That’s right, I give up."
"Have you even thought about it? The endless trials before were already so difficult, and there’s still the ultimate challenge."
"At that time, even if you succeed in the challenge, how many will survive?"
The Bright Divine Son listened and asked, "Are you scared?"
"Weren’t you all quite arrogant in the beginning?"
Han Xing shrugged, indifferent, "If you say so, then maybe."
"Anyway, I don’t want to continue with this boring trial."
In Han Xing’s eyes.
No matter how tempting the challenge rewards, it’s pointless if you can’t survive to get them.
Moreover, he had already entered the ruins.
Next, he needed to find those hidden passages.
Then break them open.
Find the resource storeroom of the ruins and take it all at once.
No need to fight to the death here with them.
After speaking, Han Xing led his team and turned towards the teleportation array.
The Bright Divine Son still wanted to say something.
But before he could speak.
Beside him, the Dark Divine Son and the Little Giant Spirit King exchanged a glance.
They spoke together.
"We give up too."
At this moment, Elinora and the group of Dwarves were quite surprised.
Other strong warriors from various races also looked on with doubt, towards
Elinora asked, "Brother Elaric, what’s happening?"
"Given your character, you wouldn’t give up so easily, right?"
She was speaking to the Dark Divine Son.
However, the Dark Divine Son looked at Elinora and smiled, "Nothing really happened."
"Just feeling somewhat overextended."
"If we forcibly take what we can’t handle."
"It might cost us our lives."
The Bright Divine Son’s eyelids twitched.
He knew Elaric was referring to him.
The Little Giant Spirit King said, "I have the same thought."
After speaking, he left with the Dark Divine Son.
So many experts left all at once.
Strong warriors from various races on the scene felt a wave of unease.
In their hearts, the thought of giving up emerged once more.
Just then, a few Dwarf Race warriors said,
"Dark Divine Son, Little Giant Spirit King!"
"What are you guys playing at?"
"Your race invested massive resources to secure this position for you."
"And now you say give up just like that."
"Don’t you want the Godslaying-level weapon? How will you explain to your superiors when you return?"
Before anyone could reply.
The Dark Divine Son first asked, "You’re asking what we are doing."
"I’m curious what you Dwarves are up to."
"Before, you never mentioned that the difficulty of this Primitive Ruins would be this high, correct?"
"Even when I and the Little Giant Spirit King teamed up, there were casualties."
"At that time, I was wondering."
"How many among your Dwarf Race have our kind of strength?"
"How did you get your Godslayer-level weapon?"
"Care to explain to us?
Listening to the Dark Divine Son’s words.
Everyone on scene thought of this point.
Including Han Xing, who paused from leaving, looking at the dark-aura humanoid creature.
The Dark Divine Son’s mind was meticulous, beyond imagination.
At this moment.
One of the seven Dwarves said, "I... We don’t know what happened either."
"But indeed, some different changes occurred in this Primitive Ruins this time."
"I’ve told you, it wasn’t like this the last time we came."
He seemed to become somewhat guilty.
Upon hearing this, the Dark Divine Son laughed lightly again, "Is that so?"
"Then can you explain how, even though all seven of you combined couldn’t match our strength,"
"you managed to get through eighty-two trials without a scratch?"
These Dwarf Race warriors were immediately tongue-tied.
They couldn’t think of a reasonable explanation.
At this time, the group of Dwarves looked towards Han Xing and them, and their eyes suddenly lit up.
"Why don’t you talk about the people from the Human Race?"
"There’s even fewer of them than us, yet not one casualty?"
"If they can do it, naturally we can too."
However, the Dark Divine Son laughed, "The fact that others came through unscathed is because they have the strength to do so."
"If it came to a one-on-one fight, there’s no one here who could stand up to Brother Han Xing."
"And you guys, merely possess the power of High-tier Legends."
"Even if you all attack together, you wouldn’t be a match for me and the Little Giant Spirit King."
"Honestly, I can’t figure out what methods you used to pass the challenge."
"Or, should I say, do you have any hidden methods you haven’t told us about?"
At this moment.
The atmosphere in the lab hall became somewhat tense.
The more the Dark Divine Son spoke, the more the crowd sensed something amiss with the Dwarves.
Their expressions shifted repeatedly.
The Bright Divine Son seemed to realize something; he shouted, "You bunch, what exactly are you hiding?"
"Out with it!"
Han Xing was more straightforward.
"Why bother explaining so much to them?"
"Why not just seize them directly?"

No matter how tempting the challenge rewards, it’s pointless if you can’t survive to get them.

Then break them open.

chapters.title: Chapter 633 - 382: Descent! The Foul Progenitors!
paragraphs: Han Xing said directly, "Why bother explaining so much to them?"
"Can’t we just take them down directly?"
"As long as we control these guys, there are plenty of ways to make them talk!"
The group of dwarves responded angrily, "How dare you!"
"We are the Dwarf Race, do you dare to make a move against us in the Secret Realm?"
"His Majesty the King will not spare you!"
However, Han Xing chuckled, "Let him come then, let’s see if I dare or not."
After saying that.
Han Xing’s figure vanished from the spot.
At the same time, an intense killing intent emerged.
At this moment, everyone knew that Han Xing had really acted.
And with utmost decisiveness!
Everyone’s expressions shifted dramatically.
Even though they knew Han Xing was extremely arrogant.
They didn’t expect him to be so lawless.
This was clearly the dwarves’ territory.
Even this Secret Realm was controlled by them!
However, the group of humans seemed like they had gone mad.
Seeing Han Xing make a move, everyone raised their weapons.
In the distance, the Dark Divine Son was momentarily stunned, then shook his head with a smile and said, "Brother Han Xing, truly swift and decisive."
"Even more direct than the Little Giant Spirit King."
With that, he too vanished, charging towards the seven dwarf legends.
"Hmph!"
The Little Giant Spirit King snorted coldly and swung his Giant Axe, striking fiercely at the dwarves.
These people were utterly lawless.
At this moment, they were showcasing this trait to the extreme.
"Damn it, Dark Divine Son, Little Giant Spirit King, are you also following these humans in this madness?"
Among the dwarves, a high-tier legendary dwarf with a chain hammer was exasperated.
He looked at the Elf Goddess, "Elinora, help me stop them!"
"Don’t forget, we’ve just signed the Three Kings Alliance!"
They actually wanted to pull Elinora into their camp.
However, after a moment of silence.
Elinora suddenly unleashed a dazzling beam of light.
The target, surprisingly, was also the group of dwarves.
"Elinora!" The dwarves exclaimed angrily.
But Elinora said, "Do not resist."
"If there’s any problem, we can discuss it after we’ve subdued you."
"The Three Kings Alliance only states not to attack allied legends without reason."
"But now, I think you have signs of plotting against me, so I must take you down first."
At this moment, Han Xing looked at Elinora with a look of appreciation in his eyes.
This woman wasn’t stupid.
At this moment.
Seeing that there was no one left to help them in the field.
The faces of those few dwarf legends darkened, almost dripping water.
A moment later.
This gloomy expression vanished.
They all grinned, revealing a twisted smile.
"Have we... been exposed after all?"
"Originally, we thought of using the ultimate trial to drain a bit more of their strength, so it would be easier to load them into the experimental container."
"Now it seems, it won’t be that easy."
Beside them, a dwarf legend laughed, "No matter, we still have a chance."
"As long as we cut off all their limbs and control their brains with instruments."
"We can still complete the parasitic experiment."
After this dwarf finished speaking.
An evil, powerful aura suddenly erupted from those dwarves!
In an instant, it reached the limits of a legendary level!
The Dark Divine Son laughed, "You guys indeed have a problem."
"Everyone, take them down!"
At this moment, changes were still occurring in the bodies of the dwarf race.
Insect scales began to cover their bodies gradually.
Long antennae grew from their heads.
Even their faces gradually transformed into insect-like features!
Next moment, an entity identical to those in the laboratory appeared.
"Take us down?"
"How naive! We have received the Insect Emperor’s blessing and possess limitless power."
They emitted unpleasant sounds, like insect chirps.
Then, seven dwarves shouted in unison, "Descend!"
Buzz!
A terrifying spiritual power erupted from these dwarves!
At this moment, they unexpectedly had demigod-level power!
Seven demigods, of the kind whose flesh bodies had reached demigod level.
A formidable aura of oppression surged forth.
The numerous Divine Sons and Daughters were overturned by this terrifying horror.
Even before the insect-like dwarves could display a gloating expression.
Han Xing said, "Where are you guys looking?"
As soon as these words were out.
All the insect creatures turned their heads abruptly.
What met their eyes was a flame-covered arrow coming straight at them!
One of the insect monsters reached out with its pincer-like claw, instantly catching Han Xing’s arrow.
The next moment, its expression changed.
A terrifying explosive force emerged from that arrow.
It was precisely Han Xing’s Blast Flame Arrow.
"Boom!"
A mushroom cloud large enough to cover most of the laboratory rose.
A moment later, seven smoke-trailing figures emerged from within.
Han Xing’s arrow hadn’t killed them outright, only causing some injuries.
"Damn alien race!"
"Let’s take this guy down first!"
The next moment, they all pounced at Han Xing.
And just then.
Cheng Jianyong suddenly raised his right hand.
An enormous sword array appeared out of nowhere.
It completely enveloped the entire laboratory.
Everyone present felt a heavy pressure on their shoulders.
As if they were stuck in a quagmire, their ability to move greatly diminished.
It was precisely Cheng Jianyong’s legendary skill—[Divine Demon Swordsmanship: Gale Style!]
The next moment, endless sword qi began to attack the seven insect monsters!
"Swish! Swish swish swish!"
"Block it!"
The seven demigod-level insect monsters suddenly tightened their scales!
However, what they didn’t know was.
This would be the most foolish decision they ever made.

chapters.title: Chapter 634 - 382: Descent! The Foul Primordial! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Han Xing ordered at this moment, "Full power output!"
"Blast them to pieces!"
As he spoke, special effects activated on Han Xing’s body.
Arrows shot out fiercely like machine guns!
At the same time, the attacks from Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng also descended.
"Puff! Puff puff!"
"Boom!"
Terrifying signs appeared; the space being attacked by everyone showed signs of cracking!
The surrounding elite warriors from various races were stunned.
They did not expect the attacks of these human warriors to be so fierce.
Forcing these demigod-level monsters to go on the defense.
At this time, the Dark Divine Son was the first to react.
A black spear suddenly formed in his hand,
its tip carrying a terrifying sense of tear!
Then, it was hurled fiercely.
Following that, the Little Giant Spirit King, Elf Goddess, and other powerful figures from various races,
also cast their attacks.
"Crack!"
The space in that area shattered completely!
After Cheng Jianyong’s sword array attack ended,
four of the seven demigod-level Insect Race creatures were blasted to pieces on the spot.
[Successfully killed Mutant Entity: Demigod-level creature, gained 17.4 billion experience value...]
[Successfully killed...]
After four consecutive system notifications,
there were only three deformed monsters left on the scene, looking at Han Xing and others in terror.
They had completely underestimated the terror of the Human Race!
With one strike, their carapaces were pierced directly.
Then an astonishing explosion erupted within them.
Added to that were the attacks from other strong warriors.
One could say that the death of these four demigods,
was mostly inflicted by these few humans.
Previously, they had only regarded the elite fighters of various larger races as their enemies.
Now they realized they were completely mistaken!
These few humans are the number one enemy!
However, now that they realized it, it was already too late.
The remaining three demigod-level Insect Race creatures had complicated expressions on their faces.
"Lawrence, the plan failed, we have to initiate the final phase!"
"But that great entity is still in slumber, awakening it now will disrupt its recovery."
"There’s no choice, these humans are too strong."
"It won’t be long before they wipe us out completely!"
At this moment,
Han Xing’s voice sounded, "What are you guys conspiring behind my back?"
It was like a demon’s whisper, suddenly arising.
Frightening the faces of the three demigod-level Insect Race creatures to turn pale.
Next moment, an arrow shot out.
"Boom!"
A violent explosion occurred.
The three Insect Race creatures were blown backwards again,
before they had time to adjust their forms.
Suddenly they saw those powerful warriors from various races charging at them from all directions!
If they were surrounded, they were doomed!
In this critical moment,
the three Insect Race creatures couldn’t care less.
They all extended their pincers like right hands and then fiercely plunged them into their own heads!
"Gurgle! Gurgle!"
It was like the sound of brain fluid being churned.
This scene made everyone’s scalp tingle.
However, their actions seem to have stimulated some creature into awakening.
The entire Ruins No. 5 trembled violently!
At the same time,
a terrifying aura beyond the limits of a demigod flickered and vanished.
Everyone felt a surge of panic within their hearts.
Instinctively, they stopped their attacks.
The Dark Divine Son frowned and asked, "What are you guys doing?"
However, the three deformed Insect Race creatures did not answer.
Instead, they continued repeating that terrifying action, constantly churning their brain matter.
The tremor feeling grew stronger and stronger!
The Dark Divine Son sensed something was amiss and hurriedly shouted, "Interrupt them!"
As he spoke, everyone’s attacks hit together.
However, the three deformed Insect Race creatures did not resist.
Instead, they knelt on both knees and lay on the ground.
Uttering loud cries from their mouths.
"Welcome the arrival of the Insect Emperor!"
At this time,
everyone noticed an extremely powerful presence descending.
They turned around,
and saw the purple passageway behind them rapidly expanding.
From within, an insect’s tentacle emerged.
Just that one tentacle was several kilometers long.
Then, a massive head followed.
"Rumble!"
When the entire head of the monster emerged from the teleportation array,
the head, over a hundred kilometers long, looked like a planet made of insects.
Or like a stitched-together monster.
The entire head was piled up by the corpses of trillions of insects.
A terrifying smell of corpse rot hit them full on.
Everyone felt a dizzying sensation.
Han Xing heard a prompt.
[You have been eroded by the Insect Emperor’s Corpse Stench Domain, spirit attribute decreased by 30%, every five seconds, you experience a wave of dizziness...]
"Insect Emperor..."
The Divine Sons and Daughters voiced the name of the monster.
At the same time, Han Xing also saw the attributes of the opponent.
[Insect Race Queen: Malodor Original Body (Divine-level creature)]
[Level]: Unknown
[Attributes]: Unknown
[Skills]: Unknown
[Divine Body Value]: 100%.
Note: A true being that has developed its body to the extreme, a flesh body that ascends, possessing the power of a general divine-level creature!
At this moment, everyone on the scene felt a chill descend upon them.
A real divine-level creature!
No one expected such an enemy to appear here.
"It’s over, a divine-level creature..."
"Even if our clan leader came, they wouldn’t be a match for this kind of creature."
"How could this be...how could such a divine-level monster appear here?"
The powerful warriors from various races were in disbelief.

When the entire head of the monster emerged from the teleportation array,
the head, over a hundred kilometers long, looked like a planet made of insects.
Or like a stitched-together monster.
The entire head was piled up by the corpses of trillions of insects.
A terrifying smell of corpse rot hit them full on.
Everyone felt a dizzying sensation.
Han Xing heard a prompt.
[You have been eroded by the Insect Emperor’s Corpse Stench Domain, spirit attribute decreased by 30%, every five seconds, you experience a wave of dizziness...]
"Insect Emperor..."
The Divine Sons and Daughters voiced the name of the monster.
At the same time, Han Xing also saw the attributes of the opponent.
[Insect Race Queen: Malodor Original Body (Divine-level creature)]
[Level]: Unknown
[Attributes]: Unknown
[Skills]: Unknown
[Divine Body Value]: 100%.
Note: A true being that has developed its body to the extreme, a flesh body that ascends, possessing the power of a general divine-level creature!
At this moment, everyone on the scene felt a chill descend upon them.
A real divine-level creature!
No one expected such an enemy to appear here.
"It’s over, a divine-level creature..."
"Even if our clan leader came, they wouldn’t be a match for this kind of creature."
"How could this be...how could such a divine-level monster appear here?"
The powerful warriors from various races were in disbelief.

chapters.title: Chapter 635 - 382: Arrival! The Foul Primordial! (Part 3)
paragraphs: The despair on the face grew even deeper.
They didn’t even have the thought of resisting anymore.
At this moment, the Little Giant Spirit King suddenly shouted, "There’s still a fight to be had!"
"This creature, though divine-level, is far inferior to the Divine Spirits of the Holy Spirit Realm!"
"I can sense there’s no Divine Power fluctuations from it."
"This means it doesn’t hold the power of the rules."
"It’s just its flesh has reached a divine level."
Upon hearing this, hope appeared on the faces of the strong from each race.
At this time, a Divine Son suddenly asked, "Little Giant Spirit King, you say this monster isn’t a true Divine Spirit."
"Then at what level is its power?"
After a moment, the Little Giant Spirit King hesitated and said, "Probably, about the same as my father..."
Upon hearing this, everyone rolled their eyes.
You might as well have said nothing.
Right now, who doesn’t know.
The Giant Spirit King has already reached the limit of demigod, even about to reach that realm.
Despite being a demigod, he can stand shoulder to shoulder with ordinary Divine Spirits.
If this monster before them possesses this level of power.
Then they will have no hope of victory.
"It’s over, we’re doomed this time!"
At this moment.
The body of the Insect Emperor had already come halfway out.
Now, they seemed to realize something.
Turns out, the purple passage wasn’t leading outside.
But leading to where the Insect Emperor resides.
This Primitive Ruins.
From the moment they entered, there was never an intention to let anyone out.
Everyone couldn’t help but feel glad.
Luckily they hadn’t left through the Teleportation Array just now.
Otherwise, they’d likely appear directly beside the Insect Emperor.
Facing a divine-level creature, they wouldn’t even know how they died.
"Quick, act now! Or we’ll have no chance!" urged the Little Giant Spirit King.
Speaking, the Little Giant Spirit King first unleashed his Bloodline Power!
His body instantly expanded to thousands of meters in size, nearly reaching the laboratory ceiling.
In this state, he represented the true strength of the Giant Race!
At those words.
The Little Giant Spirit King swung an axe fiercely!
Space shattered with cracks.
At the same time.
The attacks of other Divine Sons all flew forward.
Including Han Xing’s attack, which also joined in the barrage!
Their terrifying assault was even more fearsome than when they had focused on those seven demigods before.
However, when the commotion faded.
Han Xing noticed that the Insect Emperor’s body had not suffered any damage.
Even its shell only showed a slight trace of white.
Han Xing checked the creature’s attributes.
[Divine Body Value]: 99.7%
Everyone was rolling their eyes.
Compared to the God of Tricks, the strength of this creature’s Divine Body was evidently more terrifying.
At that time, a joint attack of five removed 0.1% of Divine Body Value.
But after such a long time, they had gained significant enhancements.
Moreover, this time, the strike came from over a dozen strong warriors of different races.
Their full-force assaults were not inferior to those of demigods.
In short.
Just now, there were at least the attacks of more than a dozen demigods, focusing fire simultaneously.
Yet, one wave of attack only shaved off 0.3% of Divine Body Value.
It’s truly outrageous!
At this moment.
The Insect Queen’s body shuddered from the attacks.
Its insect-like compound eyes glinted with chilling light as they stared at everyone.
Thankfully, this creature isn’t one that truly controls the rules.
Therefore, it didn’t deprive Han Xing and the others of their sight or suppress their attributes.
At the same time.
The Insect Queen also noticed the Little Giant Spirit King, whose stature was the largest.
It was he who had just caused the most damage to it.
In the next moment.
Its tentacle swung.
So fast that it exceeded everyone’s expectations.
It nearly flashed by, shattering all space along its path.
The Little Giant Spirit King’s eyes flashed with horror,
"No!"
He wanted to dodge.
Yet, at his speed, how could he possibly be faster than a true divine-level creature?
In the next instant.
"Snap!"
A terrifying sound of flesh echoed!
The Little Giant Spirit King’s massive body was instantly whipped away.
"Boom!"
Like a falling mountain range.
The Little Giant Spirit King flew backward tens of thousands of meters.
Then crashed heavily against the ruin walls, spewing out a mouthful of blood.
He opened his right hand, shock written all over his face as he exclaimed, "It’s so... so strong..."
He wanted to say more, but fainted immediately.
Meanwhile.
Others stared at the Little Giant Spirit King in terror.
After he fainted, his body began to shrink rapidly.
"It’s over, even the Little Giant Spirit King is down, who else can stop this Insect Race Queen now?"
The Insect Race Queen surveyed everyone on the scene.
Her eyes revealing a gaze as if looking at ants.
A tentacle swung down again!
Space collapsed with echoes.
Fear filled everyone’s eyes.
Knowing, even the Little Giant Spirit King couldn’t block this strike.
If it were them, how would they even know how they died?
Suddenly, they all cried out!
"Run, hurry up!"
"Ah! Help!"
Yet, how could they possibly be faster than the Insect Emperor’s tentacle strike?
Seeing a few strong warriors about to be crushed by the Insect Emperor.
A graceful figure suddenly appeared in front of everyone.
They saw her reach out with pale, jade-like hands, suddenly grasping the Insect Race Queen’s tentacle.
"Snap!"
A crisp loud sound.
Contrary to expectations, the scene of Elinora being flung away did not occur,
Instead, she firmly gripped the Insect Emperor’s tentacle in her hand!
At the same time, due to the powerful clash.
Crisscrossing spider-web-like cracks spread out under Elinora’s feet.
For that moment, the scene seemed frozen.
Everyone stared dumbfounded at Elinora.
Their eyes filled with disbelief.
She actually blocked the Insect Race Queen’s strike!
And she did it with such brute force!
Everyone seemed to experience a sense of unreality.
At this moment.
Elinora’s eyes turned bright red, a mad smile appearing on her face.
"Such strong power, you’re making me even more excited!"

chapters.title: Chapter 636 - 383: Godslaying—Slaying the Insect Emperor!
paragraphs: Elinora pushed off with one leg.
A terrifying force erupted, creating a crater nearly a hundred meters deep in the ground!
Then, like a cannonball, she charged madly towards the Insect Race Queen.
"Divine... Divine Maiden..."
Compared to the shock of the powerful beings from various races,
Han Xing and the others felt something was odd.
Because the way Elinora looked reminded them of someone.
Everyone turned to look at Su Xiaoyang.
"Are you two long-lost sisters?" Cheng Jianyong asked in surprise.
Su Xiaoyang looked bewildered, then bashfully lowered her head, "I... I don’t know either."
"It’s been a long time since I transformed like that."
Since Su Xiaoyang joined Han Xing and their team,
she hadn’t faced any life-and-death situations.
So she hadn’t shown this kind of terrifying power again.
Now, Elinora’s performance made everyone remember.
This time, Han Xing said, "Don’t worry about Elinora’s transformation."
"Let’s take action too."
"Don’t let that woman bear it alone."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
At this moment,
one of the Insect Race Queen’s legs was held tightly by Elinora.
No matter how it struggled, it couldn’t pull it back.
At this time,
the Insect Race Queen’s terrifying compound eyes spun a few times,
quickly realizing,
it had more than one leg!
Even if this woman held one, it could use other insect legs to attack.
The next moment,
an attack with the force of tearing through space came surging in!
"Not good! The Insect Emperor intends to strike Elinora,"
the Dark Divine Son shouted, instantly understanding the opponent’s intent.
The next moment, he transformed into a streak of dark light,
seemingly wanting to rush up and stop the attack.
However, the instant the Dark Divine Son touched the incoming long leg,
he felt an unimaginable force.
His entire body was whipped up in mid-air.
Then he spat out a mouthful of blood.
"Pffft!"
His dark form was instantly flung away.
The divine-level power connected and caused severe injuries upon brief contact.
Seeing that no one could stop the Insect Race Queen’s attack,
Elinora gritted her teeth, seeming ready to take the strike head-on.
But clearly, with her constitution,
if she took this strike directly, she’d undoubtedly die!
At this moment,
a figure holding a shield suddenly descended from the sky.
He landed steadily beside Elinora.
As the insect leg approached,
Shen Yun’s various equipment effects activated.
Shen Yun shouted, "Stop for me!"
"Boom!"
The deafening crash was so loud, nearby warriors couldn’t help but cover their ears!
But they still endured the headache,
struggling to look towards the battleground.
They saw the figure holding up a shield,
the instant it collided with the Insect Emperor’s insect leg.
He was suddenly pushed back dozens of meters.
Even the ground showed trench-like cracks.
Yet despite this, the figure stopped again!
He, like Elinora, had blocked a strike from a divine-level creature!
This figure was Shen Yun!
With a divine-level shield,
he used legendary-level strength to withstand the Insect Emperor’s attack!
At this moment,
many of the Divine Sons and Daughters on the scene once again looked with renewed respect at the strength of this group of the Human Race!
"These humans are so strong, they’ve actually blocked the attack of a divine-level creature!"
"Yeah, I initially thought that archer was the only strong one among them."
"Now it seems any one of them has strength matching the Little Giant Spirit King!"
The Divine Sons felt utterly shocked.
At the same time,
the sinister voice suddenly appeared behind some Divine Sons.
"What are you looking at?
Hearing this voice,
those Divine Sons felt a chill down their spine.
They found it was the three creatures, transformed from the Dwarf Race, now insects!
They weren’t dead yet and launched an attack on everyone!
The sudden raid caught the Divine Sons off guard!
Right then,
Han Xing and Su Xiaoyang’s arrows, along with Zhang Lianmeng’s large fireballs,
suddenly appeared behind the three demigod-level insect creatures.
Han Xing, of course, remained vigilant of them.
The three demigod-level creatures felt the crisis from behind.
As they had experienced the terror of the Human Race’s attack,
they had no choice but to abort their attack on the Divine Sons.
"These humans, how despicable!"
The three demigod creatures cursed in anger,
for Han Xing’s interference made them lose the best chance to slay the Divine Sons.
They had to respond to Han Xing and their attack.
Yet, could they easily withstand Han Xing and their attack?
"Boom!"
A blast echoed.
The three demigod-level creatures were heavily injured again,
blasting away hundreds of meters into the distance.
The Bright Divine Son immediately turned into a stream of light and rushed forward,
engaging in a fierce battle with the three demigod creatures.
Observing his actions, Cheng Jianyong remarked on the side,
"Damn, that Bright Divine Son is cunning."
"He knows he can’t beat the Insect Race Queen, and doesn’t want people saying he did nothing."
"So, he runs to deal with the three gravely wounded demigods."
Cheng Jianyong quickly saw through the Bright Divine Son’s intentions.
Nevertheless, Han Xing didn’t comment further.
At this time, having someone to take on the pressure of those three demigods was still a relief.
Meanwhile,
the rescued strong warriors from various races looked at Han Xing with eyes filled with gratitude.
Just when they thought the situation was finally stabilizing,

chapters.title: Chapter 637 - 383: Godslaying—Slaying the Insect Emperor!
paragraphs: "Pa! Pa!"
Two loud crashes.
Elinora and Shen Yun were simultaneously flung away.
The two of them flew backwards several kilometers.
Divine-level creatures’ attacks are not so easily handled.
Watching as the Insect Emperor’s attack was about to strike.
At this moment, Han Xing said, "You Divine Sons and Daughters from the big clans, have you got any more tricks? Use them all!"
"This time out, didn’t your elders give you any means of self-defense?"
However, as they looked at Han Xing, their eyes also carried a sense of helplessness.
The previous endless trials had forced them to use too many trump cards.
Even if they had more, they would have long been used up.
Even Elinora’s combat form had already been unleashed.
This shows they indeed had reached the end of their rope.
And this also indicates.
This Insect Race’s purpose of draining everyone’s strength through endless trials has been achieved.
At this point.
The Little Giant Spirit King had fainted.
Elinora and Shen Yun were flung away.
The Dark Divine Son was also severely injured.
The Bright Divine Son was fighting against the three demigod-level insect races.
On the field, there was no longer any strong person who could deal with the Insect Emperor.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing
said, "You guys out there act all high and mighty, I thought you were hotshots?"
"Turns out now, not a single trick left."
Embarrassed by Han Xing’s scolding.
The group of Divine Sons and Daughters all lowered their heads.
At this moment, Han Xing drew an arrow.
And spoke self-mockingly in his heart.
"Damn it, in the end, it falls on me!"
As he pulled back the bowstring.
The next moment.
The entire laboratory scene suddenly changed!
Above everyone’s heads, a dark red sky and pitch-black ground suddenly appeared.
On the boundless land, there were broken weapons and bones everywhere.
Countless vengeful spirits wandered and floated in the distance.
As if suddenly placed in hell.
The sudden scene.
Left everyone dumbfounded.
Including the Insect Race Queen, whose round eyes were scanning the surroundings in confusion.
However, Cheng Jianyong, Zhang Lianmeng, and others beside him had their eyes light up.
Because they knew.
This was an ultimate skill just drawn by Han Xing.
Endless Arrow Prison!
Able to directly change the surrounding environment!
Although they didn’t know if this ultimate skill could harm divine-level creatures.
They believed Han Xing had his reasons for using this skill at this time.
At this moment.
Han Xing shot out an arrow, then immediately released it.
"Whizz!"
An arrow with a red glow shot rapidly towards the Insect Race Queen.
With the fivefold attack boost from ’Endless Arrow Prison’.
The attack power of this arrow reached an unparalleled level.
"Puff!"
The Insect Race Queen’s body was too large to dodge.
When the arrow pierced its body, it triggered the Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill’s explosive effect again.
"Boom!"
A cloud of black smoke rose.
At this point, Han Xing glanced at the Insect Race Queen’s attribute panel.
[Divine Power Value]: 99.6%...
Effective!
The arrow Han Xing just shot directly took away 0.1% of the Insect Race Queen’s divine body value.
Comparable to the full-force attack of everyone focusing their attacks earlier.
If it were a middle-tier demigod instead, they would have been killed on the spot!
If someone could block the Insect Race Queen, allowing him to output without worry.
Han Xing even had the confidence.
To take down this Insect Race Queen before the Endless Arrow Prison’s duration ended!
Of course, the premise is that the enemy wouldn’t retaliate.
At this moment.
The Insect Race Queen seemed surprised by Han Xing.
That arrow just now made it feel a hint of danger.
Just then.
More arrows from Han Xing came down like a torrential rain.
"Boom boom boom!"
After a series of terrifying explosions.
The Insect Race Queen’s divine body decreased again.
The Insect Race Queen seemed completely enraged.
It raised its head and let out a sharp shriek.
All the Divine Sons and Daughters who heard the sound felt a severe headache.
However.
Han Xing shouted, "Shen Yun, cooperate with me!"
Finishing his words, Han Xing directly rushed forward.
Everyone was puzzled.
Especially when they saw Han Xing actively rushing over.
Everyone’s pupils widened in shock.
"Lord Han Xing, what are you planning to do?" Wan Liu asked in confusion.
But Shen Yun understood.
He immediately cast a Holy Light Shield and Great Angel’s Shelter on Han Xing.
The Insect Race Queen’s spiritual power attack was significantly weakened.
Han Xing felt the headache alleviated considerably.
However, the Insect Race Queen’s second wave of attack was already coming.
A bug leg thousands of meters long.
Swung down at an unimaginable speed!
"This is bad, Lord Han Xing!" Wan Liu exclaimed from behind.
However, Han Xing did not retreat and instead advanced.
Charging at the Insect Race Queen as if in a suicide attack!
At this moment.
All the strong clan members holding their heads seemed to witness something terrifying.
Each face bore an expression of disbelief.
They simply couldn’t understand why Han Xing would do such a thing.
This was simply courting death!
Clearly, there was already a way to hurt the Insect Race Queen.
From here on, they just needed to seize the opportunity and repel the enemy.
Even the Insect Race Queen was surprised.
However, it showed no mercy in its actions.
The Insect Race Queen directly swung the bug leg again.
At this moment, Han Xing’s figure flickered.
Shouting towards the back.
"Use skills!"
Shen Yun instantly caught on.
Immediately raising the Holy Hammer.
At the same time.
A massive six-winged archangel phantom appeared.
On the field, all the strong people’s vision was forcibly stripped away.
Their sight became a vast expanse of white.

sentences.text: "Pa!
Pa!"
Two loud crashes.
Elinora and Shen Yun were simultaneously flung away.
The two of them flew backwards several kilometers.
Divine-level creatures’ attacks are not so easily handled.
Watching as the Insect Emperor’s attack was about to strike.
At this moment, Han Xing said, "You Divine Sons and Daughters from the big clans, have you got any more tricks?
Use them all!"
"This time out, didn’t your elders give you any means of self-defense?"
However, as they looked at Han Xing, their eyes also carried a sense of helplessness.
The previous endless trials had forced them to use too many trump cards.
Even if they had more, they would have long been used up.
Even Elinora’s combat form had already been unleashed.
This shows they indeed had reached the end of their rope.
And this also indicates.
This Insect Race’s purpose of draining everyone’s strength through endless trials has been achieved.
At this point.
The Little Giant Spirit King had fainted.
Elinora and Shen Yun were flung away.
The Dark Divine Son was also severely injured.
The Bright Divine Son was fighting against the three demigod-level insect races.
On the field, there was no longer any strong person who could deal with the Insect Emperor.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing
said, "You guys out there act all high and mighty, I thought you were hotshots?"
"Turns out now, not a single trick left."
Embarrassed by Han Xing’s scolding.
The group of Divine Sons and Daughters all lowered their heads.
At this moment, Han Xing drew an arrow.
And spoke self-mockingly in his heart.
"Damn it, in the end, it falls on me!"
As he pulled back the bowstring.
The next moment.
The entire laboratory scene suddenly changed!
Above everyone’s heads, a dark red sky and pitch-black ground suddenly appeared.
On the boundless land, there were broken weapons and bones everywhere.
Countless vengeful spirits wandered and floated in the distance.
As if suddenly placed in hell.
The sudden scene.
Left everyone dumbfounded.
Including the Insect Race Queen, whose round eyes were scanning the surroundings in confusion.
However, Cheng Jianyong, Zhang Lianmeng, and others beside him had their eyes light up.
Because they knew.
This was an ultimate skill just drawn by Han Xing.
Endless Arrow Prison!
Able to directly change the surrounding environment!
Although they didn’t know if this ultimate skill could harm divine-level creatures.
They believed Han Xing had his reasons for using this skill at this time.
At this moment.
Han Xing shot out an arrow, then immediately released it.
"Whizz!"
An arrow with a red glow shot rapidly towards the Insect Race Queen.
With the fivefold attack boost from ’Endless Arrow Prison’.
The attack power of this arrow reached an unparalleled level.
"Puff!"
The Insect Race Queen’s body was too large to dodge.
When the arrow pierced its body, it triggered the Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill’s explosive effect again.
"Boom!"
A cloud of black smoke rose.
At this point, Han Xing glanced at the Insect Race Queen’s attribute panel.
[Divine Power Value]: 99.6%...
Effective!
The arrow Han Xing just shot directly took away 0.1% of the Insect Race Queen’s divine body value.
Comparable to the full-force attack of everyone focusing their attacks earlier.
If it were a middle-tier demigod instead, they would have been killed on the spot!
If someone could block the Insect Race Queen, allowing him to output without worry.
Han Xing even had the confidence.
To take down this Insect Race Queen before the Endless Arrow Prison’s duration ended!
Of course, the premise is that the enemy wouldn’t retaliate.
At this moment.
The Insect Race Queen seemed surprised by Han Xing.
That arrow just now made it feel a hint of danger.
Just then.
More arrows from Han Xing came down like a torrential rain.
"Boom boom boom!"
After a series of terrifying explosions.
The Insect Race Queen’s divine body decreased again.
The Insect Race Queen seemed completely enraged.
It raised its head and let out a sharp shriek.
All the Divine Sons and Daughters who heard the sound felt a severe headache.
However.
Han Xing shouted, "Shen Yun, cooperate with me!"
Finishing his words, Han Xing directly rushed forward.
Everyone was puzzled.
Especially when they saw Han Xing actively rushing over.
Everyone’s pupils widened in shock.
"Lord Han Xing, what are you planning to do?" Wan Liu asked in confusion.
But Shen Yun understood.
He immediately cast a Holy Light Shield and Great Angel’s Shelter on Han Xing.
The Insect Race Queen’s spiritual power attack was significantly weakened.
Han Xing felt the headache alleviated considerably.
However, the Insect Race Queen’s second wave of attack was already coming.
A bug leg thousands of meters long.
Swung down at an unimaginable speed!
"This is bad, Lord Han Xing!" Wan Liu exclaimed from behind.
However, Han Xing did not retreat and instead advanced.
Charging at the Insect Race Queen as if in a suicide attack!
At this moment.
All the strong clan members holding their heads seemed to witness something terrifying.
Each face bore an expression of disbelief.
They simply couldn’t understand why Han Xing would do such a thing.
This was simply courting death!
Clearly, there was already a way to hurt the Insect Race Queen.
From here on, they just needed to seize the opportunity and repel the enemy.
Even the Insect Race Queen was surprised.
However, it showed no mercy in its actions.
The Insect Race Queen directly swung the bug leg again.
At this moment, Han Xing’s figure flickered.
Shouting towards the back.
"Use skills!"
Shen Yun instantly caught on.
Immediately raising the Holy Hammer.
At the same time.
A massive six-winged archangel phantom appeared.
On the field, all the strong people’s vision was forcibly stripped away.
Their sight became a vast expanse of white.

chapters.title: Chapter 638 - 383: Godslaying—Slaying the Insect Emperor!
paragraphs: It’s Shen Yun’s Legendary Skills!
[Legendary Skills - Great Angel Judgment]: Summon the shadow of an Archangel, forcing all enemies into a blindness state.
The shadow of the Archangel continuously descends with Holy Light Wings, bombarding the enemies persistently with holy light, each blast factor is Spirit Attribute * 10.
This skill can force all enemies on the field into a blindness state.
Those Divine Sons and Daughters did not join Han Xing’s team.
In the system’s judgment, they are naturally his enemies.
However.
Although this skill can deprive other Divine Sons and Daughters of their sight.
It cannot affect Divine-level creatures.
For example, the Insect Race Queen on the field still stares directly at Han Xing.
In the next moment, as the insect leg attacked.
A slight smile of victory appeared at the corner of Han Xing’s mouth.
In the puzzled gaze of the Insect Race Queen.
A Gem Throne suddenly appeared beneath him.
And Han Xing’s figure also vanished instantly from the original spot.
"Snap!"
The attack of the insect leg hit nothing.
Space cracks appeared at the original location.
And when the Insect Race Queen saw Han Xing’s figure again,
it turned out he had appeared in its back area.
The Insect Race Queen quickly turned its head.
"Today I’ll give you a jab."
"Taste my power!" Han Xing said with a sinister smile.
In the puzzled gaze of the Insect Race Queen.
It saw that human suddenly pull out a massive Tail Spike.
The moment this thing appeared.
All the strong on the field felt a tearing sensation spreading over their entire bodies!
Many people even started bleeding.
A more terrifying aura than the Insect Race Queen rose.
"What happened? How can there be such a terrifying power?"
"So scary!"
The Divine Sons were bewilderedly looking forward,
but because their sight was deprived, they had no idea what was happening outside.
However.
The Insect Race Queen saw it clearly.
When it saw the 100-meter-long Tail Spike in Han Xing’s hand.
It immediately showed a look of terror in its eyes.
Because it felt a fatal sense of crisis from it!
This feeling, only once before.
In their world’s last doomsday cataclysm.
Did it experience.
At this moment, the Insect Race Queen suddenly thought.
Getting stabbed by that thing, it would surely die!
This Insect Race Queen just wanted to resist.
However, how could Han Xing give it the chance!
He directly aimed at the back of the Insect Race Queen and stabbed fiercely.
And this blow also used the venom stored in the Giant Beast Tail Spike,
which is the effect of the Giant Beast Poison.
[Extreme Giant Beast Poison]: The Tail Spike retains the deadly toxin of the beast, the target struck will instantly be inflicted with 100 layers of Giant Beast Poison, capable of harming a True God.
Han Xing laughed, "Mine is very large, you better bear with it!"
In an instant!
The Insect Race Queen’s face became contorted.
As if it had eaten filth and looked extremely ugly.
And the part on its back pierced by the Giant Beast Tail Spike began to turn blue-purple.
Furthermore, it was spreading at a terrifying speed.
Almost in the blink of an eye.
It covered its entire body.
Fear appeared in the eyes of the Insect Race Queen.
It let out a hoarse insect cry from its mouth.
"Sss... Sss..."
It seemed extremely painful.
Han Xing had experienced the Giant Beast Poison once before and knew how terrifying this thing was.
Except that was the residual poison mist with only a single layer of toxin effect.
But now, it’s the even more terrifying Extreme Giant Beast Poison.
And a full 100 layers!
Han Xing watched with his own eyes, the massive body of the Insect Race Queen.
Begin to necrotize at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Even dissolving into black pus.
First, its several insect legs half melted away instantly.
Losing support, the Insect Race Queen’s body toppled.
"Boom!"
Like a mountain made of corpses collapsing.
Thereafter, more parts of the body necrotized and melted.
The black pus flooded like a flood.
"Splash!"
Everyone heard this series of water sounds, along with the Insect Race Queen’s painful wails.
But they didn’t know exactly what happened.
When all disturbances ceased.
The Six-winged Archangel shadow in the sky dissipated.
Everyone restored their sight.
But the next moment.
Everyone couldn’t help but wipe their eyes.
Because they saw.
The previously massive Insect Race Queen, almost as large as a planet, vanished on the spot.
And on the laboratory floor.
A layer of black pus over a hundred meters deep had accumulated.
The stench assaulted their senses.
At this moment, a terrifying thought arose in everyone’s mind.
Could it be that the Insect Race Queen is dead?
They were immediately startled by this thought!
However, the fact was right before their eyes!
The Insect Race Queen indeed was dead!
A Divine-level creature indeed was dead!
Who accomplished it, goes without saying.
At this moment, all the Divine Sons and Daughters looked at Han Xing with eyes full of fear!
Even Elinora was looking at Han Xing with a complex expression.
No wonder, when she said the Ogre Lord was coming to trouble him at that time.
The other party wasn’t worried at all.
Given the current situation.
Not even the Ogre Lord.
Even if the Elf King came himself, he would have to drink hate on the spot.
This man, actually possesses godslaying means!
This is a power even strong enough to dominate the Holy Spirit Realm!
At this time.
Han Xing ignored the mental activities of those Divine Sons.
Instead, he looked at the previous system prompt.
[Successfully killed Insect Race Queen: a Divine-level creature, gained 10,283 billion Experience and 100 Legendary Points.]
[Survivor Han Xing, due to your outstanding performance, an additional 200 Legendary Points are awarded.]
An entire trillion experience, allowing the five people on the field to simultaneously rise in a flash of white light!
They leveled up!
Everyone rose to Level 57.
Yes, because they were in a team state, and they also attacked the Insect Race Queen earlier.
So, they all shared the experience.
Apart from the massive experience, they also gained 100 Legendary Points.
While Han Xing gained 300 points!
It means, except for Han Xing.
They can all draw another Legendary Skill!

chapters.title: Chapter 639 - 384: Relic Tremors, Shifting Situation
paragraphs: And at this moment.
Han Xing heard a prompt again, specifically addressed to him.

[Survivor, please note, the Insect Race Queen is a being that has become a god in an alternative way and has not mastered the rules of the Holy Spirit Realm, hence the first kill reward cannot be triggered.]
"No first kill reward, huh?" Han Xing pondered.
After a moment, he said somewhat painfully, "Damn it, I’m at a loss!"
The ’Extreme Giant Beast Poison’ of the Giant Beast Tail Spike has only three uses.
Now, Han Xing has already used it once.
Though he gained a lot of experience and Legendary Points, and the reward was decent.
But it still fell far short of Han Xing’s expectations.
Han Xing gnashed his teeth in secret, "Damn it, I must find the resource storage room of this ruin."
"Otherwise, I can’t make up for my loss!"
And at this moment.
The entire ruin seemed to undergo some unexpected changes due to the death of the Insect Race Queen.
It actually began to shake violently.
"Alert! Alert!"
"The core of the Primitive Ruin is under attack by an unknown force, system malfunction!"
"Adjusting all ruin systems of the Insect Race World!"
Blinding red lights flashed continuously over everyone’s heads.
The group of Divine Sons was confused.
But Han Xing understood that this might be due to the chain effect caused by him killing the Insect Race Queen.
Not only that.
All the ruins in the Secret Realm underwent drastic changes the moment the alarm sounded!
"Boom!"
One ruin after another trembled continuously.
Those abnormal creatures sealed inside jars all awoke.
At the moment they opened their eyes, they all murmured.
"Mother Queen..."
The earth continued to tremble.
Moreover, many ruins buried deep underground gradually surfaced.
At this moment.
In a gigantic Primitive Ruin.
A cockroach monster in a military officer’s uniform woke up.
It broke the jar directly and quickly realized what had happened.
"Damn it! A mother of the insects has died, how is that possible?"
This General Cockroach was filled with incredulity in its eyes, "Could it be the power of that Great World attacking?"
"But there is no relevant intelligence.
After pondering for a while, this General Cockroach ordered.
"Quickly wake up the Insect Mothers of other ruins!"
"All Insect Races, enter level one alert state!"
Meanwhile.
Outside the Secret Realm.
The Dwarf King was stationed near the teleportation array.
Suddenly felt, a strange force was emerging inside.
Beside him, a massive two-headed ogre as large as a mountain range was fiercely staring at the teleportation array.
"Dwarf King, when will they come out?"
"I must find the murderer who killed my offspring!"
The Dwarf King glanced at him and said, "Ogre Lord, your offspring might have died in the dangers of the ruin."
"It has nothing to do with other Divine Sons."
However, the Ogre Lord angrily said, "I don’t believe it!"
"Gulichi possesses the ancient bloodline of our Ogre Race, and his talent even surpasses mine."
"Everyone else survived, how could Gulichi die?"
"Once I find out, they will pay for it with blood."
"No matter who it is!"
However, the Dwarf King asked, "What if it’s the Little Giant Spirit King, Bright Divine Son, what then? Do you dare to ask them to pay with blood?"
The Ogre Lord’s anger was halted.
After a moment.
It exclaimed in anger, "Even if it’s the Little Giant Spirit King, Elf Goddess!"
"I still want an explanation from them."
The Dwarf King laughed, "Gulidun, you want an explanation, go talk to their adults."
"In our Dwarf Realm, I won’t let you make a move."
After speaking, he looked at the Ogre Lord with a warning in his eyes.
The Ogre Lord was full of anger internally.
But it wasn’t foolish, it knew who it could provoke and who it couldn’t.
Clearly, it was no match for the Dwarf King.
The Dwarf King’s face carried a faint smile.
As if everything was under control.
At this moment, his expression suddenly changed.
In the distance, many demigod-level auras were rapidly approaching.
Those auras seemed to be powerful beings from other races.
Among them, were several of his old acquaintances.
The Dwarf King looked puzzled.
Why did so many old guys come to my Dwarf Realm, what happened?
He immediately thought of the Ancient Ruins.
This time, all major races paid a certain price to get the opportunity to enter the ruins.
Their Divine Sons and Daughters are still in the ruins now.
Could it be, something happened inside?
The Dwarf King pondered.
At the same time.
A demigod creature with a deer’s head on top of its head rushed in as a streak of light.
Before the person arrived, the voice came first.
"Krumman, my race’s Divine Son met with an accident in your Secret Realm, did you know?"
The Dwarf King looked puzzled.
Even before he could speak.
The demigods of other races spoke one after another.
"Also my race’s Divine Son Aikze, also lost contact with me."
"Our race’s Divine Lady Juno Norn..."
The Dwarf King’s expression was shocked.
So many Divine Sons and Daughters died?
What on earth happened?
Could it be, something happened inside the ruins?
Before the Dwarf King could react.
Suddenly, he felt, the connection with the seven high-tier Legends within his race was also severed.
"Damn!" The Dwarf King’s heart jolted!
"Our race’s Legends also died!"
At this time.
Inside the Primitive Ruin.
Han Xing, with a hint of joy on his face, said, "The instant movement effect of the Oracle Throne, combined with the Giant Beast Tail Spike."
"Allowed me to develop a combined skill."
"With these two pieces of equipment, ordinary Divine Spirits can’t escape my sure-kill attack!"
At this moment.
Han Xing noticed, three silhouettes in the corner.

chapters.title: Chapter 640 - 384: Relic Tremors, Shifting Situation (Part 2)
paragraphs: It was those three dwarves that had transformed into insects, legendary ones.
They noticed Han Xing’s gaze.
The bodies of these three demigod-level mutant creatures instantly shook.
Then, they shouted in unison, "Run!"
In an instant, they scraped the ground with all four legs, mimicking an insect’s running stance.
Their speed was extremely fast.
However, Han Xing merely chuckled lightly.
"Can you run?"
With those words, he directly drew his bowstring.
"Whoosh! Whoosh whoosh!"
Three arrows shot out from different angles.
Then, they precisely hit the bodies of these three insects.
Within the range covered by the Endless Arrow Prison, Han Xing could instantly capture their movement trajectories.
And this was also a function Han Xing had just developed.
At this moment.
The Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill was activated.
"Boom! Boom boom!"
Three earth-shattering explosion sounds rang out.
The bodies of those three insects instantly burst into bloody mist.
[Successfully killed mutated insects: demigod-level creatures, gained 25.2 billion experience points, Legendary Points +10... ]
[Successfully killed... ]
The three demigod-level insect races brought Han Xing over 70 billion experience points, plus 30 Legendary Points.
Compared to killing the Insect Emperor, it might be insignificant.
But it was still quite good.
After all, there aren’t that many divine-level creatures for you to slay.
Plus, there are Legendary Points as reward.
Getting closer to unlocking the fifth skill.
Han Xing had a premonition that the fifth skill.
Is likely to be an ultimate skill.
After taking down these three demigod insects.
Han Xing also noticed the terrified look on the faces of the divine sons.
Even the little Giant Spirit King, who was unconscious, woke up.
They looked at Han Xing with eyes that held a mix of surprise and fear.
It seemed they feared this human might be so caught up in killing that he’d take them out too.
Han Xing could understand why they looked at him that way.
After all, he had just accomplished the feat of godslaying!
In the Holy Spirit Realm.
This was an event more shocking than the death of the Three Kings.
However, this here was within the ancient ruins.
They were not only unable to contact the outside world.
Now, their lives were not under their control.
After all, they had witnessed Han Xing’s godslaying.
It was equivalent to discovering this man’s secret.
If he wanted to silence them.
None of the divine sons and daughters present would survive.
Seeing Han Xing’s gaze sweep over them.
The powerful individuals from each race present instantly felt a chill on their scalp.
At this moment, the Dark Divine Son spoke first, "Han... Han Xing, we won’t tell anyone about what happened here."
Other divine sons nodded one after another, expressing they wouldn’t tell.
Some even swore right there on the spot.
Down below, Elinora’s gaze was complex as she looked at Han Xing.
However.
Han Xing merely looked at them calmly and said, "Don’t worry, I won’t kill you all."
"As for what happened here, you saw, you saw."
"Just don’t go blabbing about it outside."
Among the crowd below, each race’s strong individuals couldn’t help but nod.
One by one, they felt relieved, and looked at Han Xing gratefully.
And they promised repeatedly, that they absolutely wouldn’t tell.
Han Xing just smiled slightly.
He didn’t really expect them to keep it a secret.
After all, his ability to slay gods had been exposed when dealing with the God of Tricks.
Only this time, Han Xing had Shen Yun block those people’s sight.
So, they couldn’t really tell how Han Xing did it.
Nor did they know what method Han Xing used to slay gods.
Looking at the respectful expressions of the group below.
Han Xing scanned the surrounding environment.
He found there were no teleportation gates leading outside.
Including the purple teleportation gate the Insect Race Queen used earlier, which had also vanished.
"Is this to trap us here?"
After thinking for a moment.
If these people stayed here, it would interfere with what he was about to do next.
So, he had to send them out first.
At this moment.
The duration of Han Xing’s Endless Arrow Prison had not ended.
He thought, "With my current Attack Power, I should be able to do damage to the walls of this relic, right?"
Thinking of this.
Han Xing aimed at the laboratory’s ceiling and released an arrow.
"Boom!"
After a violent explosion, everyone felt the ground tremble slightly a few times.
A burst of black debris fell down.
No one knew what material these fragments were.
But it was very clear, Han Xing’s attack was effective.
Therefore.
He directly drew his bowstring.
Shooting a thousand arrows in succession!
"Whew! Whew whew whew!"
After the dense sound of arrows tearing through the air.
"Boom!"
After the violent explosion.
A large hole with a diameter of two or three meters appeared in the sky above.
Seeing this scene.
The group of Divine Sons and Daughters below were surprised, but not overly so.
But compared to Han Xing’s recent godslaying feat.
This seemed somewhat insignificant.
Han Xing said, "Alright, you can go out now."
The Divine Sons all obediently followed Han Xing’s words.
To be honest, they had long wanted to leave.
After all, staying with someone who could destroy them at any moment made everyone feel immense pressure.
The Little Giant Spirit King didn’t hesitate at all.
He rushed straight into the sky!
Then came the Bright Divine Son.
He was so afraid that Han Xing would trouble him that he fled as a golden light, escaping swiftly.
Following that, the other Divine Sons and Daughters also flew away one after another.
Finally, only the Elf Goddess, Elinora, remained.
She resumed her holy appearance.
The blood-red color faded from her eyes.
Elinora slightly bowed to Han Xing and said, "Thank you, Brother Han Xing, for saving my life."
"In the future, if in the Holy Spirit Realm, whenever Brother Han Xing has a request."
"This girl will go through fire and water without hesitation."
Han Xing waved his hand, "No need to be so courteous, you may go now."
Elinora nodded gently.
Although she didn’t know why Han Xing and the others stayed behind.
Elinora dared not ask more.
Instantly transforming into a stream of light, she rushed into the sky.
At this moment, only the five of them remained on the scene again.
The group exchanged smiles.
Cheng Jianyong said excitedly, "Brother Xing, now that everyone is gone."
"Can we finally start searching for the resource storage room of this relic?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
"This time, the Insect Race tried to outsmart us, causing me to use one of my trump cards."
"We now need to collect some interest."
Upon hearing this, everyone showed a knowing smile.
Then, without Han Xing saying more.
They began searching everywhere.
Although Han Xing now had the ability to forcibly destroy the relic’s architecture.
But that was under the enhancement of the ’Endless Arrow Prison’ state.
Now that the skill’s duration had ended, Han Xing restored to his Legendary Level aura.
Everyone began searching everywhere.
The floor of this laboratory was already piled with pus from the Insect Race Queen.
So it was impossible to see the situation below.
However, during the earlier fight, they had already investigated.
There was nothing special on the laboratory’s floor.
If there was any passage or door, it would be around the laboratory.
Suppressing their disgust, they began to search nearby.
The group searched around the large lab for about twenty minutes.
Soon.
Shen Yun found a door with a Divine Power Barrier in the corner.
"Brothers, over here."
After receiving the message.
Han Xing led the people over directly.
Then destroyed the door using the giant beast’s tail spike.
Upon entering.
They found it was an empty space.
There were also traces of battle inside.
At this point, Shen Yun said, "This scene looks familiar."
"Could this be the trial space of another team just now?"
Han Xing nodded, "It should be."
"This primitive ruins space is vast, and during our Endless Trial, those trial spaces should all be connected."
The group nodded.
They began carefully searching this trial space bit by bit.
A few minutes later.
Cheng Jianyong found a circular door.
This door had no Divine Power Barrier.
The group exchanged glances.
Then simultaneously focused their attacks on it.
"Boom!"
The door exploded open.
They went through the door immediately.
Discovered they had entered a new trial space.
Except that there wouldn’t be any new mechanical monsters generated here.
After dozens of consecutive rooms.
The group found that they seemed to have returned to the original place.
The inside of this No. 5 relic was like a giant maze.
Connected passages everywhere, one space linked to another.
But Han Xing was not discouraged, continuing to lead everyone to search for more passages.
More trial spaces were discovered by them.
They even arrived at places they had previously challenged.

chapters.title: Chapter 641 - 385: Searching for the Resource Storage Room Passage
paragraphs: "Damn, there are so many rooms in these ruins."
"Could it really be endless?" Cheng Jianyong grumbled.
Han Xing shook his head, "It’s unlikely."
"Its internal space is limited; no matter how big it is, it has to have an end."
After pausing for a moment, Han Xing said, "However, it is indeed a bit difficult to find."
"Even if we find the resource storage room, we would still spend a lot of time."
After pondering for a while.
Han Xing said, "Everyone, get away from me."
"I’m going to destroy the ruins’ structure to see if I can forcibly open a new passage."
Everyone immediately turned serious.
They all retreated several thousand meters away from Han Xing.
And Han Xing, himself, was enduring the sharp pain.
He raised the Giant Beast Tail Spike and aimed it at the floor, thrusting it down hard!
"Boom!"
A dull collision sound echoed.
The material used for building the ruins was unknown; a hole as thick as a bowl’s mouth instantly appeared on the floor.
And from the center of this hole, spider-web-like cracks spread out.
Han Xing quickly put the Giant Beast Tail Spike back into his backpack.
The ripping pain through his body was too intense to bear.
If not for the recent substantial increase in his life force and constitution.
Otherwise, Han Xing would have already had his meridians destroyed by the divine power laws in the Giant Beast Tail Spike.
His blood vessels would have burst, leading to his death!
But even so, Han Xing was still in great discomfort.
Blood continued to seep from his pores, even dripping from his soles.
Han Xing took a deep breath.
His robust constitution began to take effect.
The injuries on his body started to heal rapidly.
Han Xing glanced toward the hole.
Realizing that the strike he just delivered had already bored a hole dozens of meters deep.
However, it still hadn’t pierced through the floor.
The thickness of this ruin’s floor was beyond imagination.
"Looks like it’ll take a few more tries to puncture this floor."
Han Xing did not lose heart.
He took a deep breath.
Retrieved the Giant Beast Tail Spike once more, and thrust with all his might.
"Boom! Boom boom!"
After three consecutive strikes.
The size of the hole on the floor expanded from bowl-sized to a meter in diameter.
The depth reached nearly a hundred meters.
And at the bottom of the hole, Han Xing saw a trace of light.
At that moment, a smirk appeared at the corner of Han Xing’s mouth.
"Damn it, finally, I managed to pierce through it!"
He took a deep breath and quickly put the Giant Beast Tail Spike away.
Then, he took out a bottle of Life Secret Elixir from his backpack and drank it.
A vast life force began to flow within Han Xing’s body.
The bleeding trend all over his body gradually stopped.
At the same time.
Han Xing drew his bowstring and shot toward the bottom of the hole.
The floor, already riddled with holes by the Giant Beast Tail Spike, was close to its limit.
At that moment, it was directly hit by Han Xing’s arrow attack, causing a remarkable explosion!
"Rumble!"
After a tremor beneath their feet, more black fragments fell.
Revealing a bright room below.
Han Xing said in the team channel, "Everyone, come over; the path is open."
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong, among others in the distance, hurried over.
At this moment, Han Xing shook his body, shaking off the blood on his body.
Just then, Cheng Jianyong, looking at the pit below, couldn’t help but say, "Oh my, so deep?"
Han Xing nodded, "Let’s go down."
After saying that, he took the lead and jumped down.
This was a bright laboratory.
Five figures landed one after another.
Then quickly began to explore the surroundings.
The laboratory’s instruments were still very new, seemingly with traces of use.
A hospital bed was set up nearby, with red and green bloodstains on the bed and some insect tissues.
"Tsk tsk, could these insects have been used here for human experimentation?" Cheng Jianyong said.
"They capture those unlucky ones entering the ruins, then transform their bodies to become like those few dwarves."
"Appear to be of another race on the surface, but actually disguised as these insects.
After hearing this, everyone seemed to consider this possibility.
Han Xing pondered for a moment and nodded, "That should be the case."
"However, what I’m curious about now is."
"How many from the Dwarf Race have entered the Primitive Ruins."
"Or rather, how many among the Dwarf Race’s legends are disguises by these Insect Race."
Upon hearing this, everyone turned serious.
But they also knew.
Han Xing’s analysis was correct.
The Dwarf Race has controlled this Secret Realm for years.
Conducted multiple explorations by sending numerous legendary powerhouses.
And now, they know.
The ordinary ruins outside pose no real danger.
The real threat comes from these Primitive Ruins.
Once inside, it’s nearly impossible to come out alive.
After all, not only are there demigod-level insects inside, but also a divine-level Insect Mother.
Therefore, the number of Insect Race hidden among the Dwarf Race is undoubtedly more than just seven.
It’s just unknown whether the Dwarf King is aware of this matter.
Shaking his head.
Han Xing pushed the thought aside.
"This area is probably a non-public section of the Primitive Ruins."
"We’ve found the right place."
"Let’s go, let’s continue searching."
Upon hearing this, everyone began searching around.
Along the way.
They pushed open the laboratory door.
Entering a corridor.
The corridor had many rooms on both sides.
Everyone started investigating room by room.
After half an hour of searching, apart from a few bottles of inferior Genetic Potion.
They still found nothing.
At this moment, Han Xing also lost his patience again, "Damn it, whatever."
"I’ll continue using the Giant Beast Tail Spike to delve deeper."
