After seeing light shine from below.
Han Xing immediately put away the Giant Beast Tail Spike.
Then first attended to his injuries.
And then shot out, opening the passage.
In one smooth motion!
Upon reaching the next level.
Han Xing didn’t pause for a moment.
He continued piercing straight down!
After more than a dozen times.
He didn’t even know how many levels he had descended.
But it must be at least several thousand meters in depth.
Team members followed Han Xing’s pace, descending all the way.
Finally.
After breaking through more than a hundred floors.
Han Xing and his team landed inside a hall-like structure.
The next moment.
Every room in the ruins lit up with a red glow.
"Warning! Warning!"
"Strong energy fluctuations detected, approaching the core area of the Primitive Ruins, awakening defense protocols..."
"Awakening failed, Insect Race Queen shows no signs of life..."
Hearing this prompt, Han Xing couldn’t help but laugh.
"Damn, so your defense program was that Insect Race Queen, huh?"
One must admit, the defense means of this ruin are indeed strong.
It even had a divine-level creature as a guardian.
But unfortunately.
The Insect Race Queen had long been killed by Han Xing.
And this indirectly confirmed that Han Xing had found the right place.
At this time.
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong also walked over.
They also heard the alarm.
"Brother Xing, we’ve entered the core area, we should be close to the resource storage room, right?"
Han Xing thought for a moment and shook his head.
"Not too sure."
"This ruin is too large, completely different from those ordinary ruins before."
"Even if we’re in the core area, it’s not easy to find the resource storage room quickly."
"Let’s see if we can find a map or something.
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded once again.
Then they started to take separate actions.
At this moment, Han Xing glanced upward.
Hundreds of holes connected to reach nearly tens of thousands of meters in height.
"This damn place is really well hidden."
"Without the Giant Beast Tail Spike, even I wouldn’t have been able to find this core area."
Thinking of this, Han Xing also started to search around.
The core area appeared very spacious.
In the middle was an enormous piece of machinery.
This machine alone was at least the size of ten ruins outside.
And at the edge of this machine, there was a spiral staircase.
It seemed to be an access path for regular maintenance of the machine.
Following this staircase.
The group descended all the way down.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly stopped everyone.
"Wait a minute, it seems like something is crawling up from below."
Hearing this, everyone became alert.
"Rustle... rustle..."
The next moment, they heard it.
On the surrounding walls, there appeared a dense rustling sound.
Shen Yun sent a Holy Light Ball ahead.
In an instant, a scene that made their scalps tingle appeared before their eyes.
On the edge of this staircase.
And on the surrounding walls.
There were tens of thousands of humanoid cockroaches crawling.
Their two antennae on their heads swayed around.
Their bulging insect eyes were still staring at the group.
Being stared at by this group of creatures made one’s skin crawl all over.
This feeling was like.
You opened the kitchen cupboard at home.
And suddenly discovered a wall full of cockroaches!
Making one feel extremely uncomfortable inside.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, the two girls, had already turned pale.
Shen Yun said, "Brother Xing, are these the cockroach monsters of this ruin, have they all awakened?"
Han Xing nodded, "It seems so."
"Let’s get rid of them all."
As soon as he finished speaking, everyone entered a combat state.
At the same time, those cockroach monsters, fearless of death, rushed towards them.
Su Xiaoyang was the first to shoot an arrow.
Thousands of green vines grew out of the wall.
The cockroach monsters were entangled by the vines, which then tightened fiercely, directly crushing these monsters’ bodies into several pieces.
The remains of the cockroach monsters fell.
Cheng Jianyong’s sword qi swung, each attack reaching a length of kilometers.
Countless cockroach monsters were split into two halves.
The most exaggerated were Zhang Lianmeng and Han Xing.
All of their attacks achieved a group attack effect.
Only to see Zhang Lianmeng wave the magic staff, raising her hand for a move.
A rain of fire fell from the sky.
Wave after wave of cockroach monster bodies were ignited, then fell from the wall, crashing into the bottomless darkness below.
Han Xing also shot an arrow towards the sky.
Tens of thousands of meteors continuously crashed down.
Han Xing’s use of the ’Fallen Star Arrow Rain’ skill now already had the might of when Wild Ranger originally demonstrated it.
However, Wild Ranger was merely a spiritual body back then.
If he were at his peak, the power of this skill would definitely be more terrifying.
"Rumble!"
Meteors crashed down one after another.
The entire ruin began to shake violently.
Before those cockroach monsters could pounce, they were smashed by their attacks.
They fell in clumps.
To them, dealing with these cockroach monsters of fifth transformation strength was unbelievably easy.
The battle continued for nearly half an hour.
As they fought, they delved deeper.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong had just struck a sword qi when a cockroach monster had somehow leaped onto the staircase.
The opponent was just about to launch an attack.
When Han Xing shot an arrow, directly piercing its head.
Cheng Jianyong wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and said.
"The number of these cockroach monsters is truly terrifying."
"It’s like they’re insane."
Everyone nodded.
It was indeed terrifying.
Half an hour of continuous high-intensity combat.
Just from killing monsters to gain experience value, their experience bar increased by 5%.
Almost comparable to the experience from a single demigod.
Even Han Xing himself couldn’t remember how many cockroach monsters they had actually eliminated.
Judging by this, it seemed like all the cockroach monsters in the entire ruin had awakened.
And were rushing towards them.
Another half an hour passed.
And Han Xing and the others had reached the lowest level of the stairs.
The cockroach army’s offensive gradually weakened.
It seemed they also realized there was no hope against these few people.
Then they gradually retreated.
In the corner at the core bottom.
Han Xing and the others saw the cockroach monsters’ corpses piled into a hundred-meter high wall.
Among them were many monsters with only half their bodies but still not dead.
The antennae on their heads continuously wagged.
This scene was exactly like the cockroaches on Blue Star!
But even so, these cockroaches wouldn’t live much longer.
After repelling the last few waves of cockroach monsters.
The core region, the lowest area.
Suddenly became extremely quiet.
Han Xing said, "No more monsters, let’s continue the search."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded.
Then, another five hours of searching passed.
The core region’s lowest part was still connected to many rooms.
Since taking down the Insect Queen.
Han Xing and the others had spent almost a day in this ruin.
If not for knowing there surely was a resource storage room inside.
Anyone else might have given up by now.
But Han Xing and the others knew there had to be a lot of resources hidden in here.
Finally.
Heaven doesn’t disappoint those who persist.
As they passed through a corridor, the scene before them suddenly opened up.
A huge plaza appeared in front of them.
At this moment, they heard the system prompt.
[You have entered Primitive Ruins No. 5, Resource Storage Area...]

chapters.title: Chapter 643 - 386: Clean Sweep and Sudden Wealth
paragraphs: [You have entered Primitive Ruin No. 5, Resource Storage Area...]
Seeing this system message, a gleam of joy flashed in everyone’s eyes simultaneously.
However, the resource storage room before them seemed completely different from what they had encountered before.
This was a huge plaza.
And on both sides of the plaza, there were massive rooms.
These rooms were labeled: Warehouse No. 1, Warehouse No. 2, Warehouse...
All the way to Warehouse No. 72...
Even more astonishing...
In front of the vast plaza...
there were many spindle-shaped battleships parked.
Almost identical to the spaceships seen in movies.
[Ancient Weapon: Expedition]: Possesses extremely strong mobility and combat capabilities, capable of inflicting damage on ordinary Fifth-Turned Creatures.
[Ancient Weapon: Lost Navigation]: Possesses extremely strong endurance, suitable for dealing with harsh environments.

[High-tier Ancient Weapon: Insect Race Star-Killing Battleship]: A high-level battleship incorporating many advanced technologies of the Insect Race, with powerful firepower coverage that can threaten Demigod-level Creatures.
At this moment, everyone in the area swallowed their saliva.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but exclaim, "This is extraordinary! Unbelievable!"
"So many high-tier battleships, resource warehouses."
"Damn, any civilization stumbling upon this would experience an explosive growth in power."
"They could even become a dominant power in the Holy Spirit Realm!"
Han Xing nodded in agreement.
But unfortunately...
They couldn’t take these battleships with them.
Otherwise, bringing them to the Holy Spirit Realm...
and handing them over to the group of survivors for piloting...
The originally weak Human Race could instantly equal the power of the three major races of the Holy Spirit Realm.
By then...
it would truly be a collision of technology and magic.
Everyone felt a sense of regret as well.
Han Xing said, "No worries, after we get out this time, I’ll discuss it with the Dwarf King."
"See if I can bring more people in next time."
"Then each of us will have two Space Backpacks, and we can take away quite a lot of things each time."
"We could even pack up everything in this world’s ruins and carry them away.
After hearing this, everyone’s faces showed expressions of surprise.
However, after thinking about it, this was indeed something Han Xing could do.
Just pack it all up and take it away.
Because they knew, Han Xing was really capable of doing such a thing.
Currently, the Dwarf King was still unaware of Han Xing and his team’s strength.
Once they got out this time...
and Han Xing’s Godslaying feat was exposed...
they believed the Dwarf King would agree to Han Xing’s request.
These battleships couldn’t be taken away.
So they walked directly through the warship display plaza.
And began heading towards the rooms behind them, one by one.
Similar to the layout of the previous ruins...
most of these warehouses were grain storage for food.
And there were also seeds of plants that had been carefully selected and could grow even in extreme conditions.
Han Xing and the others ignored these things as well.
They continued to push open warehouse doors one by one.
In Warehouse No. 17,
they finally discovered something unusual.
Inside was a massive weapons warehouse.
And from the looks of it, they were all the same type of weapon.
[Middle-tier Ancient Weapon: Enhanced Pulse Rifle]: A formidable energy weapon with strong performance and the ability to be mass-produced, capable of damaging Tier Five Creatures.
An initial glance revealed at least hundreds of thousands of them!
"This is truly extraordinary. If we could take them all, we’d be set!"
After thinking for a while, Han Xing said, "Let’s leave these weapons for now."
"We can’t take that many, and we might even have to leave behind some of the weapons in our backpacks."
Upon hearing this, a sense of disappointment appeared in everyone’s eyes.
After all, seeing so many things before them, equivalent to vast sums of wealth that couldn’t be taken away,
it was undoubtedly a regrettable situation.
Han Xing noticed the disappointment in everyone’s eyes and smiled, "Don’t worry."
"We’re making space to take away something more valuable."
"I have a feeling the harvest in this Primitive Ruin No. 5 will exceed our imagination!
After hearing this, anticipation reappeared in everyone’s eyes.
Next,
they continued to push open the warehouses one by one.
After more than a dozen warehouses,
they were all packed with various high-tech weapons.
This demonstrated,
just how powerful and ambitious this race was.
They were ready for anything and eager to make a comeback at any moment.
These weapons couldn’t be taken away, so Han Xing and his team stopped looking at them.
Then they continued to explore other warehouses.
Finally, after pushing open the door to the 65th warehouse,
it was filled with black boxes.
Faced with this quantity of boxes,
everyone’s breath stopped.
Just in this one warehouse, the number of boxes exceeded the total of the previous ten ruins combined!
They could even hear each other’s slight breathing sounds.
"Wow, we’re rich, we’re rich!"
"This is really a windfall!"
"This race is truly outrageous!"
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t stop exclaiming in surprise.
Even Han Xing swallowed his saliva.
The quantity of boxes exceeded anything Han Xing had encountered before.
They were no longer worried about there not being enough Insect Emperor Stones inside.
What they were worried about was if their backpack space was sufficient.
Han Xing approached and opened them all directly.
Inside were piles upon piles of Insect Emperor Stones.
The entire warehouse was filled with Insect Emperor Stones!
Han Xing thought for a moment, took out the Ancient Weapons from his backpack.
Anything below High-tier, he took them all out.
Then he also removed those miscellaneous materials like Secret Silver Ingot, Constant Gold, Purple Gold Stone, etc.

paragraphs: Then, he directly took everything from all the boxes.
The system prompt appeared.
[Acquired Insect Emperor Stone * 11,370,000...]
Good heavens!
Directly 11 million Insect Emperor Stones!
Counting the previous haul, they directly broke through 20 million!
At this moment, Han Xing’s breathing became somewhat rapid.
The massive haul was incredibly shocking.
And the cost was that his two space backpacks were completely filled.
Han Xing glanced at his team members and then said, "Empty your backpacks."
"We need to continue scavenging the other warehouses."
"This time, take out as much as we can."
The group listened and did as instructed.
A large pile of materials was dumped out by them.
But the team felt no pain in doing so.
Because they knew they were about to harvest even more soon.
Han Xing and his team quickly arrived at the next warehouse.
Inside was another heap of boxes.
However, compared to the previous warehouse, the number was much less.
Upon opening them, it revealed another kind of special stone.
[Chaos Divine Stone]: A special material containing extreme energy, it is the main material for making high-tier battleships (apparently also one of the main materials for Godslaying-level weapons.)
"Godslaying!"
Seeing the note at the end, Han Xing couldn’t help but exclaim.
At the same time, everyone saw the introduction of this Divine Stone.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Holy crap, so Godslayer level weapons are real!"
"I always heard the dwarves talk about it, but I never saw one."
"I thought those guys were tricking us."
Han Xing nodded.
"Next, let’s continue to explore the No. 5 Primitive Ruins."
"See if we can find Godslayer weapons or blueprints."
For these terrifying weapons beyond high-tier ancient weapons.
Han Xing is eagerly anticipating.
At this time, Han Xing asked Shen Yun to pack up these Chaos Divine Stones from the boxes.
Shen Yun did as instructed.
[Acquired Chaos Divine Stone * 128,000...]
Only 120,000 pieces, but considering these are materials for crafting Godslayer level weapons.
It wasn’t surprising.
Next.
They began to open the third warehouse.
Inside the boxes.
They found 290,000 Calamity Divine Golds.
After this.
The following few warehouses were all Insect Emperor Stones and some other common materials.
Until everyone’s backpacks were completely filled.
Yet there were still some Insect Emperor Stones they couldn’t take.
Han Xing roughly estimated.
The number of Insect Emperor Stones in their five backpacks had broken through 60 million.
Equivalent to 60 million Philosopher’s Stones.
Perhaps the entire Holy Spirit Realm.
Only the three major races could come up with so much.
Now, all of it was stuffed into their backpacks by the five of them.
To call this a windfall would be an understatement!
At this moment.
Han Xing and his team finally reached the end of the resource storage room.
Han Xing realized they had almost collected all the treasures inside.
Up ahead was one last room.
"Brother Xing, we’ve almost finished searching and still haven’t found the Godslayer weapons."
Han Xing nodded, "Let’s check the last warehouse then."
Arriving at the warehouse door.
The group found this door was different from the previous ones.
Not only was the material thicker.
Among them, Han Xing and others felt a layer of Divine Power Barrier.
When Han Xing and the team attempted to enter.
A red light swept over them.

chapters.title: Chapter 645 - 386: Clean Sweep and Sudden Wealth
paragraphs: Han Xing stared at the blue pillar.
His gaze became somewhat unkind.
"If there’s nothing here, then I’ll destroy this pillar first and come back next time to search slowly."
Han Xing was deliberately speaking to the pillar.
He knew, this pillar was intelligent.
At the entrance, the relic had opened the door on its own to let them in, which showed as much.
It seemed to sense Han Xing’s threat.
At this moment, a mechanical synthesized voice sounded above their heads.
"Strong beings from the Alien Race, what are you looking for?"
Upon hearing this voice,
everyone couldn’t help but look up.
Because, this was the first time they had heard such a voice.
The other party had always been pretending to be a normal program sound.
Now, it wanted to communicate with them?
Han Xing stepped forward and said directly, "I’m looking for the Godslaying-level weapon blueprint."
"If it’s not here, I’ll destroy this pillar."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s threat.
The tone was silent for a moment, then asked.
"What you are looking for, could it be our Race’s Transcendent-level weapon?"
"Transcendent-level?" Han Xing was stunned for a moment.
Turns out, this Race calls Godslaying-level weapons, Transcendent-level weapons?
"Yes." Han Xing nodded.
The audio paused for a moment.
Then mechanically said, "Unfortunately, you probably won’t find it."
"Can’t find it? Why?" Han Xing asked.
"Because, even our Race has never actually created a Transcendent-level weapon."
"Such powerful weapons are still at the conceptual stage."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was silent for a moment.
"Conceptual stage? So the Dwarf Race also hasn’t mastered Transcendent-level weapons?"
"Yes."
The audio answered directly: "The information about the Transcendent-level weapons was deliberately leaked by our Race."
"The purpose is to attract strong beings from these alien races to come."
Han Xing was silent for a moment, seeming to analyze the truth in the other party’s words.
"If I find out you’re lying to me, I’ll destroy you the first chance I get.
"You should know, I have that ability."
The audio echoed mechanically, "I believe you have that power."
"Your power is too strong..."
"Even the Insect Race Queen died at your hands, our Race no longer has any forces to counter your power."
"Moreover, through calculations, I deduced that even if you say you won’t destroy me."
"After leaving, there is a 90% probability you would strike against me."
Han Xing was taken aback, then awkwardly smiled as if he had been seen through.
To be honest, that was indeed his plan.
Because he didn’t know whether this relic had any other means.
For convenience next time he entered.
So Han Xing decided to destroy the pillar after leaving.
The atmosphere seemed a bit awkward at the moment.
At this time, the voice continued to speak.
"I wonder, if I reveal some intelligence I know, could I exchange it for a chance at survival?"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing understood.
"I can consider it."
"Provided that you can truthfully answer my upcoming questions."
The voice paused for a moment, then said: "I can."
Han Xing immediately posed the first question: "How many Insect Race Queens are left in your Race?"
This is the No. 5 Primitive Ruin.
Han Xing believed that they definitely had more than one such relic.
Therefore, other Primitive Ruins must also have the same level of power.
The core of the relic replied: "Excluding the queens who died at doomsday."
"There are still three queens left in the entire Insect Race World."
Upon hearing this number.
Han Xing nodded.
It was pretty much as he expected.
And this also indirectly showed that this Race was very powerful.
Even with three Divine-level Insect Emperors, plus the one Han Xing killed.
That was a full four Divine-level creatures.
Although in the Holy Spirit Realm, their combat power was only equivalent to the Demigod limit.
But it was still quite a terrifying force.
Han Xing continued to ask: "Second question, where did you come from?"
For this question, the voice answered quickly.
"In the endless void, with no specific location known."
"We only built these relics by exhausting all resources of the Race before doomsday."
"Hoping to preserve the last spark."
Han Xing nodded, "Well then, third question."
"How many of you are in the Holy Spirit Realm now, or when do you plan to invade the Holy Spirit Realm?"
This question seemed to have touched a kind of taboo.
The voice was silent for a long time this time without answering.
However, when Han Xing faintly showed a hint of killing intent.
The voice quickly replied.
"Originally, there were more than a dozen Insect Generals, plus two Insect Kings."
"After you killed seven Insect Generals, there should be 8 Insect Generals and two Insect Kings left in your world."
Han Xing pondered for a moment.
The voice referred to the Insect Generals.
Corresponds to the Legends of the Holy Spirit Realm.
Insect Kings are Demigods.
This number is already quite terrifying.
And this also indirectly showed that this Race had mastered a lot of information about the Holy Spirit Realm.
The voice continued to say.
"As for when we plan to invade the Holy Spirit Realm..."
"Through information returned by kin, we already know that your world’s power is truly terrifying."
"Even Mother Queen level existences are not few."
"In the short term, our goal is to lie low."
Han Xing smiled upon hearing this and said: "You guys indeed have self-awareness."
"With your current power, invading the Holy Spirit Realm truly has no hope."
"Alright, I’m done asking my questions."
The audio broadcast appeared again.
"I have already answered your questions."
"Now, I will open the teleportation gate to send you out of the relic."
With that said.
A deep purple teleportation gate appeared once more in front of Han Xing.
"Then, please leave."
The other party seemed eager to rush them away.
However, at this time Han Xing turned around and said, "Who said I was leaving?"

chapters.title: Chapter 646 - 387: Clues to the Godslaying-level Weapon and the Return
paragraphs: The voice paused for a moment, "Didn’t you say that as long as I answer the question, you would spare my relic core?"
Han Xing said, "I did say that, but I never said I would leave right away."
"We still have things to take."
The voice echoed hollowly.
"The No. 5 Primitive Ruins have already been searched by you all."
"If you still need any resources, help yourselves."
The other party seemed to have completely given up on struggling.
Like a young maiden at the mercy of others.
Han Xing laughed, "I wasn’t talking about that."
"I’ll wait until my next visit to take those resources."
Upon hearing these words.
The blue pillar flashed a burst of light.
It seemed surprised that this bandit still intended to come again.
Moments later.
The voice asked, "What else do you need?"
Han Xing said, "Didn’t you say that there are already theories related to your transcendent-level weapons?"
"To what extent has the specific research been conducted?"
"Tell me about it."
The light on the blue pillar continued to flicker.
In response to this question, the other party replied quickly.
"Based on the world’s energy level and the method of energy utilization, we discovered that our Insect Emperor Level is different from the divine level of the Great World."
"The process from tier-three energy to tier-one energy output is attenuated by some means."
"According to our calculations..."
Han Xing interrupted directly, "Stop, just give me the conclusion."
The voice paused for a moment again.
"In simple terms, although the transcendent-level weapon we developed can harm our Insect Emperor, its lethality against the divine spirits of the Great World is greatly reduced."
"At most, it can only exert the power of a high-tier ancient weapon."
Hearing this, Han Xing asked in confusion, "It will be reduced? Do you know why?"
"I don’t know."
"However, through calculations of all relic cores in the Insect Race World, we deduced a possibility."
"That is, when crafting the transcendent-level weapon, a crucial material was missing."
"And this material is something we only inferred through some data."
"We are not even sure if such a substance exists in the world.
However, upon hearing this, Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
"You mean, you’ve already developed the relevant blueprint."
"But because of the lack of a certain material, it cannot be created?"
"Yes."
Han Xing said, "Let me see the blueprint."
The voice paused for a moment, seemingly considering.
Then, it directly said, "Alright."
As soon as the words fell.
A mass of numbers appeared above the blue pillar.
These numbers combined and arranged.
Finally, in front of Han Xing, an object resembling a Dyson Sphere appeared.
[Celestial Orbit Strike Device Blueprint]: Contains some unknown powerful force, said to be able to permanently obliterate rules and completely kill a True God.
[Attack Power]: Unknown
[Defense Value]: Unknown
[Attack Range]: Unknown
[Special Effect]: Unknown.

[Construction Materials]: Philosopher’s Stone*50 million, Shimmering Terra Stone*50 million, Ancient Elf Secret Ingot*20 million, Calamity Divine Gold*500,000, Chaos Divine Stone*200,000, Unknown Item: Code World Will*1.
The previous materials, except for the Ancient Elf Secret Ingot, were unheard of.
The other materials, Han Xing still has plenty of them.
But since there is a specific name.
Presumably, it can be found in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Only the last unknown item left Han Xing completely puzzled.
"World Will... What the heck is this?"
Han Xing was full of confusion.
No wonder this pillar said that this item was only something they speculated about.
There is no specific physical reference.
Thinking of this, Han Xing decided to put away the blueprint first.
After returning to the Holy Spirit Realm, he would inquire about it.
[Obtained Godslaying-level Weapon Blueprint: Celestial Orbit Strike Device.]
Han Xing directly clicked to learn, then nodded in satisfaction.
Thus, this trip to the ancient ruins.
Was considered a success.
Not only did he acquire a large amount of high-level materials, but also obtained the Godslaying-level weapon blueprint.
At this moment, Han Xing said, "Open the teleportation gate, we’re going out."
"Alright."
The voice sounded relieved.
A purple teleportation gate appeared again.
"The teleportation gate is now open."
"Moreover, something to note."
"Due to your killing of the Queen Mother, the operating program of this world has malfunctioned."
"The portal between the two realms has opened ahead of time."
"Only less than two days remain before it closes."
"Once it closes, no one knows when it will open again."
"We can’t do anything about it either."
Han Xing paused for a moment, "You mean, we have to return to the Holy Spirit Realm now?"
That voice said, "If you want to stay here for a few more years, it’s doable."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing rolled his eyes.
"I get it."
Saying this, Han Xing suddenly laughed, "Your service is good, I’ll come back for you next time."
With that said.
The blue pillar trembled a few more times.
Then, the five of them entered the teleportation array one after another.
The scene before them changed, and they returned outside the No. 5 ruins.
At this moment, Shen Yun suddenly said, "Brother Xing, I checked the location of the central teleportation array mentioned by the Dwarf King back then."
"It’s still hundreds of thousands of kilometers away from us. If there’s only two days left, we need to hurry over now."
Han Xing nodded, "Hmm, let’s go now."
"This trip to the Secret Realm is almost over."
"Let’s head back to the Holy Spirit Realm now and process the gains we’ve made."
"Our power should be able to increase significantly!"

At this moment, Shen Yun suddenly said, "Brother Xing, I checked the location of the central teleportation array mentioned by the Dwarf King back then."
"It’s still hundreds of thousands of kilometers away from us.
If there’s only two days left, we need to hurry over now."
Han Xing nodded, "Hmm, let’s go now."
"This trip to the Secret Realm is almost over."
"Let’s head back to the Holy Spirit Realm now and process the gains we’ve made."
"Our power should be able to increase significantly!"

chapters.title: Chapter 647 - 387: Clues to the Godslayer-Level Weapon and the Return
paragraphs: Upon hearing this, everyone showed smiles on their faces.
They all knew how terrifying this yield was.
The total resources in the six backpacks were almost equivalent to the wealth of a top family in the Holy Spirit Realm.
It was the accumulation of countless clan members over tens of thousands of years.
If they could digest it.
One could imagine how many times their strength could be improved compared to before.
With an expectant mindset.
Then, they sped towards the central teleportation array.
Along the way, using the chip’s sensing system.
They sensed many red dots converging towards the same place.
"It seems, the powerful clans from various races have received the message."
"The central teleportation array has been activated early," Han Xing pondered.
The powerful individuals from various races were rushing towards the central teleportation array area.
Along the way, the riot of the mechanical army became even more terrifying.
The entire world seemed to be occupied by the mechanical army.
Numerous mechanical monsters crawled up from the ground, crazily charging at Han Xing and his team.
However, Han Xing and his team’s attack speed was even faster.
"Boom!"
"Boom boom!"
The Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill and Large Fireball burst out wave after wave.
Those mechanical monsters were almost instantly blasted into metal parts, scattering on the ground.
The corpses of these mechanical monsters on the ground, Han Xing and his team didn’t spend much time on disassembly.
After all, the backpacks of all five were already full.
They charged all the way, advancing like a hot knife through butter.
Along the way, all the mechanical monsters were blasted to pieces by them.
Twenty hours later.
Han Xing and his team arrived at the target area.
Ahead, tens of thousands of meters away.
There was a vast open space.
In that open space, energy storms were swirling.
"Whoosh—whoosh—"
Even from afar, everyone felt their footing unstable.
The violent energy made it impossible for everyone to get close!
"Jeez, this wind is really strong!" Cheng Jianyong complained.
Shen Yun pointed to the distance and said, "Brother Xing, look ahead.
"It seems some are already ahead of us."
Upon hearing this, everyone looked over.
On the other side of this vast open space.
Stood other alien races.
Those powerful individuals from other races had above middle-tier legend strength.
They looked somewhat unfamiliar.
Not the batch from exploring the No. 5 Primitive Ruins.
Therefore, they did not know Han Xing.
Seeing Han Xing and his team approaching, they became vigilant.
Han Xing had no time to care about them and directly said, "Ignore them, we just need to keep waiting."
Everyone nodded.
Four or five hours later.
A few more powerful individuals flew over.
Everyone maintained a mindset of not interfering with each other, found a place, and quietly waited.
At this moment, Shen Yun looked at the storm area and said, "Brother Xing, the storm seems to be stopping, I saw the outline of a teleportation array."
Han Xing nodded, "At this pace, we should be able to pass through tomorrow."
"We keep waiting."
Then, everyone stood in a corner area, silently waiting.
As time passed.
The powerful individuals gathered became more numerous.
Ten hours later.
Bright Divine Son and Little Giant Spirit King also came with their people.
They also saw Han Xing standing aside.
Expressions suddenly changed.
Even their gazes towards Han Xing were somewhat evasive.
Bright Divine Son and Little Giant Spirit King quickly moved to the side, without saying a word.
Appearing very low-key.
"Little Giant Spirit King, how are the gains from this ruin adventure?"
A legendary powerhouse with a bird-like head spoke.
He seemed to want to get chummy with Little Giant Spirit King.
However, upon hearing this question, Little Giant Spirit King’s face became uglier.
He directly waved away, distancing from the legendary powerhouse.
Afraid of drawing someone’s attention.
"This..."
The bird-like headed powerhouse hesitated.
With doubt in his eyes, seemingly not understanding why Little Giant Spirit King reacted like this.
The group of powerful individuals looked bewildered, as if they didn’t know what happened.
Just when they went around to inquire other powerful individuals beside the Giant Spirit King.
Each of them kept silent too.
Everyone’s expressions were peculiar.
Because compared to their initial arrogance when they entered.
Now, it seemed as if they were struck by something.
As low-key as possible.
A few hours more passed.
The storm gradually calmed down.
The massive teleportation gate gradually took shape.
Dark Divine Son and Divine Son Wan Liu also arrived sometime.
After arriving, they, like Little Giant Spirit King, maintained considerable silence.
Then came Elinora.
Upon seeing Han Xing, unlike Little Giant Spirit King’s fearful reaction.
She gave a slight smile as a greeting.
Then found a place to quietly wait.
At this point.
The remaining powerful individuals from various races in the ancient ruins were all here.
Han Xing roughly counted.
There were 74 people left.
Apart from those who died in the No. 5 Ruins.
The others all perished in the mechanical monster riot.
This time, those who entered were all the elite from various races.
Losing a quarter.
One could imagine the commotion outside.
Half an hour later.
The storm finally stopped.
A massive purple teleportation gate appeared.
An audio announcement prompted:
"The teleportation gate between realms is open, all powerful individuals please enter quickly."
As the words fell.
Dozens of powerful individuals simultaneously rushed towards the purple teleportation gate.
Meanwhile.
Holy Spirit Realm, Dwarf Realm.
Nearby the black Sky Island, dozens of demigod-level auras had gathered.

chapters.title: Chapter 648 - 387: Clues to the Godslaying-level Weapon and the Return
paragraphs: There are many, even those old monsters who rarely show themselves.
Now, they have all come to the Dwarf Realm.
A demigod-level expert with a bat head and an aged appearance suddenly spoke.
"Old Snake, you came too? I thought you were long dead!"
In the front, a demigod-level expert with a serpentine body said flatly, "Old Ghost, if you’re not dead, how could I be?"
The bat demigod squinted its eyes, watching the other with interest, saying, "The fight thousands of years ago, we still haven’t settled it."
"How about we fight again today?"
The serpent demigod, upon hearing this, instantly retorted in anger: "Afraid of you? Not a chance!"
With those words, it directly unleashed its aura.
Half of the Dwarf Realm’s sky was dyed purple-black.
The bat demigod was also unwilling to show weakness.
Blood-colored divine power surged.
Countless ordinary dwarves were intimidated by these two auras, shaking in fear!
At this moment, another aura joined in.
"Two old things, nearly ten thousand years old, still fighting like children."
"Have you lost your reason because your offspring have perished?"
Pointed out in public by this voice.
The faces of the two demigods turned dark in an instant.
"Are you courting death, Min Tai!"
Other demigod-level experts also had somewhat unpleasant expressions.
However, the speaking demigod showed no fear.
He knew that these guys dared not make a move.
This is the Dwarf King’s territory.
This time, the reason so many demigods gathered here.
Is because they all sensed.
The Divine Sons of their respective races lost contact within the Secret Realm of the Dwarf Race.
Multiple signs indicate that these Divine Sons are likely in trouble.
Or even have perished.
Meanwhile, demigods from other major races also received the message immediately.
Huge upheavals have occurred in ancient ruins!
Many Divine Sons perished within.
Fearing that their Divine Sons and Daughters might encounter unforeseen events, each rushed to the Dwarf Realm.
The aura of three demigod-level beings was too terrifying.
Half the Dwarf Realm, billions of dwarves were intimidated by those few auras.
At this moment.
A cold snort was heard.
"Hmph!"
This sound was like a heavy hammer hitting, echoing in the ears of the demigod-level experts.
They only felt their hearts sink,
Especially the three demigod-level experts releasing their auras felt as if struck by lightning!
"Behave yourselves!"
"If anyone dares to release divine power again, don’t blame me for striking you down on the spot!"
The Dwarf King’s tone was very unfriendly.
However, not a single demigod dared to say anything more.
Because from the Dwarf King’s recent cold snort,
They felt an extremely terrifying aura and killing intent.
They knew the Dwarf King was serious!
Even the three demigods whose divine power domains were interrupted all shut their mouths.
Because, compared to them.
The Dwarf King appeared even angrier and more furious.
According to their intelligence reports.
This time, the Dwarf Race sent seven high-tier Legends.
All of whom have lost contact.
Various signs indicate these dwarves are all dead.
It can be said the loss is severe.
Ignoring the eyes of those demigods upon themselves,
The Dwarf King kept a stern face, watching the teleportation array before him.
From the early activation of the teleportation array,
He knew that this journey to the Secret Realm had taken an unexpected turn.
In his heart, a bad premonition arose.
Just then, a fluctuation appeared in the teleportation array.
Everyone knew that the people inside were about to come out.
At this point, the Dwarf King spoke again: "This time, after the Divine Sons and Daughters come out."
"I hope the clan leaders won’t rush to take them back."
"Wait for me to clarify the inside situation and what actually happened, then take them away."
"I hope everyone can cooperate."
Hearing these words, the demigods on the scene all frowned.
They picked up on the threatening tone in the Dwarf King’s words.
However, no one said much.
After all, this time, the Dwarf Race did suffer greatly.
A full seven high-tier Legends fell inside.
Some demigod-level experts glanced at each other and nodded.
Besides this group of demigods, over a dozen others also kept stern faces.
They all felt that the connection with their own Divine Sons and Daughters was severed,
Now is their last hope.
They only wished that those clansmen merely encountered some unexpected situation.
And hadn’t truly perished.
At this moment.
The teleportation array before them flickered with light.
All the demigods instantly focused their gaze.
A golden light burst forth.
The Bright Divine Son from the Sea of Light.
He was the fastest, also the first to rush out.
As the Bright Divine Son looked up, he saw a golden figure appear in the sky.
Exclaimed with joy: "Uncle!"
The Bright Divine Son just wanted to rush over.
But found himself instantly locked by a dozen demigod-level auras.
"Stop!"
The demigod-level experts simultaneously shouted.
The Bright Divine Son’s expression froze for a moment, and he asked, "What do you mean by this?"
The group of demigods, in a foul mood, didn’t want to answer the Bright Divine Son’s question.
At this time, the Dwarf King said, "Neotos, stay put."
"Wait until everyone comes out, I’ll ask a few questions."
"Then you can go."
The Bright Divine Son frowned slightly.
But since it was the Dwarf King, the Bright Divine Son dared not act out.
Thus, he looked to a demigod-level expert in the distance, his uncle.
However, the other party said, "Neotos, cooperate with them."
"It’ll be fine after they finish questioning."
The Bright Divine Son froze instantly at these words.
He didn’t expect that the demigod, being his clansman, his uncle,
Would also say this.
At this point, he realized the situation might be beyond his expectations...

chapters.title: Chapter 649 - 388: Interrogation, the Ogre Lord’s Difficulties
paragraphs: The Bright Divine Son realized that something was amiss with the situation in front of him.
So, he stood in place.
A few seconds later.
Several other Divine Sons emerged one after another.
They all encountered the same situation as the Bright Divine Son.
They were restricted to their original positions, unable to move.
Even the Little Giant Spirit King and Elinora, Divine Sons from major races,
suffered the same treatment.
Though the Little Giant Spirit King was quite dissatisfied,
under the intimidation of so many demigod-level powerhouses, he stood still obediently.
Everyone waited silently.
Until, finally, Han Xing and the other four appeared.
The teleportation array then closed at that moment.
On the field, all 74 people remained in their original positions.
Dozens of powerful gazes focused on them.
With so many eyes, all of demigod-level powerhouses, staring at them,
everyone felt a terrifying pressure.
Han Xing and his companions, however, felt nothing.
After all, they had faced even Divine Spirit-level creatures before.
These demigods could no longer pose any effective deterrent to them.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong whispered, "Tsk, what a spectacle."
"Why do I feel like half of the demigod-level powerhouses of the Holy Spirit Realm are here?"
Everyone nodded in agreement.
Indeed, the number of demigods here was somewhat unexpectedly large.
But they didn’t know the purpose of these demigods gathering here.
They could only vaguely guess it might be related to these Divine Sons.
"Could it be that these demigod-level powerhouses are here to welcome us?" Cheng Jianyong suddenly laughed.
Shen Yun rolled her eyes at him: "What are you thinking? Welcoming us?"
"It’s already good enough they’re not here to cause us trouble."
At this moment, the senses of the demigods were incredibly sharp, and they naturally noticed the five of them.
To see five sudden humans, all of legendary-level strength, surprised the demigods.
However, these demigods didn’t say much.
Because now, there were more important matters to attend to.
At this point, the Dwarf King glanced around at everyone on the field.
After confirming that none of the seven dwarves had come out,
a trace of sadness appeared in his eyes.
After all, they were his tribe’s people.
The Dwarf King sighed, "Do you know how our legendary dwarves died?"
"Or, do you know what happened inside?"
As soon as the Dwarf King spoke,
those demigod-level powerhouses, who had lost tribe members...
No, those whose tribe members had died, immediately began to ask questions.
"And my tribe’s Divine Son of the Crab, did anyone see what happened to him?"
"My tribe’s Divine Son of the Demon Ram didn’t come out either."
They all started asking questions simultaneously.
However, Han Xing and his group finally figured out the purpose of the demigods gathering here.
In summary, they wanted to know the cause of death of their tribe’s Divine Sons.
At this moment, the Divine Sons began answering in a cacophony of voices.
After a round of exchanges,
the demigods roughly understood the situation that had occurred inside.
Then, the field fell into a brief silence.
They were all digesting the information they just received.
A moment later, the Dwarf King asked in confusion, "You mean, there was a large-scale riot of mechanical monsters inside?"
"And even many high-tier legendary level mechanical monsters appeared?"
The Divine Sons below nodded in unison.
The Dwarf King frowned deeply.
Because, this was something he had never encountered before.
The Dwarf Race had entered ancient ruins many times but had never encountered such a mechanical riot situation.
At this moment, the Dwarf King pondered for a moment, as if remembering something.
"No, with the strength of our seven legends, even if they encountered a mechanical monster riot, it’s impossible for none of them to survive!"
He looked at the Divine Sons on the field, asking seriously.
"Does anyone know how our legends died?
Hearing these words.
More than half of the Divine Sons on the field looked puzzled.
They had not experienced the trial of the ancient ruins and did not know what had happened inside.
And now, hearing the Dwarf King mention it, they were shocked to discover.
Those seven dwarves really hadn’t returned!
Seeing the puzzled expressions of the Divine Sons,
The Dwarf King shook his head in disappointment.
Because he knew.
These Divine Sons might really be unaware of how those legendary dwarves died.
However, among the crowd, there were a few Divine Sons with peculiar expressions.
Because, those who experienced the ruins journey knew.
Those few dwarves were not truly of the Dwarf Race.
They had long been possessed by the Insect Race.
They were actually seven demigod-level insect monsters.
Yet now, seeing the Dwarf King’s reaction.
He seemed completely unaware of this matter?
The Dwarf King, as a top demigod, had incredibly acute perception abilities.
He immediately noticed the strange behavior of those few Divine Sons.
His divine sense instantly locked onto those individuals.
"It seems you know some inside information."
"Then, can you tell me what you know?"
Although the Dwarf King used the word ’please’ in his speech, his tone carried an air of undeniable authority.
Under the pressure of a top demigod’s aura.
The faces of those Divine Sons turned pale, and some even had blood trickling from the corners of their mouths!
At this time, a few auras burst forth from the sky: "Krumman, what are you doing?"
"Krumman! Don’t lay a hand on our Divine Sons!"
Several demigod-level powerhouses rushed over.
However, the Dwarf King did not stop, and spoke in a deep voice.
"I am inquiring about the clues regarding the death of strong members of my tribe, I hope you do not interrupt me."

At this moment, the senses of the demigods were incredibly sharp, and they naturally noticed the five of them.
To see five sudden humans, all of legendary-level strength, surprised the demigods.
However, these demigods didn’t say much.
Because now, there were more important matters to attend to.
At this point, the Dwarf King glanced around at everyone on the field.
After confirming that none of the seven dwarves had come out,
a trace of sadness appeared in his eyes.
After all, they were his tribe’s people.
The Dwarf King sighed, "Do you know how our legendary dwarves died?"
"Or, do you know what happened inside?"
As soon as the Dwarf King spoke,
those demigod-level powerhouses, who had lost tribe members...
No, those whose tribe members had died, immediately began to ask questions.
"And my tribe’s Divine Son of the Crab, did anyone see what happened to him?"
"My tribe’s Divine Son of the Demon Ram didn’t come out either."
They all started asking questions simultaneously.
However, Han Xing and his group finally figured out the purpose of the demigods gathering here.
In summary, they wanted to know the cause of death of their tribe’s Divine Sons.
At this moment, the Divine Sons began answering in a cacophony of voices.
After a round of exchanges,
the demigods roughly understood the situation that had occurred inside.
Then, the field fell into a brief silence.
They were all digesting the information they just received.
A moment later, the Dwarf King asked in confusion, "You mean, there was a large-scale riot of mechanical monsters inside?"
"And even many high-tier legendary level mechanical monsters appeared?"
The Divine Sons below nodded in unison.
The Dwarf King frowned deeply.
Because, this was something he had never encountered before.
The Dwarf Race had entered ancient ruins many times but had never encountered such a mechanical riot situation.
At this moment, the Dwarf King pondered for a moment, as if remembering something.
"No, with the strength of our seven legends, even if they encountered a mechanical monster riot, it’s impossible for none of them to survive!"
He looked at the Divine Sons on the field, asking seriously.
"Does anyone know how our legends died?
Hearing these words.
More than half of the Divine Sons on the field looked puzzled.
They had not experienced the trial of the ancient ruins and did not know what had happened inside.
And now, hearing the Dwarf King mention it, they were shocked to discover.
Those seven dwarves really hadn’t returned!
Seeing the puzzled expressions of the Divine Sons,
The Dwarf King shook his head in disappointment.
Because he knew.
These Divine Sons might really be unaware of how those legendary dwarves died.
However, among the crowd, there were a few Divine Sons with peculiar expressions.
Because, those who experienced the ruins journey knew.
Those few dwarves were not truly of the Dwarf Race.
They had long been possessed by the Insect Race.
They were actually seven demigod-level insect monsters.
Yet now, seeing the Dwarf King’s reaction.
He seemed completely unaware of this matter?
The Dwarf King, as a top demigod, had incredibly acute perception abilities.
He immediately noticed the strange behavior of those few Divine Sons.
His divine sense instantly locked onto those individuals.
"It seems you know some inside information."
"Then, can you tell me what you know?"
Although the Dwarf King used the word ’please’ in his speech, his tone carried an air of undeniable authority.
Under the pressure of a top demigod’s aura.
The faces of those Divine Sons turned pale, and some even had blood trickling from the corners of their mouths!
At this time, a few auras burst forth from the sky: "Krumman, what are you doing?"
"Krumman!
Don’t lay a hand on our Divine Sons!"
Several demigod-level powerhouses rushed over.
However, the Dwarf King did not stop, and spoke in a deep voice.
"I am inquiring about the clues regarding the death of strong members of my tribe, I hope you do not interrupt me."

chapters.title: Chapter 650 - 388: Interrogation, the Ogre Lord’s Difficulties
paragraphs: As the words fell, an aura of extreme might flickered briefly.
The demigod-level experts rushing over had their momentum halted.
Their Divine Power Domains were instantly broken, causing them to plummet from the sky.
All the strong individuals present changed their expressions, and with disbelief, they said.
"Krumman, you are indeed close to reaching that realm!"
Including Han Xing and the others below, who couldn’t help but look up at this dwarf.
From the Dwarf King’s recent move, they had already gauged his strength.
At least at the pseudo-divine level.
The aura was even on par with that of the Insect Mother!
This Dwarf King was truly powerful.
The demigod-level experts dared not say more.
The Divine Sons locked below felt a mountain-like pressure.
They cast probing glances toward Han Xing and his group.
Because, most of the seven dwarves’ deaths were at the hands of Han Xing and his group.
Including the last three dwarves who turned into insects, all personally slain by Han Xing.
The Dwarf King noticed their glances and asked.
"Do you have anything to say to me?"
Just as the Dwarf King’s attention was about to shift to Han Xing and his group.
Elinora spoke up, "Your Majesty the King, I know how those seven legendary dwarves died."
Upon hearing this, the Dwarf King’s attention shifted to Elinora.
"Elf Goddess, tell me, what exactly happened."
Elinora replied with neither humility nor arrogance, "The seven legendary members of the Dwarf Race died in the endless trials of the Primitive Ruins."
"Including several other Divine Sons who also encountered accidents during the endless trials."
Upon hearing this, the scene fell silent for a moment.
At this moment, the Dwarf King asked, "Primitive Ruins? How is that possible!"
"I am well aware of the difficulty of the Primitive Ruins; it is absolutely impossible for it to have caused the death of seven high-tier legends of my race."
"You are lying!"
The Dwarf King immediately roared in anger, and a powerful aura pressed instantly toward Elinora.
Elinora turned pale.
Even as the Divine Maiden of the Elf Race, she could not withstand the force of an existence about to break through to Divine Spirit.
Elinora took several deep breaths, adjusted her state, and continued.
"Your Majesty the King, I am not lying."
"This time, some unexpected changes occurred in the endless trials within the Primitive Ruins."
"We challenged over eighty rounds before reaching the ultimate trial grounds."
"Giant Spirit King and Bright Divine Son should both be able to testify to this."
The Dwarf King looked toward them.
Giant Spirit King and Bright Divine Son nodded, "The Elf Goddess speaks the truth; this time, indeed many unexpected situations arose."
"Not only the strong of the Dwarf Race but also we almost fell in there."
Hearing this, all the demigods present were shocked.
They all knew how formidable Giant Spirit King’s talent was!
Even he said he almost died there.
And it sounded nothing like a lie.
From this, one could see how terrifying the so-called Primitive Ruins challenge was.
At this time, the Divine Sons who also participated in the primordial challenge echoed.
"Yes, yes, Giant Spirit King and Elf Goddess are telling the truth."
"This time, the Primitive Ruins were too dangerous!"
"We almost got wiped out in there!"
With so many people saying so.
The Dwarf King frowned.
From his divine power perception, these strong individuals were not lying to him.
This meant they were telling the truth now.
The Dwarf King sighed, his tone gradually softening.
"Even you almost perished, it seems the endless trials in the Primitive Ruins indeed increased in difficulty."
"Thinking back, it’s reasonable."
"Alas..."
The Dwarf King sighed helplessly.
It seemed he accepted the reality of those legendary dwarves’ deaths.
Then, he withdrew his divine power oppression.
The Divine Sons felt relieved.
Meanwhile.
The demigods on the scene almost figured out what had happened inside.
At this moment, the Dwarf King turned around and addressed the strong individuals.
"You’ve all heard it, an unexpected change occurred during this trip to the Ancient Ruins."
"Divine Sons of all races died by accident, including several of my race’s legends."
"You may all disperse now."
On the scene, the demigod-level experts who lost their clansmen were still quite depressed.
But at this moment, they could only sigh helplessly.
After all, even the Dwarf King didn’t intend to pursue it any further.
Continuing to pursue would be meaningless.
Meanwhile.
The Divine Sons returned to their respective races’ strong individuals.
Han Xing and the other four looked around, also ready to leave.
And just at this moment.
A two-headed ogre demigod’s gaze locked onto Han Xing and his group.
This ogre was blood-red all over, a sign of atavism.
Han Xing and his group also felt that inspecting gaze, mixed with hostility.
They walked some distance.
However, that gaze still lingered.
Cheng Jianyong then said speechlessly, "Why does that ogre keep staring at us?"
"Isn’t it planning to make a move on us too?"
Han Xing shook his head and said, "No worries, ignore it."
"If this guy dares to make a move, we won’t be polite either."
Hearing this, everyone nodded, understanding Han Xing’s meaning.
Han Xing and his group ignored the ogre’s gaze.
Directly preparing to manipulate divine power to leave.
And just at this moment.
